sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceCatalogService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCatalog.ts";
import { toWorkspaceViewRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readValueFromQuery(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (const candidate of value) {
            const text = cleanText(candidate);
            if (text) {
                return text;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        return cleanText(value.value) || cleanText(value.sys_id);
    }
    return cleanText(value);
}
function readQueryParam(request, key) {
    const queryString = cleanText(request?.queryString);
    if (!queryString) {
        const queryParams = request?.queryParams;
        if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === "object") {
            return readValueFromQuery(queryParams[key]);
        }
        return "";
    }
    const normalizedQuery = queryString.startsWith("?") ? queryString.slice(1) : queryString;
    for (const entry of normalizedQuery.split("&")) {
        if (!entry) {
            continue;
        }
        const [rawKey, ...rawValueParts] = entry.split("=");
        if (cleanText(decodeURIComponent(rawKey || "")) !== key) {
            continue;
        }
        const rawValue = rawValueParts.join("=");
        if (!rawValue) {
            return "";
        }
        return cleanText(decodeURIComponent(rawValue.replace(/\+/g, " ")));
    }
    const queryParams = request?.queryParams;
    if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === "object") {
        return readValueFromQuery(queryParams[key]);
    }
    return "";
}
function readPageNumber(request, key, fallback) {
    const value = Number(readQueryParam(request, key));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
}
function normalizeWorkspacePayload(result) {
    return {
        mode: "servicenow",
        ...result
    };
}
function logUnexpectedWorkspaceError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace catalog failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace catalog] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const workspaceSlug = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSlug") || readQueryParam(request, "workspace");
    const searchText = readQueryParam(request, "q") || readQueryParam(request, "searchText") || readQueryParam(request, "name");
    const page = readPageNumber(request, "page", 1);
    const pageSize = readPageNumber(request, "pageSize", 10);
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, searchTextPresent: Boolean(searchText), searchTextLength: searchText.length, page, pageSize };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceCatalogService();
        const workspaceSlug = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSlug") || readQueryParam(request, "workspace");
        if (workspaceSlug) {
            const workspace = await service.getWorkspace(workspaceSlug);
            if (!workspace) {
                response.setStatus?.(404);
                response.setBody({
                    error: {
                        message: "Workspace could not be found."
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
            response.setBody({
                result: normalizeWorkspacePayload({
                    workspace: toWorkspaceViewRecord(workspace, workspace.roleLabel)
                })
            });
            return;
        }
        const result = await service.listWorkspaces({
            searchText: readQueryParam(request, "q") || readQueryParam(request, "searchText") || readQueryParam(request, "name"),
            page: readPageNumber(request, "page", 1),
            pageSize: readPageNumber(request, "pageSize", 10)
        });
        response.setBody({
            result: normalizeWorkspacePayload({
                items: result.items.map((item) => toWorkspaceViewRecord(item, item.roleLabel ?? null)),
                canCreateWorkspaces: result.canCreateWorkspaces,
                page: result.page,
                pageSize: result.pageSize,
                totalCount: result.totalCount,
                hasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,
                searchText: result.searchText
            })
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceError(error, summarizeRequest(request));
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Unable to load workspaces. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspaces.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>e1502b8f7418431d8e2a2084ea45075e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspaces.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_e1502b8f7418431d8e2a2084ea45075e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideDateTime, GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE, createWorkspaceDraft, WORKSPACE_ROLE_NAMES } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceIcons.ts";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PROVISION_REQUEST_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_provision_request";
const PROVISION_STATUS_ROUTE_PATH = "/api/x_2300756_docsera/docsera_runtime/workspace-provisioning-status";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readLastErrorMessage(record) {
    return cleanText(record.getLastErrorMessage?.());
}
function logProvisioningFailure(event, safeMessage, detail) {
    const payload = {
        message: safeMessage,
        detail: cleanText(detail) || undefined
    };
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace provisioning] ${event} ${JSON.stringify(payload)}`);
}
function mapGroupRecord(record) {
    return {
        sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
        name: cleanText(record.getValue("name")),
        description: cleanText(record.getValue("description")) || undefined
    };
}
function readRequestState(value) {
    const state = cleanText(value);
    if (state === "processing" || state === "succeeded" || state === "failed") {
        return state;
    }
    return "requested";
}
function readProvisionRequestRecord(requestId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(requestId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PROVISION_REQUEST_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return null;
    }
    return {
        adminGroupSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("admin_group")),
        editorGroupSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("editor_group")),
        errorCode: cleanText(record.getValue("error_code")),
        errorMessage: cleanText(record.getValue("error_message")),
        requestId: sysId,
        state: readRequestState(record.getValue("state")),
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace"))
    };
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
}
function loadGroupBySysId(groupSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(groupSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapGroupRecord(record);
}
function listReservedWorkspaceSlugs() {
    const slugs = [];
    const workspaces = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    workspaces.query();
    while (workspaces.next()) {
        const slug = cleanText(workspaces.getValue("workspace_slug"));
        if (slug) {
            slugs.push(slug);
        }
    }
    const requests = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PROVISION_REQUEST_TABLE);
    requests.addQuery("state", "IN", "requested,processing");
    requests.query();
    while (requests.next()) {
        const slug = cleanText(requests.getValue("workspace_slug"));
        if (slug) {
            slugs.push(slug);
        }
    }
    return slugs;
}
function allocateProvisionRequestSysId(record) {
    const generated = cleanText(gs.generateGUID?.());
    if (!generated) {
        throw new Error("Failed to allocate workspace provisioning request ID.");
    }
    record.setNewGuidValue(generated);
    return generated;
}
function createProvisionRequest(input) {
    const draft = createWorkspaceDraft(input, listReservedWorkspaceSlugs());
    const iconService = createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService();
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PROVISION_REQUEST_TABLE);
    record.initialize();
    const requestId = draft.icon.type === "uploaded" ? allocateProvisionRequestSysId(record) : "";
    record.setValue("name", draft.name);
    record.setValue("workspace_slug", draft.slug);
    record.setValue("workspace_group_key", draft.workspaceGroupKey);
    record.setValue("admin_group_name", draft.adminGroupName);
    record.setValue("editor_group_name", draft.editorGroupName);
    record.setValue("short_description", draft.shortDescription ?? "");
    record.setValue("icon_type", draft.icon.type);
    record.setValue("icon_key", draft.icon.key);
    record.setValue("icon_label", draft.icon.label);
    record.setValue("icon_asset_path", draft.icon.assetPath ?? "");
    record.setValue("workspace_status", draft.status);
    record.setValue("toc_default_visible", draft.layout.tocVisible);
    record.setValue("page_width", draft.layout.pageWidth);
    record.setValue("requested_by", draft.creatorUserSysId);
    record.setValue("state", "requested");
    record.setValue("error_code", "");
    record.setValue("error_message", "");
    if (draft.icon.type === "uploaded") {
        const claim = iconService.claimWorkspaceIcon(draft.icon.key, requestId);
        if (claim.kind === "failed") {
            throw new TypeError(claim.errorMessage);
        }
        record.setValue("icon_type", claim.icon.type);
        record.setValue("icon_key", claim.icon.key);
        record.setValue("icon_label", claim.icon.label);
        record.setValue("icon_asset_path", claim.icon.assetPath);
        const insertedRequestId = cleanText(record.insert());
        if (insertedRequestId !== requestId) {
            iconService.restoreWorkspaceIconClaim(claim.asset.sysId);
            const safeMessage = "Failed to queue workspace provisioning.";
            logProvisioningFailure(`createProvisionRequest uploaded insert failed ${draft.slug}`, safeMessage, readLastErrorMessage(record));
            throw new Error(safeMessage);
        }
        return requestId;
    }
    const insertedRequestId = cleanText(record.insert());
    if (!insertedRequestId) {
        const safeMessage = "Failed to queue workspace provisioning.";
        logProvisioningFailure(`createProvisionRequest insert failed ${draft.slug}`, safeMessage, readLastErrorMessage(record));
        throw new Error(safeMessage);
    }
    return insertedRequestId;
}
function buildStatusPath(requestId) {
    return `${PROVISION_STATUS_ROUTE_PATH}?requestId=${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}`;
}
function readProvisionRequestImmediately(requestId) {
    return readProvisionRequestRecord(requestId);
}
function buildSucceededOutcome(request) {
    const workspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(request.workspaceSysId);
    const adminGroup = loadGroupBySysId(request.adminGroupSysId);
    const editorGroup = loadGroupBySysId(request.editorGroupSysId);
    if (!workspace || !adminGroup || !editorGroup) {
        throw new Error("Workspace provisioning finished without complete result data.");
    }
    return {
        adminGroup,
        editorGroup,
        kind: "succeeded",
        requestId: request.requestId,
        workspace
    };
}
function buildOutcomeFromRequestRecord(request) {
    if (!request) {
        throw new Error("Workspace provisioning request could not be found.");
    }
    if (request.state === "succeeded") {
        return buildSucceededOutcome(request);
    }
    if (request.state === "failed") {
        return {
            kind: "failed",
            errorCode: request.errorCode || "provisioning_failed",
            errorMessage: request.errorMessage || "Workspace provisioning failed.",
            requestId: request.requestId
        };
    }
    return {
        kind: "pending",
        requestId: request.requestId,
        state: request.state
    };
}
export function createServiceNowWorkspaceProvisioningService() {
    return {
        async createWorkspace(input) {
            const creatorUserSysId = cleanText(gs.getUserID());
            if (!creatorUserSysId) {
                throw new Error("The current ServiceNow user could not be resolved.");
            }
            const requestId = createProvisionRequest({
                ...input,
                createdOn: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue(),
                creatorUserName: cleanText(gs.getUserName()),
                creatorUserSysId
            });
            return buildOutcomeFromRequestRecord(readProvisionRequestImmediately(requestId));
        },
        async getProvisioningStatus(requestId) {
            const request = readProvisionRequestRecord(requestId);
            if (!request) {
                return null;
            }
            return buildOutcomeFromRequestRecord(request);
        },
        listReservedWorkspaceSlugs,
        roleNames: WORKSPACE_ROLE_NAMES,
        statusPathFor(requestId) {
            return buildStatusPath(requestId);
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceProvisioning.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>04673d9a71504f38bbf38a075b26ee40</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceProvisioning.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_04673d9a71504f38bbf38a075b26ee40</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMedia.ts";
import { readQueryParam } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedMediaError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace media failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace media] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const workspaceSysId = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId");
    return { action: "list", workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService();
        const result = await service.listWorkspaceMedia({
            workspaceSysId: readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
        });
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                items: result.items
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedMediaError(error, summarizeRequest(request));
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Unable to load workspace media. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>f2f24ff947444a548dadd77df78e8050</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_f2f24ff947444a548dadd77df78e8050</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    return row.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(row) : null;
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response)) {
            return;
        }
        if (lease.kind !== "held") {
            return;
        }
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority) {
            return;
        }
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const pageSysId = cleanText(body.pageSysId);
        if (!pageSysId) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A target page is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "not_found", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService().discardPage({
            authority,
            pageSysId,
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "forbidden", message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "invalid"
                            ? "invalid"
                            : result.code === "recovery_required"
                                ? "recovery_required"
                                : "discard_page_failed",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? { currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId, currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                discardedPageSysId: result.result.discardedPageSysId,
                pages: result.result.pages,
                pendingChanges: result.result.pendingChanges,
                workspaceStateRevision: result.result.workspaceStateRevision,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace discard-page] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace discard-page failure."}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "discard_page_failed", message: "Something went wrong while discarding changes to this page. No changes were discarded. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-discard-page.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>d077bb4d79a74384ac1b13030adaf98b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-discard-page.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_d077bb4d79a74384ac1b13030adaf98b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function normalizeServiceNowBoolean(value) {
    const normalized = cleanText(value).toLowerCase();
    return normalized === "1" || normalized === "true";
}
function normalizeIcon(record) {
    return {
        type: cleanText(record.getValue("icon_type")) === "uploaded" ? "uploaded" : "builtin",
        key: cleanText(record.getValue("icon_key")),
        label: cleanText(record.getValue("icon_label")) || "Docsera workspace icon",
        assetPath: cleanText(record.getValue("icon_asset_path")) || undefined
    };
}
export function mapWorkspaceRecord(record) {
    const workspaceStateRevision = Number(record.getValue("workspace_state_revision"));
    return {
        sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
        name: cleanText(record.getValue("name")),
        slug: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace_slug")),
        shortDescription: cleanText(record.getValue("short_description")) || null,
        icon: normalizeIcon(record),
        status: cleanText(record.getValue("status")) === "inactive" ? "inactive" : "active",
        adminGroupSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("admin_group")),
        editorGroupSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("editor_group")),
        creatorUserSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("creator")),
        creatorUserName: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("creator")) || null,
        createdOn: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("sys_created_on")) || null,
        updatedOn: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("sys_updated_on")) || null,
        updatedBy: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("sys_updated_by")) || null,
        pendingChangeSetSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("pending_change_set")) || null,
        publishedSnapshotSetSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("published_snapshot_set")) || null,
        workspaceStateRevision: Number.isSafeInteger(workspaceStateRevision) && workspaceStateRevision >= 0 ? workspaceStateRevision : null,
        layout: {
            tocVisible: normalizeServiceNowBoolean(record.getValue("toc_default_visible")),
            pageWidth: cleanText(record.getValue("page_width")) === "full" ? "full" : "readable"
        }
    };
}
export function cleanWorkspaceSlug(value) {
    return cleanText(value);
}
export function toWorkspaceViewRecord(workspace, roleLabel = null) {
    const canManageWorkspaceMembers = Boolean(roleLabel === "Admin");
    return {
        sysId: cleanText(workspace.sysId),
        slug: cleanText(workspace.slug),
        name: cleanText(workspace.name),
        shortDescription: workspace.shortDescription,
        icon: workspace.icon,
        layout: {
            tocVisible: workspace.layout.tocVisible
        },
        status: workspace.status,
        roleLabel,
        canManageSettings: canManageWorkspaceMembers,
        canManageWorkspaceMembers
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>d7b61708511743bebb11b064eff2b812</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_d7b61708511743bebb11b064eff2b812</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMedia.ts";
import { readHeader, readNumericHeader, readQueryParam, readRequestBodyDataStream } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedMediaError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace media upload failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace media upload] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const fileName = readQueryParam(request, "fileName");
    const workspaceSysId = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId");
    const contentLengthBytes = readNumericHeader(request, "Content-Length");
    return { action: "upload", fileNamePresent: Boolean(fileName), fileNameLength: fileName.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, contentTypePresent: Boolean(readHeader(request, "Content-Type")), contentLengthBytes: typeof contentLengthBytes === "number" ? contentLengthBytes : undefined };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService();
        const result = await service.uploadWorkspaceMedia({
            contentLengthBytes: readNumericHeader(request, "Content-Length"),
            contentType: readHeader(request, "Content-Type"),
            dataStream: readRequestBodyDataStream(request),
            fileName: readQueryParam(request, "fileName"),
            workspaceLeaseToken: readHeader(request, "X-Docsera-Workspace-Lease-Token"),
            workspaceSysId: readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
        });
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(201);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                media: result.media
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedMediaError(error, summarizeRequest(request));
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Something went wrong while uploading media. The file was not saved. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media-upload.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>4b23a3247e5443d982830553ce34992a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media-upload.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_4b23a3247e5443d982830553ce34992a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideDateTime, GlideDigest, GlideRecord, GlideSecureRandomUtil, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { loadWorkspaceBySlug } from "../pages/serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createWorkspaceEditLeaseService } from "./workspaceEditLeaseService.ts";
import { cleanText, DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE, DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceEditLeaseDomain.ts";
function timestamp() { return new GlideDateTime().getValue(); }
function map(record) { return { sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()), workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace")), holderUserSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("holder_user")), holderDisplayName: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("holder_user")) || null, verifierDigest: cleanText(record.getValue("verifier_digest")), acquiredAt: cleanText(record.getValue("acquired_on")), lastSeenAt: cleanText(record.getValue("last_seen_on")) }; }
function load(workspaceKey) { const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE); record.addQuery("workspace_key", workspaceKey); record.setLimit(1); record.query(); return record.next() ? map(record) : null; }
function expired(input) { const now = new GlideDateTime(); now.setValue(input.currentTimestamp); const seen = new GlideDateTime(); seen.setValue(input.lastSeenAt); return !now.isValid() || !seen.isValid() || seen.getNumericValue() < now.getNumericValue() - input.staleAfterMs; }
function loadActiveGeneration(workspace) {
    const changeSetId = cleanText(workspace.pendingChangeSetSysId);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(workspace.sysId);
    if (!changeSetId || !workspaceSysId)
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace editing is unavailable for this workspace.", retryable: false, status: 409 };
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", changeSetId))
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace editing is unavailable for this workspace.", retryable: false, status: 409 };
    const revision = Number(record.getValue("change_set_revision"));
    if (cleanText(record.getValue("workspace")) !== workspaceSysId || cleanText(record.getValue("lifecycle_state")) !== "active" || !Number.isSafeInteger(revision) || revision < 0) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace editing is unavailable for this workspace.", retryable: false, status: 409 };
    }
    const workspaceStateRevision = workspace.workspaceStateRevision;
    return {
        kind: "ready",
        generation: {
            changeSetId,
            changeSetRevision: revision,
            workspaceStateRevision: typeof workspaceStateRevision === "number" && workspaceStateRevision >= 0 ? workspaceStateRevision : null
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowWorkspaceEditLeaseService() {
    return createWorkspaceEditLeaseService({
        createToken: () => String(GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomString(48)), currentTimestamp: timestamp,
        digestToken: (value) => String(new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(value)), isLeaseExpired: expired,
        getCurrentUser: () => ({ sysId: cleanText(gs.getUserID()), displayName: cleanText(gs.getUserDisplayName()) || null }),
        loadActiveGeneration,
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        loadWorkspaceBySysId: (sysId) => { const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE); return record.get("sys_id", sysId) ? mapWorkspaceRecord(record) : null; },
        loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey: load,
        insertLease: (lease) => { const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE); record.initialize(); record.setValue("workspace_key", lease.workspaceSysId); record.setValue("workspace", lease.workspaceSysId); record.setValue("holder_user", lease.holderUserSysId); record.setValue("verifier_digest", lease.verifierDigest); record.setValue("acquired_on", lease.acquiredAt); record.setValue("last_seen_on", lease.lastSeenAt); try {
            return record.insert() ? "created" : "conflict";
        }
        catch {
            return "conflict";
        } },
        deleteExactExpiredLease: (input) => {
            const cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
            cutoff.setValue(input.currentTimestamp);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", input.expectedLeaseSysId);
            record.addQuery("workspace_key", input.workspaceKey);
            record.addQuery("last_seen_on", input.expectedLastSeenAt);
            record.addQuery("last_seen_on", "<", cutoff.getValue());
            record.query();
            record.deleteMultiple();
            return !load(input.workspaceKey);
        },
        touchExactLease: (input) => { const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE); if (!record.get("sys_id", input.leaseSysId) || cleanText(record.getValue("workspace_key")) !== input.workspaceKey || cleanText(record.getValue("holder_user")) !== input.holderUserSysId || cleanText(record.getValue("verifier_digest")) !== input.verifierDigest)
            return null; record.setValue("last_seen_on", input.lastSeenAt); return record.update() ? map(record) : null; },
        releaseExactLease: (input) => { const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE); return Boolean(record.get("sys_id", input.leaseSysId) && cleanText(record.getValue("workspace_key")) === input.workspaceKey && cleanText(record.getValue("holder_user")) === input.holderUserSysId && cleanText(record.getValue("verifier_digest")) === input.verifierDigest && record.deleteRecord()); }
    });
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/serviceNowWorkspaceEditLeases.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>3b2105962dcd4049bf3f4805524cdda8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/serviceNowWorkspaceEditLeases.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_3b2105962dcd4049bf3f4805524cdda8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { canonicalizeDocseraImageAttrs, validateDocseraImageAttrs } from "./serverImageContract.ts";
import { isDocseraNonDefaultTextAlignment, isDocseraPaletteKey, isDocseraTextAlignment } from "../editor/colorContract.ts";
const DOCSERA_INVALID_DOCUMENT_MESSAGE = "The stored page content does not contain a valid TipTap document.";
const DOCSERA_ALLOWED_LINK_ATTRS = ["href", "target", "rel", "class", "title"];
const DOCSERA_ALLOWED_ORDERED_LIST_TYPES = [null, "1", "a", "A", "i", "I"];
const DOCSERA_ALLOWED_LINK_PROTOCOLS = ["http", "https", "ftp", "ftps", "mailto", "tel", "callto", "sms", "cid", "xmpp"];
const DOCSERA_UNICODE_WHITESPACE_PATTERN = "[\\u0000-\\u0020\\u00A0\\u1680\\u180E\\u2000-\\u2029\\u205F\\u3000]";
const DOCSERA_UNICODE_WHITESPACE_REGEX_GLOBAL = new RegExp(DOCSERA_UNICODE_WHITESPACE_PATTERN, "g");
const DOCSERA_BLOCK_NODE_TYPES = new Set([
    "paragraph",
    "heading",
    "image",
    "bulletList",
    "orderedList",
    "listItem",
    "taskList",
    "taskItem",
    "blockquote",
    "horizontalRule",
    "codeBlock",
    "table",
    "columns",
    "column",
    "tableRow",
    "tableCell",
    "tableHeader",
    "accordion",
    "accordionItem",
    "accordionTitle",
    "accordionContent",
    "callout"
]);
const DOCSERA_INLINE_NODE_TYPES = new Set(["text", "hardBreak"]);
const DOCSERA_TITLE_INLINE_NODE_TYPES = new Set(["text"]);
const DOCSERA_DOC_CHILD_TYPES = new Set([
    "paragraph",
    "heading",
    "image",
    "bulletList",
    "orderedList",
    "taskList",
    "blockquote",
    "horizontalRule",
    "codeBlock",
    "table",
    "accordion",
    "columns",
    "callout"
]);
const DOCSERA_CALLOUT_TYPES = ["info", "warning", "success", "error"];
const DOCSERA_CALLOUT_CHILD_TYPES = new Set([
    "paragraph",
    "heading",
    "bulletList",
    "orderedList",
    "taskList",
    "blockquote",
    "horizontalRule",
    "codeBlock"
]);
const DOCSERA_NESTED_BLOCK_CHILD_TYPES = new Set([
    "paragraph",
    "heading",
    "image",
    "bulletList",
    "orderedList",
    "taskList",
    "blockquote",
    "horizontalRule",
    "codeBlock",
    "table"
]);
const DOCSERA_ACCORDION_BODY_CHILD_TYPES = new Set([...DOCSERA_NESTED_BLOCK_CHILD_TYPES, "columns", "callout"]);
const DOCSERA_COLUMN_CHILD_TYPES = new Set([...DOCSERA_NESTED_BLOCK_CHILD_TYPES, "accordion", "callout"]);
const DOCSERA_TABLE_CELL_TYPES = new Set(["tableCell", "tableHeader"]);
const DOCSERA_TABLE_CELL_ALIGNMENTS = new Set(["left", "center", "right"]);
const DOCSERA_ACCORDION_ATTRS = ["accordionId"];
const DOCSERA_ACCORDION_ITEM_ATTRS = ["accordionItemId"];
const DOCSERA_CALLOUT_ATTRS = ["type", "title"];
export const DOCSERA_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;
export const DOCSERA_BODY_HEADING_LEVELS = [1, 2, 3];
export const SERVER_DOCSERA_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = DOCSERA_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION;
export function createEmptyDocseraDocumentEnvelope() {
    return {
        schemaVersion: DOCSERA_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        document: {
            type: "doc",
            content: [{ type: "paragraph" }]
        }
    };
}
export function createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope() {
    return createEmptyDocseraDocumentEnvelope();
}
function createValidationFailure(message = DOCSERA_INVALID_DOCUMENT_MESSAGE) {
    return {
        ok: false,
        message
    };
}
function createAccordionValidationContext() {
    return {
        accordionIds: new Set(),
        accordionItemIds: new Set()
    };
}
function createParseFailure(reason, message) {
    return {
        ok: false,
        reason,
        message
    };
}
function isRecord(value) {
    return Boolean(value) && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function hasOnlyAllowedKeys(value, allowedKeys) {
    return Object.keys(value).every((key) => allowedKeys.includes(key));
}
function normalizeStableIdentity(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function isNullableString(value) {
    return value === null || typeof value === "string";
}
function isDocseraTableCellAlignment(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" && DOCSERA_TABLE_CELL_ALIGNMENTS.has(value);
}
function isDocseraCalloutType(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" && DOCSERA_CALLOUT_TYPES.includes(value);
}
function isValidCalloutTitle(value) {
    return value === null || (typeof value === "string" && !/[\r\n]/.test(value));
}
function validateTextAlignAttrs(attrs, allowedKeys) {
    if (!hasOnlyAllowedKeys(attrs, allowedKeys)) {
        return false;
    }
    return attrs.textAlign === undefined || isDocseraTextAlignment(attrs.textAlign);
}
function hasSchemaVersion(value) {
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, "schemaVersion");
}
function isAllowedDocumentNodeType(type) {
    return type === "doc" || DOCSERA_BLOCK_NODE_TYPES.has(type) || DOCSERA_INLINE_NODE_TYPES.has(type);
}
function isAllowedMarkType(type) {
    return (type === "link" ||
        type === "bold" ||
        type === "italic" ||
        type === "strike" ||
        type === "code" ||
        type === "underline" ||
        type === "highlight" ||
        type === "textColor" ||
        type === "highlightColor" ||
        type === "superscript" ||
        type === "subscript");

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { loadWorkspaceBySlug, listWorkspacePages } from "./serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { buildPageBodySaveRecord, buildPageContentSaveRecord, savePageDraftRecord } from "./serviceNowPagePersistence.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function isObjectLike(value) {
    return Boolean(value) && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function logUnexpectedPageSaveError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page save failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page save] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return Promise.resolve(mapWorkspaceRecord(record));
}
function findPageByReference(pages, reference) {
    const pageSysId = cleanText(reference.pageSysId);
    const pageSlug = cleanText(reference.pageSlug).toLowerCase();
    if (pageSysId) {
        const page = pages.find((candidate) => cleanText(candidate.sysId) === pageSysId) ?? null;
        if (!page) {
            return null;
        }
        if (pageSlug && cleanText(page.draftSlugNormalized || page.draftSlug).toLowerCase() !== pageSlug) {
            return null;
        }
        return page;
    }
    if (!pageSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    return (pages.find((candidate) => {
        const candidateSlug = cleanText(candidate.draftSlugNormalized || candidate.draftSlug).toLowerCase();
        return candidateSlug === pageSlug;
    }) ?? null);
}
export function createPageBodySaveService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async savePageBody(input) {
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
            const pageSysId = cleanText(input.pageSysId);
            const pageSlug = cleanText(input.pageSlug);
            if (!workspaceSlug && !workspaceSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (!pageSysId && !pageSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A page reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const workspace = workspaceSysId && typeof dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId === "function"
                ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId)
                : workspaceSlug
                    ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug)
                    : null;
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (workspaceSlug && workspace.slug !== workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (!capability.canEditWorkspace && !capability.canAdminWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to edit page bodies in this workspace."
                };
            }
            const pages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId);
            const page = findPageByReference(pages, input);
            if (!page) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (cleanText(page.workspaceSysId) !== workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found in this workspace.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (pageSysId && cleanText(page.sysId) !== pageSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found in this workspace.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const currentRevision = Number.isSafeInteger(Number(page.draftRevision)) ? Number(page.draftRevision) : 0;
            const expectedRevision = input.expectedRevision;
            if (typeof expectedRevision !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedRevision) || expectedRevision < 0) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A non-negative expected draft revision is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (expectedRevision !== currentRevision) {
                return {
                    kind: "conflict",
                    currentRevision,
                    errorMessage: "This page has a newer saved draft. Reload before saving again."
                };
            }
            let nextPage;
            try {
                if (input.draftContentJson !== undefined) {
                    if (!isObjectLike(input.draftContentJson)) {
                        return {
                            kind: "failed",
                            errorMessage: "The stored page content does not use a supported document envelope.",
                            status: 400
                        };
                    }
                    nextPage = buildPageContentSaveRecord(page, input.draftContentJson, currentRevision + 1);
                }
                else {
                    nextPage = buildPageBodySaveRecord(page, input.draftBodyText ?? "", currentRevision + 1);
                }
            }
            catch (error) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "The page document is invalid.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const savedPage = await dependencies.savePageDraft(nextPage, expectedRevision);
            if (!savedPage) {
                return {
                    kind: "conflict",
                    currentRevision,
                    errorMessage: "This page has a newer saved draft. Reload before saving again."
                };
            }
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                page: savedPage
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowPageBodySaveService() {
    const service = createPageBodySaveService({
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        loadWorkspaceBySysId,
        listWorkspacePages,
        savePageDraft: savePageDraftRecord
    });
    return {
        async savePageBody(input) {
            return service.savePageBody(input);
        }
    };
}

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_68708b12da0143bca9c08b057e79f910
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { createPageDraft } from "./serverPageDomain.ts";
import { listWorkspacePages, loadWorkspaceBySlug } from "./serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { savePageRecord } from "./serviceNowPagePersistence.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedPageCreationError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page creation failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page creation] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
export function createPageCreationService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async createPage(input) {
            const title = cleanText(input.title);
            if (!title) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page title is required."
                };
            }
            if (title.length > 160) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page title must be 160 characters or fewer."
                };
            }
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            if (!workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required."
                };
            }
            const workspace = await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug);
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found."
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (!capability.canEditWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to create pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            const retainedPages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId);
            const parentPageSysId = cleanText(input.parentPageSysId);
            const parentPage = parentPageSysId ? retainedPages.find((page) => page.sysId === parentPageSysId) ?? null : null;
            if (parentPageSysId && !parentPage) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A valid parent page is required."
                };
            }
            if (parentPage && parentPage.workspaceSysId !== workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A parent page must belong to the same workspace."
                };
            }
            const draft = createPageDraft({
                title,
                workspaceSysId: workspace.sysId,
                parentPageSysId: parentPage?.sysId ?? null,
                parentPageWorkspaceSysId: parentPage?.workspaceSysId ?? null,
                active: true
            }, retainedPages);
            const savedPage = await dependencies.savePage(draft);
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                page: savedPage
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowPageCreationService() {
    const service = createPageCreationService({
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        listWorkspacePages,
        savePage: savePageRecord
    });
    return {
        async createPage(input) {
            return service.createPage(input);
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageCreation.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>68708b12da0143bca9c08b057e79f910</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageCreation.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_68708b12da0143bca9c08b057e79f910</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

    margin: 0;
    color: var(--docsera-editor-muted);
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

IMAGE_OPTIONS_STYLES=`
  .docsera-image-preview-group,
  .docsera-image-controls-group {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    box-shadow: var(--docsera-shadow);
    z-index: 5;
  }

  .docsera-image-preview-group--active,
  .docsera-image-controls-group--active {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 22%, var(--docsera-border));
    box-shadow: var(--docsera-shadow);
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button,
  .docsera-image-options-trigger {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    box-shadow: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      background-color 0.16s ease,
      color 0.16s ease,
      box-shadow 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button--selected {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 12%, var(--docsera-surface));
    color: var(--docsera-primary);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 24%, var(--docsera-border));
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button:hover:not(:disabled),
  .docsera-image-controls-button:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-options-trigger:hover,
  .docsera-image-options-trigger:focus-visible {
    background: var(--docsera-surface-muted);
    color: var(--docsera-primary);
    outline: none;
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-options-trigger:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 18%, white 20%);
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button[aria-disabled="true"] {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .docsera-image-controls-button svg,
  .docsera-image-options-trigger svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-group {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 6;
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-handle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: transparent;
    color: transparent;
    box-shadow: none;
    cursor: col-resize;
    outline: none;
    pointer-events: auto;
    z-index: 6;
    transition: background-color 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-handle::before {
    content: "";
    display: block;
    width: 2px;
    height: calc(100% - 8px);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 68%, var(--docsera-border));
    opacity: 0.5;
    transition: opacity 0.16s ease, background-color 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-handle:hover::before,
  .docsera-image-resize-handle:focus-visible::before {
    opacity: 1;
    background: var(--docsera-primary);
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-handle--left {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .docsera-image-resize-handle--right {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: grid;
    gap: 4px;
    min-width: 0;
    width: 192px;
    padding: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    box-shadow: var(--docsera-shadow);
    z-index: 7;
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu--active {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 22%, var(--docsera-border));
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      background-color 0.16s ease,
      color 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item:hover,
  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item--active {
    background: var(--docsera-surface-muted);
    color: var(--docsera-primary);
    outline: none;
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item--selected {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 12%, var(--docsera-surface));
    color: var(--docsera-primary);
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .docsera-image-alignment-menu__item span {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel {
    display: grid;
    min-width: 0;
    width: min(372px, calc(100vw - 24px));
    max-width: min(372px, calc(100vw - 24px));
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--docsera-shadow);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 14px 10px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__header-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--docsera-border);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__title {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font-size: 0.98rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px 14px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-field {
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-value {
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 34px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.25;
    box-shadow: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-value--unset,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-value--pending,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__media-value--unavailable {
    color: var(--docsera-text-muted);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.2;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      background-color 0.16s ease,
      border-color 0.16s ease,
      color 0.16s ease,
      box-shadow 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button:hover:not(:disabled),
  .docsera-image-options-panel__button:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__chip:hover:not(:disabled),
  .docsera-image-options-panel__chip:focus-visible {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 24%, var(--docsera-border));
    background: var(--docsera-surface-muted);
    color: var(--docsera-primary);
    outline: none;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__chip:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 18%, white 20%);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--destructive {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 18%, var(--docsera-border));
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 10%, var(--docsera-surface));
    color: var(--docsera-error);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--destructive:hover:not(:disabled),
  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--destructive:focus-visible {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 28%, var(--docsera-border));
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 14%, var(--docsera-surface));
    color: var(--docsera-error);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--destructive:focus-visible,
  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--primary:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 32%, transparent);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--primary {
    border-color: var(--docsera-primary);
    background: var(--docsera-primary);
    color: white;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--primary:hover:not(:disabled),
  .docsera-image-options-panel__button--primary:focus-visible {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 86%, var(--docsera-surface) 14%);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-primary) 88%, var(--docsera-surface) 12%);
    color: white;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__field-label {
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.25;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__input {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 34px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--docsera-surface);
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.25;
    transition:
      border-color 0.16s ease,
      box-shadow 0.16s ease;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__input:focus {
    border-color: var(--docsera-primary);
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: var(--docsera-text);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__toggle input {
    margin: 0;
    accent-color: var(--docsera-primary);
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0 14px 14px;
  }

  .docsera-image-options-panel__footer-actions {

    width: 100%;

  .docsera-image-options-panel__footer-actions > .docsera-image-options-panel__button {

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button svg {

    gap: 6px;

  .docsera-image-options-panel__button-label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 126;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill {
    position: fixed;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    appearance: none;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-editor-panel-border);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel) 94%, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 6%);
    color: var(--docsera-editor-muted);
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-text) 10%, transparent),
      0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel-border) 58%, transparent);
    will-change: width, height, opacity;
    transition:
      width 140ms ease,
      height 140ms ease,
      opacity 140ms ease,
      border-color 140ms ease,
      background-color 140ms ease,
      box-shadow 140ms ease;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="row"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    width: 8px;
    height: 18px;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="row"][data-docsera-table-handle-expanded="true"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="row"]:hover .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="row"]:focus-visible .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    height: 28px;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="column"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    width: 18px;
    height: 8px;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="column"][data-docsera-table-handle-expanded="true"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="column"]:hover .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-kind="column"]:focus-visible .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    width: 28px;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-accented="false"][data-docsera-table-handle-expanded="true"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-accented="false"]:hover .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-accented="false"]:focus-visible .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell {
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-text) 10%, transparent),
      0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-table-control-primary) 28%, transparent);
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-icon {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 110ms ease;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill[data-docsera-table-handle-expanded="true"] .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-icon,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill:hover .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-icon,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill:focus-visible .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-icon {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 1px solid var(--docsera-editor-panel-border);
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel) 94%, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 6%);
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-text) 10%, transparent),
      0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel-border) 58%, transparent);
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--docsera-editor-muted);
    transition:
      background-color 120ms ease,
      color 120ms ease;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button:hover,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button:focus-visible {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel) 84%, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 16%);
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--docsera-editor-muted);
    transition: color 120ms ease;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button:hover .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-icon,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button:focus-visible .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-icon {
    color: var(--docsera-table-control-primary);
  }

  html[data-docsera-table-rail-cursor-lock="row"],
  html[data-docsera-table-rail-cursor-lock="row"] * {
    cursor: row-resize !important;
  }

  html[data-docsera-table-rail-cursor-lock="column"],
  html[data-docsera-table-rail-cursor-lock="column"] * {
    cursor: col-resize !important;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: auto;
    z-index: 130;
    max-width: min(256px, calc(100vw - 24px));
    max-height: min(320px, calc(100vh - 24px));
    overflow: auto;
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu-item--destructive,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu-item--destructive:hover,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu-item--destructive:focus-visible {
    color: var(--docsera-error);
  }

  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu-item--destructive:hover,
  .docsera-table-controls-overlay__menu-item--destructive:focus-visible {
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 20%, var(--docsera-border));
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-error) 10%, var(--docsera-surface));
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-shell,
    .docsera-table-controls-overlay__pill-icon,
    .docsera-table-controls-overlay__rail-button {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
