        .docsera-editor-runtime {
          display: block;
          color: var(--docsera-editor-text);
          font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime--light {
          --docsera-editor-muted: #5f6b7c;
          --docsera-editor-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
          --docsera-editor-panel-border: rgba(140, 156, 178, 0.22);
          --docsera-editor-text: #16212f;
          --docsera-editor-primary: #015ec2;
          --docsera-table-control-primary: #4648D4;
          --docsera-table-control-active-icon: var(--docsera-editor-panel);
          --docsera-editor-block-selection: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 7%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-gray-text: #475569;
          --docsera-palette-red-text: #b42318;
          --docsera-palette-orange-text: #b54708;
          --docsera-palette-yellow-text: #8a6100;
          --docsera-palette-green-text: #067647;
          --docsera-palette-blue-text: #175cd3;
          --docsera-palette-purple-text: #6941c6;
          --docsera-palette-pink-text: #c11574;
          --docsera-palette-gray-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #cbd5e1 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-red-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #fda29b 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-orange-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #fdba74 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-yellow-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #fde68a 58%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-green-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #86efac 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-blue-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #93c5fd 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-purple-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #c4b5fd 48%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-pink-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #f9a8d4 48%, transparent);
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime--dark {
          --docsera-editor-muted: #a7b3c5;
          --docsera-editor-panel: rgba(15, 18, 24, 0.98);
          --docsera-editor-panel-border: rgba(122, 139, 167, 0.22);
          --docsera-editor-text: #eef2f8;
          --docsera-editor-primary: #58a6ff;
          --docsera-table-control-primary: #7C83FA;
          --docsera-table-control-active-icon: #ffffff;
          --docsera-editor-block-selection: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 12%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-gray-text: #cbd5e1;
          --docsera-palette-red-text: #fda29b;
          --docsera-palette-orange-text: #fdba74;
          --docsera-palette-yellow-text: #fde68a;
          --docsera-palette-green-text: #86efac;
          --docsera-palette-blue-text: #93c5fd;
          --docsera-palette-purple-text: #c4b5fd;
          --docsera-palette-pink-text: #f9a8d4;
          --docsera-palette-gray-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #94a3b8 34%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-red-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #b42318 46%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-orange-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #b54708 46%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-yellow-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #8a6100 52%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-green-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #067647 46%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-blue-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #175cd3 46%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-purple-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #6941c6 46%, transparent);
          --docsera-palette-pink-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, #c11574 46%, transparent);
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__surface {
          position: relative;
          width: 100%;
          min-width: 0;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__surface--block-dragging,
        .docsera-editor-runtime__surface--block-dragging *,
        .docsera-editor-overlay-root--block-dragging,
        .docsera-editor-overlay-root--block-dragging * {
          cursor: grabbing !important;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-banner {
          display: grid;
          gap: 0.45rem;
          margin: 0 0 1rem;
          padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
          border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 18%, var(--docsera-editor-panel-border));
          border-radius: 1rem;
          background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel) 94%, transparent);
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-banner[data-state="lost"],
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-banner[data-state="failed"] {
          border-color: rgba(186, 26, 26, 0.22);
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-title {
          margin: 0;
          font-size: 0.82rem;
          font-weight: 700;
          letter-spacing: 0.06em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
          color: var(--docsera-editor-muted);
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-copy {
          margin: 0;
          color: var(--docsera-editor-text);
          font-size: 0.94rem;
          line-height: 1.55;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-actions {
          display: flex;
          gap: 0.75rem;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-action,
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-secondary {
          min-height: 2.4rem;
          padding: 0.65rem 0.95rem;
          border-radius: 0.9rem;
          border: 1px solid var(--docsera-editor-panel-border);
          background: var(--docsera-editor-panel);
          color: var(--docsera-editor-text);
          font: inherit;
          font-weight: 700;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-action {
          border-color: rgba(1, 94, 194, 0.26);
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--docsera-editor-primary), #004fa8);
          color: #fff;
        }
        .docsera-editor-runtime__lock-progress {
          position: absolute;

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, GlideSysAttachment, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "../api/docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function safeInteger(value) {
    const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? Number(value) : Number.NaN;
    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : null;
}
function normalizeContentType(value) {
    return cleanText(value).split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}
function isSupportedMediaContentType(value) {
    const contentType = normalizeContentType(value);
    return contentType === "image/jpeg" || contentType === "image/png" || contentType === "image/webp" || contentType === "image/gif";
}
function contentTypeForExtension(extension) {
    switch (extension.toLowerCase()) {
        case "jpg":
        case "jpeg":
            return "image/jpeg";
        case "png":
            return "image/png";
        case "webp":
            return "image/webp";
        case "gif":
            return "image/gif";
        default:
            return null;
    }
}
function splitSupportedMediaFileName(fileName) {
    const candidate = cleanText(fileName);
    if (!candidate || candidate.includes("/") || candidate.includes("\\") || candidate.includes("..")) {
        return null;
    }
    const lastDot = candidate.lastIndexOf(".");
    if (lastDot <= 0 || lastDot === candidate.length - 1) {
        return null;
    }
    const baseName = candidate.slice(0, lastDot);
    const extension = candidate.slice(lastDot + 1);
    if (!baseName || baseName.includes("/") || baseName.includes("\\") || baseName.includes("..")) {
        return null;
    }
    return {
        baseName,
        extension
    };
}
function isSupportedMediaPair(fileName, contentType) {
    const split = splitSupportedMediaFileName(fileName);
    if (!split) {
        return false;
    }
    const supportedContentType = contentTypeForExtension(split.extension);
    return Boolean(supportedContentType) && normalizeContentType(contentType) === supportedContentType;
}
function compareMediaDescriptors(left, right) {
    const updatedComparison = cleanText(right.updatedOn).localeCompare(cleanText(left.updatedOn));
    if (updatedComparison !== 0) {
        return updatedComparison;
    }
    const createdComparison = cleanText(right.createdOn).localeCompare(cleanText(left.createdOn));
    if (createdComparison !== 0) {
        return createdComparison;
    }
    return cleanText(left.mediaId).localeCompare(cleanText(right.mediaId));
}
function toMediaDescriptor(record) {
    if (!isSupportedMediaPair(record.fileName, record.contentType)) {
        return null;
    }
    const supportedContentType = normalizeContentType(record.contentType);
    if (!isSupportedMediaContentType(supportedContentType)) {
        return null;
    }
    return {
        mediaId: cleanText(record.mediaId),
        fileName: cleanText(record.fileName),
        contentType: supportedContentType,
        sizeBytes: safeInteger(record.sizeBytes) ?? 0,
        createdOn: cleanText(record.createdOn),
        updatedOn: cleanText(record.updatedOn)
    };
}
function toFailure(status, errorMessage) {
    return {
        kind: "failed",
        status,
        errorMessage
    };
}
function isWorkspaceMediaLeaseHeld(result) {
    return result.kind === "held";
}
function buildAttachmentFilenameCollisionSet(records) {
    const names = new Set();
    for (const record of records) {
        const fileName = cleanText(record.fileName);
        if (fileName) {
            names.add(fileName);
        }
    }
    return names;
}
function allocateCollisionSafeFileName(fileName, existingFileNames) {
    const candidate = cleanText(fileName);
    if (!existingFileNames.has(candidate)) {
        return candidate;
    }
    const split = splitSupportedMediaFileName(candidate);
    if (!split) {
        return candidate;
    }
    let suffix = 1;
    while (existingFileNames.has(`${split.baseName}-${suffix}.${split.extension}`)) {
        suffix += 1;
    }
    return `${split.baseName}-${suffix}.${split.extension}`;
}
function createDefaultDependencies() {
    return {
        deleteAttachment(mediaId) {
            if (!cleanText(mediaId)) {
                return;
            }
            new GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment(mediaId);
        },
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        getAttachmentBySysId(mediaId) {
            const attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
            if (!attachment.get("sys_id", cleanText(mediaId))) {
                return null;
            }
            return {
                contentType: normalizeContentType(attachment.getValue("content_type")),
                createdOn: cleanText(attachment.getValue("sys_created_on")) || cleanText(attachment.getDisplayValue("sys_created_on")),
                fileName: cleanText(attachment.getValue("file_name")),
                mediaId: cleanText(attachment.getUniqueValue()),
                sizeBytes: safeInteger(attachment.getValue("size_bytes")) ?? 0,
                tableName: cleanText(attachment.getValue("table_name")),
                tableSysId: cleanText(attachment.getValue("table_sys_id")),
                updatedOn: cleanText(attachment.getValue("sys_updated_on")) || cleanText(attachment.getDisplayValue("sys_updated_on"))
            };
        },
        getAttachmentContentStream(mediaId) {
            return new GlideSysAttachment().getContentStream(cleanText(mediaId));
        },
        listWorkspaceAttachments(workspaceSysId) {
            const rows = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
            rows.addQuery("table_name", DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
            rows.addQuery("table_sys_id", cleanText(workspaceSysId));
            rows.query();
            const attachments = [];
            while (rows.next()) {
                attachments.push({
                    contentType: normalizeContentType(rows.getValue("content_type")),
                    createdOn: cleanText(rows.getValue("sys_created_on")) || cleanText(rows.getDisplayValue("sys_created_on")),
                    fileName: cleanText(rows.getValue("file_name")),
                    mediaId: cleanText(rows.getUniqueValue()),
                    sizeBytes: safeInteger(rows.getValue("size_bytes")) ?? 0,
                    tableName: cleanText(rows.getValue("table_name")),
                    tableSysId: cleanText(rows.getValue("table_sys_id")),
                    updatedOn: cleanText(rows.getValue("sys_updated_on")) || cleanText(rows.getDisplayValue("sys_updated_on"))
                });
            }
            return attachments;
        },
        loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
            const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
            if (!row.get("sys_id", cleanText(workspaceSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            return mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        },
        maxUploadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
        verifyWorkspaceEditLease,
        writeAttachmentToWorkspace(input) {
            const workspace = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
            if (!workspace.get("sys_id", cleanText(input.workspaceSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            const attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();

export function createWorkspaceMediaService(dependencies) {

        if (!cleanWorkspaceSysId) {

        }
        const workspace = dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(cleanWorkspaceSysId);
        if (!workspace || !cleanText(workspace.sysId)) {

        return workspace;

        return null;

            .filter((item) => Boolean(item))

        return items;

    function loadAttachmentOrFailure(workspaceSysId, mediaId) {

        }

            return toFailure(404, "Media could not be found.");
        }
        return attachment;
    }
    function cleanupCreatedAttachment(mediaId) {
        const cleanMediaId = cleanText(mediaId);
        if (!cleanMediaId) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            dependencies.deleteAttachment(cleanMediaId);
        }
        catch (error) {

        async uploadWorkspaceMedia(input) {
            const workspaceResult = loadWorkspaceOrFailure(input.workspaceSysId);
            if ("kind" in workspaceResult) {
                return workspaceResult;
            }
            const accessFailure = validateAuthoringAccess(workspaceResult);
            if (accessFailure) {
                return accessFailure;
            }
            const lease = await dependencies.verifyWorkspaceEditLease({
                workspaceLeaseToken: cleanText(input.workspaceLeaseToken),
                workspaceSlug: cleanText(workspaceResult.slug),
                workspaceSysId: cleanText(workspaceResult.sysId)
            });
            if (!isWorkspaceMediaLeaseHeld(lease)) {
                return toFailure(403, "A valid workspace edit lease is required to upload media.");
            }
            if (input.dataStream === undefined || input.dataStream === null) {
                return toFailure(400, "The upload body cannot be empty.");
            }
            const fileName = cleanText(input.fileName);
            if (!fileName) {
                return toFailure(400, "A file name is required.");
            }
            if (fileName.includes("/") || fileName.includes("\\") || fileName.includes("..")) {
                return toFailure(400, "The file name cannot include a path or traversal intent.");
            }
            const fileNameParts = splitSupportedMediaFileName(fileName);
            if (!fileNameParts) {
                return toFailure(415, "The file name must include a supported image extension.");
            }
            const expectedContentType = contentTypeForExtension(fileNameParts.extension);
            if (!expectedContentType) {
                return toFailure(415, "The file name must include a supported image extension.");
            }
            const requestContentType = normalizeContentType(input.contentType);
            if (!isSupportedMediaContentType(requestContentType)) {

            const descriptor = toMediaDescriptor({
                ...attachment,

            if (!descriptor) {

            }
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                media: descriptor
            };
        },
        async getWorkspaceMediaFile(input) {
            const workspaceResult = loadWorkspaceOrFailure(input.workspaceSysId);
            if ("kind" in workspaceResult) {
                return workspaceResult;
            }
            const accessFailure = validateViewingAccess(workspaceResult);
            if (accessFailure) {
                return accessFailure;
            }
            const attachmentResult = loadAttachmentOrFailure(cleanText(input.workspaceSysId), input.mediaId);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function summarizeRequestBody(body) {
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const pageSysId = cleanText(body.pageSysId);
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, pageSysIdPresent: Boolean(pageSysId), pageSysIdLength: pageSysId.length };
}
function logUnexpectedPageDeleteError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page delete failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page delete] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    if (!row.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response))
            return;
        if (lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority)
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = service.deletePage({
            authority,
            pageSysId: cleanText(body.pageSysId),
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "recovery_required"
                            ? "recovery_required"
                            : result.code === "unsupported"
                                ? "unsupported"
                                : "invalid",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? {
                            currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision
                        }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                deletedPageSysId: result.result.deletedPageSysId,
                nextPageSysId: result.result.nextPageSysId,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedPageDeleteError(error, {
            ...summarizeRequestBody(readRequestBody(request))
        });
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Something went wrong while deleting the page. The page was not deleted. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-delete-action.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>b76550354fdb4dcaaeabc6a2671e97f4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-delete-action.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_b76550354fdb4dcaaeabc6a2671e97f4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[export const DOCSERA_IMAGE_ALIGNMENTS = ["left", "center", "right"];
const DOCSERA_IMAGE_ALLOWED_ATTR_KEYS = [
    "mediaId",
    "darkMediaId",
    "alt",
    "caption",
    "frame",
    "align",
    "widthPct"
];
export const DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS = {
    darkMediaId: null,
    alt: "",
    caption: "",
    frame: true,
    align: "left",
    widthPct: 100
};
function isRecord(value) {
    return Boolean(value) && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function hasOnlyAllowedKeys(value, allowedKeys) {
    return Object.keys(value).every((key) => allowedKeys.includes(key));
}
function isDocseraImageAlignment(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" && DOCSERA_IMAGE_ALIGNMENTS.includes(value);
}
function normalizeMediaId(value) {
    if (typeof value !== "string") {
        return null;
    }
    const normalized = value.trim();
    return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : null;
}
function normalizeWidthPct(value) {
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
        return null;
    }
    return Math.min(100, Math.max(20, value));
}
function createImageValidationFailure() {
    return false;
}
export function validateDocseraImageAttrs(attrs) {
    if (!isRecord(attrs) || !hasOnlyAllowedKeys(attrs, DOCSERA_IMAGE_ALLOWED_ATTR_KEYS)) {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (normalizeMediaId(attrs.mediaId) === null) {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.darkMediaId !== undefined && attrs.darkMediaId !== null && normalizeMediaId(attrs.darkMediaId) === null) {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.alt !== undefined && typeof attrs.alt !== "string") {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.caption !== undefined && typeof attrs.caption !== "string") {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.frame !== undefined && typeof attrs.frame !== "boolean") {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.align !== undefined && !isDocseraImageAlignment(attrs.align)) {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    if (attrs.widthPct !== undefined && normalizeWidthPct(attrs.widthPct) === null) {
        return createImageValidationFailure();
    }
    return true;
}
export function canonicalizeDocseraImageAttrs(attrs) {
    if (!validateDocseraImageAttrs(attrs)) {
        throw new TypeError("The published page content contains an invalid image.");
    }
    const imageAttrs = isRecord(attrs) ? attrs : {};
    const mediaId = normalizeMediaId(imageAttrs.mediaId);
    const darkMediaId = imageAttrs.darkMediaId === undefined || imageAttrs.darkMediaId === null ? null : normalizeMediaId(imageAttrs.darkMediaId);
    const widthPct = imageAttrs.widthPct === undefined ? DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS.widthPct : normalizeWidthPct(imageAttrs.widthPct);
    if (mediaId === null || widthPct === null) {
        throw new TypeError("The published page content contains an invalid image.");
    }
    return {
        mediaId,
        darkMediaId,
        alt: typeof imageAttrs.alt === "string" ? imageAttrs.alt : DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS.alt,
        caption: typeof imageAttrs.caption === "string" ? imageAttrs.caption : DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS.caption,
        frame: typeof imageAttrs.frame === "boolean" ? imageAttrs.frame : DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS.frame,
        align: isDocseraImageAlignment(imageAttrs.align) ? imageAttrs.align : DOCSERA_IMAGE_DEFAULTS.align,
        widthPct
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serverImageContract.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>daaaddaa636e46ba8f9000a9bd3595c5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serverImageContract.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_daaaddaa636e46ba8f9000a9bd3595c5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[(function () {
    var TABLE = 'x_2300756_docsera_workspace_icon_asset';
    var RETENTION_SECONDS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;
    var BATCH_SIZE = 50;
    var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
    cutoff.addSeconds(-RETENTION_SECONDS);

    var processed = 0;

    function cleanCandidates(candidates) {
        while (processed < BATCH_SIZE && candidates.next()) {
            processed++;
            try {
                var id = String(candidates.getUniqueValue() || '');
                var attachmentId = String(candidates.getValue('attachment') || '');
                var state = String(candidates.getValue('state') || '');
                if (!id || !attachmentId) continue;
                if (state === 'staged') {
                    var claim = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                    claim.addQuery('sys_id', id);
                    claim.addQuery('state', 'staged');
                    claim.addQuery('provision_request', '');
                    claim.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<', cutoff.getValue());
                    claim.setValue('state', 'cleaning');
                    claim.updateMultiple();
                }
                var asset = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                if (!asset.get('sys_id', id) || String(asset.getValue('state') || '') !== 'cleaning' || String(asset.getValue('provision_request') || '')) continue;
                var attachment = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
                if (attachment.get('sys_id', attachmentId)) {
                    if (String(attachment.getValue('table_name') || '') !== TABLE || String(attachment.getValue('table_sys_id') || '') !== id) continue;
                    new GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment(attachmentId);
                }
                var absent = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
                if (absent.get('sys_id', attachmentId)) continue;
                var remove = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                remove.addQuery('sys_id', id);
                remove.addQuery('state', 'cleaning');
                remove.addQuery('attachment', attachmentId);
                remove.deleteMultiple();
            } catch (error) {
                gs.warn('Docsera workspace icon cleanup deferred one asset: ' + error);
            }
        }
    }

    // Retry interrupted durable claims first; their age does not affect eligibility.
    var cleaningCandidates = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
    cleaningCandidates.addQuery('state', 'cleaning');
    cleaningCandidates.addQuery('provision_request', '');
    cleaningCandidates.orderBy('sys_updated_on');
    cleaningCandidates.setLimit(BATCH_SIZE);
    cleaningCandidates.query();
    cleanCandidates(cleaningCandidates);

    // Apply staged-upload retention before limiting the remaining batch capacity.
    if (processed < BATCH_SIZE) {
        var stagedCandidates = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('state', 'staged');
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('provision_request', '');
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<', cutoff.getValue());
        stagedCandidates.orderBy('sys_updated_on');
        stagedCandidates.setLimit(BATCH_SIZE - processed);
        stagedCandidates.query();
        cleanCandidates(stagedCandidates);
    }
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/scheduled-scripts/docsera-workspace-icon-cleanup.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>06e970428b874994a6859d33cf8734be</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/scheduled-scripts/docsera-workspace-icon-cleanup.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_06e970428b874994a6859d33cf8734be</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_f7e2d7cf40ab498fbd3e1087ac04aa04
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { validatePageSettingsSlug, validatePageSettingsTitle } from "../pages/serverPageDomain.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function summarizeRequestBody(body) {
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const pageSysId = cleanText(body.pageSysId);
    const title = cleanText(body.title);
    const slug = cleanText(body.slug);
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, pageSysIdPresent: Boolean(pageSysId), pageSysIdLength: pageSysId.length, titlePresent: Boolean(title), titleLength: title.length, slugPresent: Boolean(slug), slugLength: slug.length };
}
function logUnexpectedPageSettingsError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page settings failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page settings] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    if (!row.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response))
            return;
        if (lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority)
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const projection = service.listPages(workspace, "edit");
        if (projection.kind !== "succeeded") {
            response.setStatus?.(projection.status);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: projection.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        const titleValidation = validatePageSettingsTitle(body.title);
        if (!titleValidation.valid) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: titleValidation.error } });
            return;
        }
        const slugValidation = validatePageSettingsSlug(body.slug, projection.pages, cleanText(workspace.sysId), cleanText(body.pageSysId));
        if (!slugValidation.valid) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: slugValidation.error } });
            return;
        }
        const result = service.savePageSettings({
            authority,
            pageSysId: cleanText(body.pageSysId),
            title: titleValidation.value,
            slug: slugValidation.normalizedValue,
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "recovery_required"
                            ? "recovery_required"
                            : "invalid",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? {
                            currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision
                        }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                page: result.result.page,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedPageSettingsError(error, {
            ...summarizeRequestBody(readRequestBody(request))
        });
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Something went wrong while saving page settings. Your changes were not saved. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-settings-save.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>f7e2d7cf40ab498fbd3e1087ac04aa04</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-settings-save.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_f7e2d7cf40ab498fbd3e1087ac04aa04</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, GlideSysAttachment, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { validateWorkspaceIconImage } from "./serverWorkspaceIconImage.ts";
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_icon_asset";
export const WORKSPACE_ICON_FILE_ROUTE_PATH = "/api/x_2300756_docsera/docsera_runtime/workspaces/icons/file";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function normalizeState(value) {
    const state = cleanText(value);
    return state === "claimed" || state === "cleaning" || state === "invalid" ? state : "staged";
}
function safeInteger(value) {
    const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? Number(value) : Number.NaN;
    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : null;
}
function toFailure(status, errorMessage) {
    return { errorMessage, kind: "failed", status };
}
function decodeBase64(value) {
    const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    const clean = value.replace(/\s+/g, "");
    const bytes = [];
    for (let offset = 0; offset < clean.length; offset += 4) {
        const chunk = clean.slice(offset, offset + 4);
        const values = chunk.split("").map((character) => (character === "=" ? 0 : alphabet.indexOf(character)));
        if (values.some((item) => item < 0)) {
            return new Uint8Array();
        }
        const triplet = (values[0] << 18) | (values[1] << 12) | (values[2] << 6) | values[3];
        bytes.push((triplet >> 16) & 0xff);
        if (chunk[2] !== "=") {
            bytes.push((triplet >> 8) & 0xff);
        }
        if (chunk[3] !== "=") {
            bytes.push(triplet & 0xff);
        }
    }
    return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}
function assetFileUrl(assetKey) {
    return `${WORKSPACE_ICON_FILE_ROUTE_PATH}?assetKey=${encodeURIComponent(assetKey)}`;
}
function createOpaqueAssetKey(dependencies) {
    const glideSystem = gs;
    const generated = cleanText(glideSystem?.generateGUID?.()).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "");
    const suffix = generated || `${Date.now()}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}`;
    return `wsi_${cleanText(dependencies.getCurrentUserSysId()).slice(0, 8)}_${suffix}`;
}
function mapAsset(record) {
    const contentType = cleanText(record.getValue("content_type"));
    return {
        assetKey: cleanText(record.getValue("asset_key")),
        attachmentSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("attachment")),
        contentType: contentType === "image/png" || contentType === "image/webp" ? contentType : "image/jpeg",
        fileName: cleanText(record.getValue("file_name")),
        format: contentType === "image/png" ? "png" : contentType === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpeg",
        height: safeInteger(record.getValue("height")) ?? 0,
        requestedBy: cleanText(record.getValue("requested_by")),
        sizeBytes: safeInteger(record.getValue("size_bytes")) ?? 0,
        state: normalizeState(record.getValue("state")),
        sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
        width: safeInteger(record.getValue("width")) ?? 0,
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace")),
        provisionRequestSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("provision_request"))
    };
}
function createDefaultDependencies() {
    return {
        canCreateWorkspaces: () => gs.hasRole("x_2300756_docsera.admin"),
        createAsset(input) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.initialize();
            record.setValue("asset_key", input.assetKey);
            record.setValue("state", "staged");
            record.setValue("requested_by", input.requestedBy);
            return cleanText(record.insert());
        },
        deleteAsset(assetSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            if (record.get("sys_id", cleanText(assetSysId))) {
                record.deleteRecord();
            }
        },
        deleteAttachment(attachmentSysId) {
            new GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment(cleanText(attachmentSysId));
        },
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        getAttachmentBySysId(attachmentSysId) {
            const attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
            if (!attachment.get("sys_id", cleanText(attachmentSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            return {
                contentType: cleanText(attachment.getValue("content_type")).split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase(),
                fileName: cleanText(attachment.getValue("file_name")),
                mediaId: cleanText(attachment.getUniqueValue()),
                sizeBytes: safeInteger(attachment.getValue("size_bytes")) ?? 0,
                tableName: cleanText(attachment.getValue("table_name")),
                tableSysId: cleanText(attachment.getValue("table_sys_id"))
            };
        },
        getAttachmentBytes(attachmentSysId) {
            const attachment = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
            if (!attachment.get("sys_id", cleanText(attachmentSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            const base64 = cleanText(new GlideSysAttachment().getContentBase64?.(attachment));
            return base64 ? decodeBase64(base64) : null;
        },
        getAttachmentContentStream(attachmentSysId) {
            return new GlideSysAttachment().getContentStream(cleanText(attachmentSysId));
        },
        getCurrentUserSysId: () => cleanText(gs.getUserID()),
        loadAssetByKey(assetKey) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("asset_key", cleanText(assetKey));
            record.setLimit(1);
            record.query();
            return record.next() ? mapAsset(record) : null;
        },
        loadClaimedAssetsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("state", "claimed");
            record.addQuery("workspace", cleanText(workspaceSysId));
            record.orderBy("sys_created_on");
            record.setLimit(10);
            record.query();
            const assets = [];
            while (record.next()) {
                assets.push(mapAsset(record));
            }
            return assets;
        },
        loadProvisionRequestBySysId(provisionRequestSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord("x_2300756_docsera_workspace_provision_request");
            if (!record.get("sys_id", cleanText(provisionRequestSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            const state = cleanText(record.getValue("state"));
            const iconType = cleanText(record.getValue("icon_type"));
            return {
                iconKey: cleanText(record.getValue("icon_key")),
                iconType: iconType === "uploaded" ? "uploaded" : "builtin",
                state: state === "processing" || state === "succeeded" || state === "failed" ? state : "requested",
                sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
                workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace"))
            };
        },
        loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
            if (!record.get("sys_id", cleanText(workspaceSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            return mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
        },
        markAssetInvalid(assetSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            if (record.get("sys_id", cleanText(assetSysId))) {
                record.setValue("state", "invalid");
                record.update();
            }
        },
        restoreAssetToStaged(assetSysId, input = {}) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            if (record.get("sys_id", cleanText(assetSysId))) {
                record.setValue("state", "staged");
                record.setValue("provision_request", cleanText(input.provisionRequestSysId));
                record.setValue("workspace", cleanText(input.workspaceSysId));
                record.update();
            }
        },
        setAssetValidated(assetSysId, input) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            if (record.get("sys_id", cleanText(assetSysId))) {
                record.setValue("attachment", input.attachmentSysId);
                record.setValue("file_name", input.fileName);
                record.setValue("content_type", input.contentType);
                record.setValue("size_bytes", input.sizeBytes);
                record.setValue("width", input.width);
                record.setValue("height", input.height);
                record.setValue("state", "staged");
                record.update();
            }
        },
        setAssetStagedWorkspace(assetSysId, workspaceSysId) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "staged");
            record.addQuery("provision_request", "");
            record.addQuery("workspace", "");
            record.setValue("workspace", targetWorkspaceSysId);
            record.updateMultiple();
            const verified = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            return (verified.get("sys_id", sysId) &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("state")) === "staged" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("provision_request")) === "" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("workspace")) === targetWorkspaceSysId);
        },
        setAssetWorkspace(assetSysId, input) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const requestSysId = cleanText(input.provisionRequestSysId);
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "claimed");
            record.addQuery("provision_request", requestSysId);
            record.addQuery("workspace", "");
            if (cleanText(input.workspaceSysId)) {
                record.setValue("workspace", workspaceSysId);
            }
            record.updateMultiple();
            const verified = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            return (verified.get("sys_id", sysId) &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("state")) === "claimed" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("provision_request")) === requestSysId &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("workspace")) === workspaceSysId);
        },
        tryClaimAsset(assetSysId, provisionRequestSysId) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const requestSysId = cleanText(provisionRequestSysId);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "staged");
            record.addQuery("provision_request", "");
            record.addQuery("workspace", "");
            record.setValue("state", "claimed");
            record.setValue("provision_request", requestSysId);
            record.updateMultiple();
            const verified = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            return (verified.get("sys_id", sysId) &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("state")) === "claimed" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("provision_request")) === requestSysId &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("workspace")) === "");
        },
        tryClaimSettingsAsset(assetSysId, workspaceSysId) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "staged");
            record.addQuery("provision_request", "");
            record.addQuery("workspace", targetWorkspaceSysId);
            record.setValue("state", "claimed");
            record.updateMultiple();
            const verified = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            return (verified.get("sys_id", sysId) &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("state")) === "claimed" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("provision_request")) === "" &&
                cleanText(verified.getValue("workspace")) === targetWorkspaceSysId);
        },
        tryBeginStagedSettingsAssetCleanup(assetSysId, workspaceSysId, requestedBy) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
            const userSysId = cleanText(requestedBy);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "staged");
            record.addQuery("workspace", targetWorkspaceSysId);
            record.addQuery("requested_by", userSysId);
            record.addQuery("provision_request", "");
            record.setValue("state", "cleaning");
            record.updateMultiple();
            const verified = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            return verified.get("sys_id", sysId) && cleanText(verified.getValue("state")) === "cleaning" && cleanText(verified.getValue("workspace")) === targetWorkspaceSysId && cleanText(verified.getValue("requested_by")) === userSysId && cleanText(verified.getValue("provision_request")) === "";
        },
        tryFinalizeAssetCleanup(assetSysId, attachmentSysId) {
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", cleanText(assetSysId));
            record.addQuery("state", "cleaning");
            record.addQuery("attachment", cleanText(attachmentSysId));
            record.setLimit(1);
            record.query();
            return record.next() ? Boolean(record.deleteRecord()) : false;
        },
        tryRetireClaimedAsset(assetSysId, workspaceSysId, attachmentSysId) {
            const sysId = cleanText(assetSysId);
            const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
            const targetAttachmentSysId = cleanText(attachmentSysId);
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("sys_id", sysId);
            record.addQuery("state", "claimed");
            record.addQuery("workspace", targetWorkspaceSysId);
            record.addQuery("attachment", targetAttachmentSysId);
            record.setLimit(1);
            record.query();
            return record.next() ? Boolean(record.deleteRecord()) : false;
        },
        writeAttachmentToAsset(input) {
            const asset = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
            if (!asset.get("sys_id", cleanText(input.assetSysId))) {
                return null;
            }
            return cleanText(new GlideSysAttachment().writeContentStream(asset, cleanText(input.fileName), input.contentType, input.dataStream));
        }
    };
}
export function createWorkspaceIconService(dependencies) {
    function hasCompletedMatchingProvisioningClaim(asset, workspaceSysId) {
        if (!asset.provisionRequestSysId) {
            return true;
        }
        const request = dependencies.loadProvisionRequestBySysId(asset.provisionRequestSysId);
        return Boolean(request &&
            request.sysId === asset.provisionRequestSysId &&
            request.state === "succeeded" &&
            request.workspaceSysId === workspaceSysId &&
            request.iconType === "uploaded" &&
            request.iconKey === asset.assetKey);
    }
    function retireVerifiedClaimedWorkspaceIcon(asset, workspaceSysId) {
        const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
        if (!targetWorkspaceSysId ||
            asset.state !== "claimed" ||
            asset.workspaceSysId !== targetWorkspaceSysId ||
            !asset.sysId ||
            !asset.attachmentSysId ||
            !hasCompletedMatchingProvisioningClaim(asset, targetWorkspaceSysId)) {
            return;
        }

        if (!workspace || cleanText(workspace.sysId) !== targetWorkspaceSysId || (workspace.icon.type === "uploaded" && cleanText(workspace.icon.key) === asset.assetKey)) {
            return;
        }
        const attachment = dependencies.getAttachmentBySysId(asset.attachmentSysId);
        if (attachment) {
            if (attachment.mediaId !== asset.attachmentSysId || attachment.tableName !== DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE || attachment.tableSysId !== asset.sysId) {
                return;
            }
            dependencies.deleteAttachment(asset.attachmentSysId);
            if (dependencies.getAttachmentBySysId(asset.attachmentSysId)) {
                return;
            }
        }
        dependencies.tryRetireClaimedAsset(asset.sysId, targetWorkspaceSysId, asset.attachmentSysId);
    }
    function cleanupFailedUpload(assetSysId, attachmentSysId) {
        if (attachmentSysId) {
            dependencies.deleteAttachment(attachmentSysId);
        }
        dependencies.deleteAsset(assetSysId);
    }
    function finishCleaningAsset(asset) {
        if (asset.state !== "cleaning" || !asset.sysId || !asset.attachmentSysId)
            return;
        const attachment = dependencies.getAttachmentBySysId(asset.attachmentSysId);
        if (attachment && (attachment.mediaId !== asset.attachmentSysId || attachment.tableName !== DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE || attachment.tableSysId !== asset.sysId))
            return;
        if (attachment)
            dependencies.deleteAttachment(asset.attachmentSysId);

    function validateClaimableAsset(assetKey, options = {}) {
        const asset = dependencies.loadAssetByKey(assetKey);
        const currentUserSysId = cleanText(dependencies.getCurrentUserSysId());
        const targetWorkspaceSysId = cleanText(options.workspaceSysId);
        if (!asset || asset.assetKey !== cleanText(assetKey)) {
            return toFailure(400, "The uploaded workspace icon could not be found.");
        }
        if (asset.state !== "staged" || asset.provisionRequestSysId) {
            return toFailure(400, "The uploaded workspace icon has already been used.");
        }
        if (targetWorkspaceSysId ? asset.workspaceSysId !== targetWorkspaceSysId : Boolean(asset.workspaceSysId)) {

        }
        if (asset.requestedBy !== currentUserSysId) {
            return toFailure(403, "The uploaded workspace icon belongs to another user.");
        }
        if (!asset.attachmentSysId || asset.width < 128 || asset.width !== asset.height) {
            return toFailure(400, "The uploaded workspace icon is not valid.");
        }
        const attachment = dependencies.getAttachmentBySysId(asset.attachmentSysId);
        if (!attachment || attachment.mediaId !== asset.attachmentSysId || attachment.tableName !== DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE || attachment.tableSysId !== asset.sysId) {
            return toFailure(400, "The uploaded workspace icon attachment could not be verified.");
        }
        if (attachment.fileName !== asset.fileName || attachment.contentType !== asset.contentType || attachment.sizeBytes !== asset.sizeBytes) {

    return {

            if (targetWorkspaceSysId) {

                if (!targetWorkspace || cleanText(targetWorkspace.sysId) !== targetWorkspaceSysId) {

            const currentUserSysId = cleanText(dependencies.getCurrentUserSysId());
            if (!currentUserSysId) {

            }
            const assetKey = createOpaqueAssetKey(dependencies);
            const assetSysId = dependencies.createAsset({ assetKey, requestedBy: currentUserSysId });
            if (!assetSysId) {
                return toFailure(500, "Something went wrong while preparing the icon asset. Please try again.");
            }
            const attachmentSysId = dependencies.writeAttachmentToAsset({
                assetSysId,
                contentType: cleanText(input.contentType).split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase(),
                dataStream: input.dataStream,
                fileName: cleanText(input.fileName)

            }
            try {

                const bytes = dependencies.getAttachmentBytes(attachmentSysId);

                    key: asset.assetKey,

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";

import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";

function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }

}
function loadWorkspace(body) {

    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);

        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    return row.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(row) : null;
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await validateWorkspaceEditLeaseForRead(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response)) {
            return;
        }
        if (lease.kind !== "held") {
            return;
        }
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "not_found", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService().pendingChanges(workspace);
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "recovery_required" ? "recovery_required" : "pending_changes_unavailable",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? {
                            currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision
                        }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                ...result.pending
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera pending changes] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown pending changes failure."}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "pending_changes_unavailable", message: "Unable to load pending changes. Please try again." } });
    }
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMembers.ts";
import { readQueryParam } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const body = request?.body;
    if (!body || typeof body !== "object") {
        return {};
    }
    const data = body.data;
    if (data && typeof data === "object") {
        return data;
    }
    return body;
}
function readWorkspaceRef(request, body) {
    return {
        workspaceSlug: cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) || readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSlug") || readQueryParam(request, "workspace"),
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(body.workspaceSysId) || readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
    };
}
function setOutcome(response, outcome, successPayload) {
    if (outcome.kind === "succeeded") {
        response.setBody({ result: successPayload });
        return;
    }
    response.setStatus?.(outcome.kind === "forbidden" ? 403 : outcome.status ?? 500);
    response.setBody({
        error: {
            message: outcome.errorMessage || "Workspace membership request failed."
        }
    });
}
function logUnexpectedWorkspaceMemberError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace membership failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace membership] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeQueryRequest(request, operation) {
    const workspaceRef = readWorkspaceRef(request, {});
    const term = readQueryParam(request, "q") || readQueryParam(request, "term");
    const excludedUserCount = (readQueryParam(request, "exclude") || "").split(",").map(cleanText).filter(Boolean).length;
    const limit = Number(readQueryParam(request, "limit"));
    return { operation, workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceRef.workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceRef.workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceRef.workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceRef.workspaceSysId.length, termPresent: Boolean(term), termLength: term.length, excludedUserCount, limit: Number.isSafeInteger(limit) && limit > 0 ? limit : undefined };
}
function summarizeBodyRequest(body, operation) {
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const userSysId = cleanText(body.userSysId);
    return { operation, workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, userSysIdPresent: Boolean(userSysId), userSysIdLength: userSysId.length, accessLevel: body.accessLevel === "admin" || body.accessLevel === "editor" || body.accessLevel === "viewer" ? body.accessLevel : undefined };
}
export function listWorkspaceMembers(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService();
        const outcome = service.listMembers(readWorkspaceRef(request, {}));
        setOutcome(response, outcome, outcome.kind === "succeeded" ? { callerCapabilities: outcome.callerCapabilities, members: outcome.members } : {});
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceMemberError(error, summarizeQueryRequest(request, "list"));
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Unable to load workspace members. Please try again." } });
    }
}
export function searchWorkspaceMemberUsers(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService();
        const limit = Number(readQueryParam(request, "limit")) || 10;
        const excludedUserSysIds = (readQueryParam(request, "exclude") || "")
            .split(",")
            .map(cleanText)
            .filter(Boolean);
        const outcome = service.searchUsers({
            ...readWorkspaceRef(request, {}),
            excludedUserSysIds,
            limit,
            term: readQueryParam(request, "q") || readQueryParam(request, "term")
        });
        setOutcome(response, outcome, outcome.kind === "succeeded" ? { callerCapabilities: outcome.callerCapabilities, users: outcome.users } : {});
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceMemberError(error, summarizeQueryRequest(request, "search"));
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Unable to search users. Please try again." } });
    }
}
export function setWorkspaceMemberAccess(request, response) {
    const body = readRequestBody(request);
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService();
        const outcome = service.setMemberAccess({
            ...readWorkspaceRef(request, body),
            accessLevel: cleanText(body.accessLevel),
            userSysId: cleanText(body.userSysId)
        });
        setOutcome(response, outcome, outcome.kind === "succeeded" ? { callerCapabilities: outcome.callerCapabilities, member: outcome.member, members: outcome.members } : {});
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceMemberError(error, summarizeBodyRequest(body, "set"));
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Unable to update workspace membership. Please try again." } });
    }
}
export function removeWorkspaceMemberAccess(request, response) {
    const body = readRequestBody(request);
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService();
        const outcome = service.removeMemberAccess({
            ...readWorkspaceRef(request, body),
            userSysId: cleanText(body.userSysId)
        });
        setOutcome(response, outcome, outcome.kind === "succeeded" ? { callerCapabilities: outcome.callerCapabilities, members: outcome.members } : {});
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceMemberError(error, summarizeBodyRequest(body, "remove"));
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Unable to remove workspace membership. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-members.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>4c95c208a1904705818bcbb4565f1e3f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-members.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_4c95c208a1904705818bcbb4565f1e3f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
