sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_member_mutation_command";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function normalizeBoolean(value) {
    const normalized = cleanText(value).toLowerCase();
    return value === true || value === 1 || normalized === "1" || normalized === "true" || normalized === "yes";
}
function normalizeAccessLevel(value) {
    const normalized = cleanText(value).toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === "admin" || normalized === "workspace_admin" || normalized === "workspace-admin") {
        return "admin";
    }
    if (normalized === "editor" || normalized === "workspace_editor" || normalized === "workspace-editor") {
        return "editor";
    }
    return null;
}
function callerCapabilities(dependencies) {
    return {
        canManageWorkspaceMembers: true
    };
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
}
function loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug) {
    const slug = cleanText(workspaceSlug);
    if (!slug) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    record.addQuery("workspace_slug", slug);
    record.setLimit(1);
    record.query();
    if (!record.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
}
const USER_LOOKUP_BATCH_SIZE = 100;
function readGroupMembers(groups) {
    const validGroups = groups.map((group) => ({ ...group, groupSysId: cleanText(group.groupSysId) }));
    const groupIds = [...new Set(validGroups.map((group) => group.groupSysId).filter(Boolean))];
    if (!groupIds.length)
        return groups.map(() => []);
    const memberships = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
    if (groups.length === 1)
        memberships.addQuery("group", groupIds[0]);
    else
        memberships.addQuery("group", "IN", groupIds.join(","));
    memberships.query();
    const userIdsByGroup = groups.map(() => []);
    while (memberships.next()) {
        const groupSysId = cleanText(memberships.getValue("group"));
        const userSysId = cleanText(memberships.getValue("user"));
        if (!userSysId)
            continue;
        validGroups.forEach((group, index) => {
            if (group.groupSysId && group.groupSysId === groupSysId)
                userIdsByGroup[index].push(userSysId);
        });
    }
    const uniqueIds = [...new Set(userIdsByGroup.flat())];
    const usersById = new Map();
    for (let offset = 0; offset < uniqueIds.length; offset += USER_LOOKUP_BATCH_SIZE) {
        const users = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
        users.addQuery("sys_id", "IN", uniqueIds.slice(offset, offset + USER_LOOKUP_BATCH_SIZE).join(","));
        users.query();
        while (users.next()) {
            const userSysId = cleanText(users.getValue("sys_id"));
            usersById.set(userSysId, {
                userSysId,
                userName: cleanText(users.getValue("user_name")),
                displayName: cleanText(users.getDisplayValue("name")) || cleanText(users.getValue("name")) || cleanText(users.getValue("user_name")),
                email: cleanText(users.getValue("email")),
                active: normalizeBoolean(users.getValue("active"))
            });
        }
    }
    return userIdsByGroup.map((userIds, index) => {
        const members = [];
        for (const userSysId of userIds) {
            const user = usersById.get(userSysId);
            if (user)
                members.push({ ...user, accessLevel: validGroups[index].accessLevel });
        }
        return members;
    });
}
export function listGroupMembers(groupSysId, accessLevel) {
    return readGroupMembers([{ groupSysId, accessLevel }])[0];
}
export function listWorkspaceGroupMembers(adminGroupSysId, editorGroupSysId) {
    const [adminMembers, editorMembers] = readGroupMembers([
        { groupSysId: adminGroupSysId, accessLevel: "admin" },
        { groupSysId: editorGroupSysId, accessLevel: "editor" }
    ]);
    return { adminMembers, editorMembers };
}
export function searchActiveUsers(term, excludedUserSysIds, limit) {
    const cleanTerm = cleanText(term);
    const excluded = new Set(excludedUserSysIds.map(cleanText).filter(Boolean));
    const users = new GlideRecord("sys_user");
    users.addQuery("active", true);
    if (excluded.size > 0) {
        users.addQuery("sys_id", "NOT IN", [...excluded].join(","));
    }
    if (cleanTerm) {
        const nameQuery = users.addQuery("name", "CONTAINS", cleanTerm);
        nameQuery.addOrCondition("user_name", "CONTAINS", cleanTerm);
        nameQuery.addOrCondition("email", "CONTAINS", cleanTerm);
    }
    users.orderBy("name");
    users.setLimit(Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, 20)));
    users.query();
    const results = [];
    while (users.next()) {
        const userSysId = cleanText(users.getValue("sys_id"));
        if (!userSysId || excluded.has(userSysId)) {
            continue;
        }
        results.push({
            displayName: cleanText(users.getDisplayValue("name")) || cleanText(users.getValue("name")) || cleanText(users.getValue("user_name")),
            email: cleanText(users.getValue("email")),
            userName: cleanText(users.getValue("user_name")),
            userSysId
        });
    }
    return results;
}
function resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        return dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId);
    }
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
    if (workspaceSlug) {
        return dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug);
    }
    return null;
}
function mergeMembers(adminMembers, editorMembers) {
    const membersByUser = new Map();
    for (const member of editorMembers) {
        membersByUser.set(member.userSysId, member);
    }
    for (const member of adminMembers) {
        membersByUser.set(member.userSysId, {
            ...member,
            accessLevel: "admin"
        });
    }
    return [...membersByUser.values()].sort((left, right) => {
        const name = left.displayName.localeCompare(right.displayName, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
        if (name !== 0) {
            return name;
        }
        return left.userSysId.localeCompare(right.userSysId);
    });
}
function listWorkspaceMembers(workspace, dependencies) {
    if (dependencies.listWorkspaceGroupMembers) {
        const { adminMembers, editorMembers } = dependencies.listWorkspaceGroupMembers(workspace.adminGroupSysId, workspace.editorGroupSysId);
        return mergeMembers(adminMembers, editorMembers);
    }
    return mergeMembers(dependencies.listGroupMembers(workspace.adminGroupSysId, "admin"), dependencies.listGroupMembers(workspace.editorGroupSysId, "editor"));
}
function hasGroupMembership(workspace, dependencies, groupSysId, accessLevel, userSysId) {
    return dependencies
        .listGroupMembers(groupSysId, accessLevel)
        .some((member) => member.userSysId === userSysId);
}
function verifyMutationEndState(workspace, dependencies, command) {
    const inAdmin = hasGroupMembership(workspace, dependencies, workspace.adminGroupSysId, "admin", command.targetUserSysId);
    const inEditor = hasGroupMembership(workspace, dependencies, workspace.editorGroupSysId, "editor", command.targetUserSysId);
    if (command.kind === "remove") {
        return !inAdmin && !inEditor;
    }
    if (command.accessLevel === "admin") {
        return inAdmin && !inEditor;
    }
    if (command.accessLevel === "editor") {
        return inEditor && !inAdmin;
    }
    return false;
}
function countActiveAdmins(workspace, dependencies) {
    return dependencies
        .listGroupMembers(workspace.adminGroupSysId, "admin")
        .filter((member) => member.active)
        .length;
}
function isUserActiveAdmin(workspace, dependencies, userSysId) {
    return dependencies
        .listGroupMembers(workspace.adminGroupSysId, "admin")
        .some((member) => member.userSysId === userSysId && member.active);
}
function isLastActiveAdminChangeForbidden(workspace, dependencies, targetUserSysId, nextAccessLevel) {
    if (nextAccessLevel === "admin") {
        return false;
    }
    return isUserActiveAdmin(workspace, dependencies, targetUserSysId) && countActiveAdmins(workspace, dependencies) <= 1;
}
function validateGroupReferences(workspace) {
    if (!cleanText(workspace.adminGroupSysId) || !cleanText(workspace.editorGroupSysId)) {
        return "Workspace access groups are not configured.";
    }
    return null;
}
function ensureCanManageMembers(workspace, dependencies) {
    const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
    if (!capability.canManageWorkspaceMembers) {
        return {
            allowed: false,
            outcome: {
                kind: "forbidden",
                errorMessage: "You do not have permission to manage workspace members."
            }
        };
    }
    return { allowed: true };
}
export function createWorkspaceMembershipService(dependencies) {
    return {
        listMembers(input) {
            const workspace = resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input);
            if (!workspace) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
            }
            const authorization = ensureCanManageMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            if (authorization.allowed === false) {
                return authorization.outcome;
            }
            const groupError = validateGroupReferences(workspace);
            if (groupError) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: groupError, status: 500 };
            }
            return {
                callerCapabilities: callerCapabilities(dependencies),
                kind: "succeeded",
                members: listWorkspaceMembers(workspace, dependencies)
            };
        },
        searchUsers(input) {
            const term = cleanText(input.term);
            const workspace = resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input);
            if (!workspace) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
            }
            const authorization = ensureCanManageMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            if (authorization.allowed === false) {
                return authorization.outcome;
            }
            const groupError = validateGroupReferences(workspace);
            if (groupError) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: groupError, status: 500 };
            }
            const members = listWorkspaceMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            const excluded = [
                ...members.map((member) => member.userSysId),
                ...(Array.isArray(input.excludedUserSysIds) ? input.excludedUserSysIds : [])
            ];
            return {
                callerCapabilities: callerCapabilities(dependencies),
                kind: "succeeded",
                users: dependencies.searchActiveUsers(term, excluded, input.limit ?? 10)
            };
        },
        setMemberAccess(input) {
            const accessLevel = normalizeAccessLevel(input.accessLevel);
            const userSysId = cleanText(input.userSysId);
            if (!userSysId || !accessLevel) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "A user and access level are required.", status: 400 };
            }
            const workspace = resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input);
            if (!workspace) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
            }
            const authorization = ensureCanManageMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            if (authorization.allowed === false) {
                return authorization.outcome;
            }
            const groupError = validateGroupReferences(workspace);
            if (groupError) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: groupError, status: 500 };
            }
            if (isLastActiveAdminChangeForbidden(workspace, dependencies, userSysId, accessLevel)) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "The last active Workspace Admin cannot be demoted or removed."
                };
            }
            const command = {
                accessLevel,
                kind: "set",
                targetUserSysId: userSysId,
                workspaceSysId: cleanText(workspace.sysId)
            };
            if (!dependencies.createMutationCommand(command) || !verifyMutationEndState(workspace, dependencies, command)) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace membership could not be updated.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
            const members = listWorkspaceMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            const member = members.find((candidate) => candidate.userSysId === userSysId) ?? null;
            return {
                callerCapabilities: callerCapabilities(dependencies),
                kind: "succeeded",
                member,
                members
            };
        },
        removeMemberAccess(input) {
            const userSysId = cleanText(input.userSysId);
            if (!userSysId) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "A user is required.", status: 400 };
            }
            const workspace = resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input);
            if (!workspace) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
            }
            const authorization = ensureCanManageMembers(workspace, dependencies);
            if (authorization.allowed === false) {
                return authorization.outcome;
            }
            const groupError = validateGroupReferences(workspace);
            if (groupError) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: groupError, status: 500 };
            }
            if (isLastActiveAdminChangeForbidden(workspace, dependencies, userSysId, null)) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "The last active Workspace Admin cannot be demoted or removed."
                };
            }
            const command = {
                accessLevel: null,
                kind: "remove",
                targetUserSysId: userSysId,
                workspaceSysId: cleanText(workspace.sysId)
            };
            if (!dependencies.createMutationCommand(command) || !verifyMutationEndState(workspace, dependencies, command)) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace membership could not be removed.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
            return {
                callerCapabilities: callerCapabilities(dependencies),
                kind: "succeeded",
                members: listWorkspaceMembers(workspace, dependencies)
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createMembershipMutationCommand(command) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(command.workspaceSysId);
    const targetUserSysId = cleanText(command.targetUserSysId);
    const kind = cleanText(command.kind);
    const accessLevel = command.accessLevel ? normalizeAccessLevel(command.accessLevel) : null;
    if (!workspaceSysId || !targetUserSysId || (kind !== "set" && kind !== "remove")) {
        return null;
    }
    if (kind === "set" && !accessLevel) {
        return null;
    }
    const commandRecord = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE);
    commandRecord.initialize();
    commandRecord.setValue("workspace", workspaceSysId);
    commandRecord.setValue("target_user", targetUserSysId);
    commandRecord.setValue("mutation_kind", kind);
    commandRecord.setValue("access_level", kind === "set" ? accessLevel : "");
    commandRecord.setValue("requested_by", gs.getUserID());
    commandRecord.setValue("state", "requested");
    return cleanText(commandRecord.insert()) || null;
}
export function createServiceNowWorkspaceMembershipService() {
    return createWorkspaceMembershipService({
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        hasDocseraAdminAccess: () => evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities({
            adminGroupSysId: "",
            creatorUserSysId: "",
            editorGroupSysId: "",
            icon: { key: "", label: "", type: "builtin" },
            layout: { pageWidth: "readable", tocVisible: true },
            name: "",
            shortDescription: null,
            slug: "",
            status: "active"
        }).canAdminWorkspace,
        listGroupMembers,
        listWorkspaceGroupMembers,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        loadWorkspaceBySysId,
        createMutationCommand: createMembershipMutationCommand,
        searchActiveUsers
    });
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMembers.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>60ec1a3bb51145c99526b3122cb40e5c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMembers.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_60ec1a3bb51145c99526b3122cb40e5c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function parseJsonValue(value) {
    const text = cleanText(value);
    try {
        return JSON.parse(text);
    }
    catch {
        throw new Error("The stored page content is not valid JSON.");
    }
}
function parsePersistedDraftContentJson(value) {
    const text = cleanText(value);
    if (!text) {
        throw new Error("The stored page content does not use a supported document envelope.");
    }
    return parseJsonValue(text);
}
function parseOptionalPersistedContentJson(value) {
    const text = cleanText(value);
    if (!text) {
        return null;
    }
    return text;
}
export function mapPageRecord(record) {
    return normalizePageRecord({
        sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace")),
        parentPageSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("parent_page")) || null,
        siblingOrder: normalizeSiblingOrder(record.getValue("sibling_order")),
        draftTitle: cleanText(record.getValue("draft_title")),
        draftSlug: cleanText(record.getValue("draft_slug")),
        draftSlugNormalized: cleanText(record.getValue("draft_slug_normalized")),
        draftContentJson: parsePersistedDraftContentJson(record.getValue("draft_content_json")),
        draftRevision: Number(record.getValue("draft_revision")) || 0,
        draftBodyText: cleanText(record.getValue("draft_body_text")) || null,
        publishedTitle: cleanText(record.getValue("published_title")) || null,
        publishedSlug: cleanText(record.getValue("published_slug")) || null,
        publishedSlugNormalized: cleanText(record.getValue("published_slug_normalized")) || null,
        publishedContentJson: parseOptionalPersistedContentJson(record.getValue("published_content_json")),
        publishedBodyText: cleanText(record.getValue("published_body_text")) || null,
        publishedAt: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("published_at")) || cleanText(record.getValue("published_at")) || null,
        publishedBySysId: cleanText(record.getValue("published_by")) || null,
        publishedByDisplayName: cleanText(record.getDisplayValue("published_by")) || null,
        publicationState: cleanText(record.getValue("publication_state")) || "draft",
        active: normalizeServiceNowBoolean(record.getValue("active"), true)
    });
}

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_a673a09512144e94a5476daa4f9b4b3f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceMedia.ts";
import { readQueryParam } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedMediaError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace media retrieval failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace media file] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const mediaId = readQueryParam(request, "mediaId");
    const workspaceSysId = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId");
    return { action: "retrieve", mediaIdPresent: Boolean(mediaId), mediaIdLength: mediaId.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceMediaService();
        const result = await service.getWorkspaceMediaFile({
            mediaId: readQueryParam(request, "mediaId"),
            workspaceSysId: readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
        });
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setHeaders?.({
            "Content-Type": result.contentType
        });
        const writer = response.getStreamWriter?.();
        if (!writer) {
            throw new Error("A response stream writer is required for media retrieval.");
        }
        writer.writeStream(result.contentStream);
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedMediaError(error, summarizeRequest(request));
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Unable to load media file. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media-file.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>a673a09512144e94a5476daa4f9b4b3f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-media-file.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_a673a09512144e94a5476daa4f9b4b3f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><business_calendar/><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><entered_run_end/><entered_run_start/><entered_time>1970-01-01 00:00:00</entered_time><max_drift/><name>Docsera Abandoned Workspace Icon Cleanup</name><offset/><offset_type>0</offset_type><repeat_every/><run_as/><run_as_tz/><run_dayofmonth>1</run_dayofmonth><run_dayofweek>1</run_dayofweek><run_daysofweek/><run_end/><run_month>1</run_month><run_period/><run_start>2026-11-06 22:37:12</run_start><run_time>2026-11-06 22:39:01</run_time><run_type>daily</run_type><run_weekinmonth>1</run_weekinmonth><script><![CDATA[(function () {
    var TABLE = 'x_2300756_docsera_workspace_icon_asset';
    var RETENTION_SECONDS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;
    var BATCH_SIZE = 50;
    var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
    cutoff.addSeconds(-RETENTION_SECONDS);

    var processed = 0;

    function cleanCandidates(candidates) {
        while (processed < BATCH_SIZE && candidates.next()) {
            processed++;
            try {
                var id = String(candidates.getUniqueValue() || '');
                var attachmentId = String(candidates.getValue('attachment') || '');
                var state = String(candidates.getValue('state') || '');
                if (!id || !attachmentId) continue;
                if (state === 'staged') {
                    var claim = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                    claim.addQuery('sys_id', id);
                    claim.addQuery('state', 'staged');
                    claim.addQuery('provision_request', '');
                    claim.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<', cutoff.getValue());
                    claim.setValue('state', 'cleaning');
                    claim.updateMultiple();
                }
                var asset = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                if (!asset.get('sys_id', id) || String(asset.getValue('state') || '') !== 'cleaning' || String(asset.getValue('provision_request') || '')) continue;
                var attachment = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
                if (attachment.get('sys_id', attachmentId)) {
                    if (String(attachment.getValue('table_name') || '') !== TABLE || String(attachment.getValue('table_sys_id') || '') !== id) continue;
                    new GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment(attachmentId);
                }
                var absent = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
                if (absent.get('sys_id', attachmentId)) continue;
                var remove = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
                remove.addQuery('sys_id', id);
                remove.addQuery('state', 'cleaning');
                remove.addQuery('attachment', attachmentId);
                remove.deleteMultiple();
            } catch (error) {
                gs.warn('Docsera workspace icon cleanup deferred one asset: ' + error);
            }
        }
    }

    // Retry interrupted durable claims first; their age does not affect eligibility.
    var cleaningCandidates = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
    cleaningCandidates.addQuery('state', 'cleaning');
    cleaningCandidates.addQuery('provision_request', '');
    cleaningCandidates.orderBy('sys_updated_on');
    cleaningCandidates.setLimit(BATCH_SIZE);
    cleaningCandidates.query();
    cleanCandidates(cleaningCandidates);

    // Apply staged-upload retention before limiting the remaining batch capacity.
    if (processed < BATCH_SIZE) {
        var stagedCandidates = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('state', 'staged');
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('provision_request', '');
        stagedCandidates.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<', cutoff.getValue());
        stagedCandidates.orderBy('sys_updated_on');
        stagedCandidates.setLimit(BATCH_SIZE - processed);
        stagedCandidates.query();
        cleanCandidates(stagedCandidates);
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>705c1a6e32fa48fb9157541b3545b467</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Docsera Abandoned Workspace Icon Cleanup</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysauto_script_705c1a6e32fa48fb9157541b3545b467</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:46</sys_updated_on><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe></sysauto_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[const PNG_SIGNATURE = [0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a];
const MAX_ICON_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
const MIN_ICON_DIMENSION = 128;
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function normalizeContentType(value) {
    return cleanText(value).split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}
function hasBytes(bytes, offset, values) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + values.length) {
        return false;
    }
    return values.every((value, index) => bytes[offset + index] === value);
}
function ascii(bytes, offset, length) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + length) {
        return "";
    }
    let value = "";
    for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) {
        value += String.fromCharCode(bytes[offset + index]);
    }
    return value;
}
function readUint16BE(bytes, offset) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + 2) {
        return null;
    }
    return (bytes[offset] << 8) | bytes[offset + 1];
}
function readUint24LE(bytes, offset) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + 3) {
        return null;
    }
    return bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8) | (bytes[offset + 2] << 16);
}
function readUint32LE(bytes, offset) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + 4) {
        return null;
    }
    return (bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8) | (bytes[offset + 2] << 16) | (bytes[offset + 3] << 24)) >>> 0;
}
function readUint32BE(bytes, offset) {
    if (offset < 0 || bytes.length < offset + 4) {
        return null;
    }
    return ((bytes[offset] << 24) | (bytes[offset + 1] << 16) | (bytes[offset + 2] << 8) | bytes[offset + 3]) >>> 0;
}
function parsePng(bytes) {
    if (!hasBytes(bytes, 0, PNG_SIGNATURE) || bytes.length < 33 || readUint32BE(bytes, 8) !== 13 || ascii(bytes, 12, 4) !== "IHDR") {
        return null;
    }
    const width = readUint32BE(bytes, 16);
    const height = readUint32BE(bytes, 20);
    if (!width || !height) {
        return null;
    }
    let hasImageData = false;
    let offset = 8;
    while (offset < bytes.length) {
        const chunkLength = readUint32BE(bytes, offset);
        const chunkType = ascii(bytes, offset + 4, 4);
        if (chunkLength === null || !chunkType || offset + 12 + chunkLength > bytes.length) {
            return null;
        }
        if (offset === 8 && chunkType !== "IHDR") {
            return null;
        }
        if (chunkType === "IDAT") {
            hasImageData = true;
        }
        offset += 12 + chunkLength;
        if (chunkType === "IEND") {
            return hasImageData && offset === bytes.length ? { contentType: "image/png", format: "png", width, height } : null;
        }
    }
    return null;
}
function isJpegStartOfFrame(marker) {
    return ((marker >= 0xc0 && marker <= 0xc3) ||
        (marker >= 0xc5 && marker <= 0xc7) ||
        (marker >= 0xc9 && marker <= 0xcb) ||
        (marker >= 0xcd && marker <= 0xcf));
}
function parseJpeg(bytes) {
    if (!hasBytes(bytes, 0, [0xff, 0xd8])) {
        return null;
    }
    let offset = 2;
    let metadata = null;
    let sawScan = false;
    while (offset < bytes.length) {
        while (offset < bytes.length && bytes[offset] === 0xff) {
            offset += 1;
        }
        if (offset >= bytes.length) {
            return null;
        }
        const marker = bytes[offset];
        offset += 1;
        if (marker === 0xd9) {
            return metadata && sawScan ? metadata : null;
        }
        if (marker === 0xda) {
            const segmentLength = readUint16BE(bytes, offset);
            if (!segmentLength || segmentLength < 2 || offset + segmentLength >= bytes.length - 2 || !metadata || !hasBytes(bytes, bytes.length - 2, [0xff, 0xd9])) {
                return null;
            }
            sawScan = true;
            return metadata;
        }
        if (marker >= 0xd0 && marker <= 0xd7) {
            continue;
        }
        const segmentLength = readUint16BE(bytes, offset);
        if (!segmentLength || segmentLength < 2 || offset + segmentLength > bytes.length) {
            return null;
        }
        if (isJpegStartOfFrame(marker)) {
            const height = readUint16BE(bytes, offset + 3);
            const width = readUint16BE(bytes, offset + 5);
            if (!width || !height) {
                return null;
            }
            metadata = { contentType: "image/jpeg", format: "jpeg", width, height };
        }
        offset += segmentLength;
    }
    return null;
}
function parseWebp(bytes) {
    if (ascii(bytes, 0, 4) !== "RIFF" || ascii(bytes, 8, 4) !== "WEBP") {
        return null;
    }
    const riffPayloadLength = readUint32LE(bytes, 4);
    if (riffPayloadLength === null || riffPayloadLength + 8 !== bytes.length || bytes.length < 20) {
        return null;
    }
    let offset = 12;
    let metadata = null;
    let requiresImagePayload = false;
    let hasImagePayload = false;
    function acceptImagePayload(payloadMetadata) {
        if (metadata && (metadata.width !== payloadMetadata.width || metadata.height !== payloadMetadata.height)) {
            return false;
        }
        hasImagePayload = true;
        metadata = metadata ?? payloadMetadata;
        return true;
    }
    while (offset < bytes.length) {
        const chunkType = ascii(bytes, offset, 4);
        const chunkLength = readUint32LE(bytes, offset + 4);
        if (!chunkType || chunkLength === null || offset + 8 + chunkLength > bytes.length) {
            return null;
        }
        const payloadOffset = offset + 8;
        if (chunkType === "VP8X") {
            if (chunkLength !== 10) {
                return null;
            }
            const widthMinusOne = readUint24LE(bytes, payloadOffset + 4);
            const heightMinusOne = readUint24LE(bytes, payloadOffset + 7);
            if (widthMinusOne === null || heightMinusOne === null) {
                return null;
            }
            metadata = { contentType: "image/webp", format: "webp", width: widthMinusOne + 1, height: heightMinusOne + 1 };
            requiresImagePayload = true;
        }
        else if (chunkType === "VP8L") {
            if (chunkLength <= 5 || !hasBytes(bytes, payloadOffset, [0x2f])) {
                return null;
            }
            const b0 = bytes[payloadOffset + 1];
            const b1 = bytes[payloadOffset + 2];
            const b2 = bytes[payloadOffset + 3];
            const b3 = bytes[payloadOffset + 4];
            const width = 1 + (((b1 & 0x3f) << 8) | b0);
            const height = 1 + (((b1 & 0xc0) >> 6) | (b2 << 2) | ((b3 & 0x0f) << 10));
            if (!acceptImagePayload({ contentType: "image/webp", format: "webp", width, height })) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        else if (chunkType === "VP8 ") {
            if (chunkLength <= 10 || !hasBytes(bytes, payloadOffset + 3, [0x9d, 0x01, 0x2a])) {
                return null;
            }
            const rawWidth = bytes[payloadOffset + 6] | (bytes[payloadOffset + 7] << 8);
            const rawHeight = bytes[payloadOffset + 8] | (bytes[payloadOffset + 9] << 8);
            if (!rawWidth || !rawHeight) {
                return null;
            }
            if (!acceptImagePayload({ contentType: "image/webp", format: "webp", width: rawWidth & 0x3fff, height: rawHeight & 0x3fff })) {
                return null;
            }

        offset += 8 + chunkLength + (chunkLength % 2);
    }
    return offset === bytes.length && metadata && hasImagePayload && (!requiresImagePayload || hasImagePayload) ? metadata : null;
}
export function normalizeWorkspaceIconDeclaredContentType(value) {
    const contentType = normalizeContentType(value);
    return contentType === "image/png" || contentType === "image/jpeg" || contentType === "image/webp" ? contentType : null;
}
export function contentTypeForWorkspaceIconExtension(fileName) {
    const candidate = cleanText(fileName);
    if (!candidate || candidate.includes("/") || candidate.includes("\\") || candidate.includes("..")) {
        return null;
    }
    const extension = candidate.slice(candidate.lastIndexOf(".") + 1).toLowerCase();
    switch (extension) {
        case "jpg":
        case "jpeg":
            return "image/jpeg";
        case "png":
            return "image/png";
        case "webp":
            return "image/webp";
        default:
            return null;
    }
}
export function parseWorkspaceIconImage(bytes) {
    return parsePng(bytes) ?? parseJpeg(bytes) ?? parseWebp(bytes);
}
export function validateWorkspaceIconImage(input) {
    const extensionContentType = contentTypeForWorkspaceIconExtension(input.fileName);
    if (!extensionContentType) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon file name must use PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP." };
    }
    const declaredContentType = normalizeWorkspaceIconDeclaredContentType(input.contentType);
    if (!declaredContentType) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon content type must be PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WebP." };
    }
    if (declaredContentType !== extensionContentType) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon file extension and content type do not match." };
    }
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.sizeBytes) || input.sizeBytes <= 0) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon upload body cannot be empty." };
    }
    if (input.sizeBytes > MAX_ICON_BYTES || input.bytes.length > MAX_ICON_BYTES) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon upload exceeds the 1 MB limit." };
    }
    const metadata = parseWorkspaceIconImage(input.bytes);
    if (!metadata || metadata.contentType !== declaredContentType) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon file content does not match a supported image format." };
    }
    if (metadata.width !== metadata.height || metadata.width < MIN_ICON_DIMENSION) {
        return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The icon image must be square and at least 128 by 128 pixels." };
    }

    return raw && typeof raw === "object" && "data" in raw && raw.data && typeof raw.data === "object" ? raw.data : raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
}
function send(action, result, response) {
    if (result.kind === "held") {
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                state: "held",
                ...(action === "status" ? {} : { leaseToken: result.leaseToken }),
                heartbeatIntervalMs: result.heartbeatIntervalMs,

    }

 .filter((node): node is ProseMirrorNode => Boolean(node));

 if (nodes.length > 0) {
 return nodes;
 }

 const paragraphType = view.state.schema.nodes.paragraph;
 return paragraphType ? [paragraphType.create()] : [];
}

function replaceCellContent(view: EditorView, tr: EditorState["tr"], cellPos: number, nextContent: JSONContent[]) {
 const mappedCellPos = tr.mapping.map(cellPos);
 const mappedCellNode = tr.doc.nodeAt(mappedCellPos);
 if (!mappedCellNode) {
 return tr;
 }

 const nextNodes = decodeCellContent(view, nextContent);
 if (nextNodes.length === 0) {
 return tr;
 }

 return tr.replaceWith(mappedCellPos + 1, mappedCellPos + mappedCellNode.nodeSize - 1, nextNodes);
}

function isWholeRowSelection(rect: { bottom: number; left: number; right: number; top: number }, map: TableMap): boolean {
 return rect.left === 0 && rect.right === map.width && rect.bottom - rect.top === 1;
}

function isWholeColumnSelection(rect: { bottom: number; left: number; right: number; top: number }, map: TableMap): boolean {
 return rect.top === 0 && rect.bottom === map.height && rect.right - rect.left === 1;
}

export function createStructuredTableClipboardPayload(
 kind: StructuredTableClipboardKind,
 cells: JSONContent[][],
 timestampMsUtc = Date.now(),
 provenanceToken = createStructuredTableClipboardProvenanceToken()
): StructuredTableClipboardPayload {
 const clipboardText = serializeStructuredTableClipboardCellsToPlainText(cells);
 return {
 cells: cloneStructuredTableClipboardCells(cells),
 clipboardText,
 kind,
 provenanceToken,
 timestampMsUtc
 };
}

export function isFreshStructuredTableClipboardPayload(
 payload: StructuredTableClipboardPayload,
 nowMsUtc = Date.now()
): boolean {
 return nowMsUtc - payload.timestampMsUtc < STRUCTURED_TABLE_CLIPBOARD_TTL_MS;
}

export function serializeStructuredTableClipboardCellsToPlainText(cells: JSONContent[][]): string {
 return cells.map((cellContent) => collectPlainTextFromJsonContent(cellContent)).join("\n");
}

export function createStructuredTableClipboardItemData(payload: StructuredTableClipboardPayload): Record<string, Blob> {
 return {
 "text/plain": new Blob([payload.clipboardText], { type: "text/plain" }),
 [STRUCTURED_TABLE_CLIPBOARD_PROVENANCE_WEB_CUSTOM_FORMAT]: new Blob([payload.provenanceToken], {
 type: STRUCTURED_TABLE_CLIPBOARD_PROVENANCE_WEB_CUSTOM_FORMAT
 })
 };
}

export function doesStructuredTableClipboardDataMatchPayload(
 clipboardData: StructuredTableClipboardDataLike,
 payload: StructuredTableClipboardPayload
): boolean {
 if (!clipboardData) {
 return false;
 }

 return clipboardData.getData(STRUCTURED_TABLE_CLIPBOARD_PROVENANCE_WEB_CUSTOM_FORMAT) === payload.provenanceToken;
}

export function resolveStructuredTableClipboardDestination(
 state: EditorState
): { index: number; kind: StructuredTableClipboardKind; map: TableMap; tableStart: number } | null {
 if (!(state.selection instanceof CellSelection)) {
 return null;
 }

 const table = findTable(state.selection.$anchorCell);
 if (!table) {
 return null;
 }

 let rect: ReturnType<typeof selectedRect> | null = null;
 try {
 rect = selectedRect(state);
 } catch {
 rect = null;
 }

 if (!rect) {
 return null;
 }

 const map = TableMap.get(table.node);
 if (isWholeRowSelection(rect, map)) {
 return {
 index: rect.top,
 kind: "row",
 map,
 tableStart: table.start
 };
 }

 if (isWholeColumnSelection(rect, map)) {
 return {
 index: rect.left,
 kind: "column",
 map,
 tableStart: table.start
 };
 }

 return null;
}

export function tryApplyStructuredTableClipboardPaste(
 view: EditorView,
 payload: StructuredTableClipboardPayload | null,
 nowMsUtc = Date.now()
): boolean {
 if (!payload || !isFreshStructuredTableClipboardPayload(payload, nowMsUtc)) {
 return false;
 }

 const destination = resolveStructuredTableClipboardDestination(view.state);
 if (!destination || destination.kind !== payload.kind) {
 return false;
 }

 const targetCount = destination.kind === "row" ? destination.map.width : destination.map.height;
 const sourceCount = payload.cells.length;
 const copyCount = Math.min(targetCount, sourceCount);
 if (copyCount <= 0) {
 return false;
 }

 let tr = view.state.tr;

 if (destination.kind === "row") {
 for (let columnIndex = 0; columnIndex < copyCount; columnIndex += 1) {
 const relativeCellPos = destination.map.map[destination.index * destination.map.width + columnIndex];
 if (typeof relativeCellPos !== "number") {
 continue;
 }

 tr = replaceCellContent(view, tr, destination.tableStart + relativeCellPos, payload.cells[columnIndex] ?? []);
 }
 } else {
 for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < copyCount; rowIndex += 1) {
 const relativeCellPos = destination.map.map[rowIndex * destination.map.width + destination.index];
 if (typeof relativeCellPos !== "number") {
 continue;
 }

 tr = replaceCellContent(view, tr, destination.tableStart + relativeCellPos, payload.cells[rowIndex] ?? []);
 }
 }

 view.dispatch(closeHistory(tr.scrollIntoView()));
 view.focus();
 return true;
}

function isTextSelection(selection: unknown): selection is TextSelection {
 return selection instanceof TextSelection;
}

function isNodeSelection(selection: unknown): selection is NodeSelection {
 return selection instanceof NodeSelection;
}

function getShortcutModifierLabel(ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): "Ctrl" | "Command" {
 const platform = ownerWindow?.navigator?.platform ?? "";
 return /mac|iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(platform) ? "Command" : "Ctrl";
}

export function formatToolbarShortcutLabel(shortcut: string, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): string {
 return shortcut.replace(/\bMod\b/g, getShortcutModifierLabel(ownerWindow));
}

function getToolbarActionTitle(label: string, shortcut: string | null | undefined, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): string {
 return shortcut ? `${label} (${formatToolbarShortcutLabel(shortcut, ownerWindow)})` : label;
}

function hasUrlScheme(value: string): boolean {
 return /^[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:/i.test(value);
}

function normalizeLinkHref(rawHref: string): string {
 const trimmed = rawHref.trim();
 if (!trimmed) {
 return "";
 }

 if (
 hasUrlScheme(trimmed) ||
 trimmed.startsWith("//") ||
 trimmed.startsWith("/") ||
 trimmed.startsWith("#")
 ) {
 return trimmed;
 }

 if (trimmed.startsWith("www.") || /^[^\s/]+\.[^\s/]+/.test(trimmed)) {
 return `https://${trimmed}`;
 }

 return trimmed;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
 return Math.min(Math.max(min, value), max);
}

function getElementRect(element: HTMLElement | null): DOMRect | null {
 if (!element) {
 return null;
 }

 const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
 if (!Number.isFinite(rect.left) || !Number.isFinite(rect.top)) {
 return null;
 }

 return new DOMRect(rect.left, rect.top, Math.max(1, rect.width), Math.max(1, rect.height));
}

function isNodeFromOwnerWindow(value: unknown, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): value is Node {
 const ownerNode = (ownerWindow as (Window & typeof globalThis) | null | undefined)?.Node;
 if (ownerNode && value instanceof ownerNode) {
 return true;
 }

 return typeof Node !== "undefined" && value instanceof Node;
}

function isElementNodeFromOwnerWindow(value: unknown, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): value is Element {
 if (!isNodeFromOwnerWindow(value, ownerWindow)) {
 return false;
 }

 const ownerNode = (ownerWindow as (Window & typeof globalThis) | null | undefined)?.Node;
 return value.nodeType === (ownerNode?.ELEMENT_NODE ?? Node.ELEMENT_NODE);
}

function getEventPathNodes(event: Event, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): Node[] {
 if (typeof event.composedPath !== "function") {
 return [];
 }

 return event
 .composedPath()
 .filter((entry): entry is Node => isNodeFromOwnerWindow(entry, ownerWindow));
}

function resolveEventTargetNode(event: Event, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): Node | null {
 const pathNodes = getEventPathNodes(event, ownerWindow);
 if (pathNodes.length > 0) {
 return pathNodes[0];
 }

 return isNodeFromOwnerWindow(event.target, ownerWindow) ? event.target : null;
}

export function resolveEditorLinkElementFromEvent(
 event: Event,
 editorDom: HTMLElement,
 ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined
): Element | null {
 const ownerNode = (ownerWindow as (Window & typeof globalThis) | null | undefined)?.Node;
 const pathNodes = getEventPathNodes(event, ownerWindow);
 for (const node of pathNodes) {
 if (isElementNodeFromOwnerWindow(node, ownerWindow)) {
 const linkElement = node.closest("a[href]");
 if (linkElement && editorDom.contains(linkElement)) {
 return linkElement;
 }
 }
 }

 const target = event.target;
 if (!isNodeFromOwnerWindow(target, ownerWindow)) {
 return null;
 }

 const targetElement =
 target.nodeType === (ownerNode?.ELEMENT_NODE ?? Node.ELEMENT_NODE)
 ? (target as Element)
 : (target as Node & { parentElement: Element | null }).parentElement;

 if (!targetElement || !editorDom.contains(targetElement)) {
 return null;
 }

 const linkElement = targetElement.closest("a[href]");
 return linkElement && editorDom.contains(linkElement) ? linkElement : null;
}

export function isEventWithinEditor(event: Event, editorElement: HTMLElement, ownerWindow: Window | null | undefined): boolean {
 if (isNodeFromOwnerWindow(event.target, ownerWindow) && editorElement.contains(event.target)) {
 return true;
 }

 return getEventPathNodes(event, ownerWindow).some((node) => editorElement.contains(node));
}

export function resolveCenteredSurfaceStyle(
 ownerDocument: Document,
 anchorRect: DOMRect,
 surfaceRect: Pick<DOMRect, "height" | "width">,
 preferAbove = false
): CSSProperties {
 const ownerWindow = ownerDocument.defaultView;
 const viewportWidth = ownerWindow?.innerWidth ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientWidth;
 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientHeight;
 const maxSurfaceWidth = Math.max(1, viewportWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const maxSurfaceHeight = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const clampedWidth = Math.max(1, Math.min(surfaceRect.width, maxSurfaceWidth));
 const clampedHeight = Math.max(1, Math.min(surfaceRect.height, maxSurfaceHeight));
 const centeredLeft = anchorRect.left + anchorRect.width / 2 - clampedWidth / 2;
 const left = clamp(centeredLeft, VIEWPORT_GUTTER, Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, viewportWidth - clampedWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER));
 const aboveTop = anchorRect.top - clampedHeight - POPOVER_GAP;
 const belowTop = anchorRect.bottom + POPOVER_GAP;
 const top = preferAbove && aboveTop >= VIEWPORT_GUTTER ? aboveTop : clamp(belowTop, VIEWPORT_GUTTER, Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, viewportHeight - clampedHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER));

 return {
 position: "fixed",
 left: `${left}px`,
 top: `${top}px`,
 width: `${clampedWidth}px`,
 maxWidth: `${maxSurfaceWidth}px`,
 maxHeight: `${maxSurfaceHeight}px`
 };
}

 ownerDocument: Document,
 anchorRect: DOMRect,
 surfaceRect: Pick<DOMRect, "height" | "width">
): CSSProperties {
 const ownerWindow = ownerDocument.defaultView;
 const viewportWidth = ownerWindow?.innerWidth ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientWidth;
 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientHeight;
 const maxSurfaceWidth = Math.max(1, viewportWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const maxSurfaceHeight = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const clampedWidth = Math.max(1, Math.min(surfaceRect.width, maxSurfaceWidth));
 const clampedHeight = Math.max(1, Math.min(surfaceRect.height, maxSurfaceHeight));
 const centeredLeft = anchorRect.left + anchorRect.width / 2 - clampedWidth / 2;
 const left = clamp(
 centeredLeft,
 VIEWPORT_GUTTER,
 Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, viewportWidth - clampedWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER)
 );
 const aboveTop = anchorRect.top - clampedHeight - POPOVER_GAP;
 const belowTop = anchorRect.bottom + POPOVER_GAP;
 const top =
 aboveTop >= VIEWPORT_GUTTER
 ? aboveTop
 : clamp(
 belowTop,
 VIEWPORT_GUTTER,
 Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, viewportHeight - clampedHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER)
 );

 return {

export function getToolbarBlockTypeLabel(blockType: ToolbarBlockTypeId): string {
 switch (blockType) {
 case "heading1":
 return "Heading 1";
 case "heading2":
 return "Heading 2";
 case "heading3":
 return "Heading 3";
 case "blockquote":
 return "Blockquote";
 case "bulletedList":
 return "Unordered List";
 case "numberedList":
 return "Numbered List";
 case "taskList":
 return "Task List";
 case "text":
 default:
 return "Text";
 }
}

export function getToolbarBlockType(editor: Editor): ToolbarBlockTypeId {
 const { selection } = editor.state;
 if (!isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return "text";
 }

 for (let depth = selection.$from.depth; depth >= 0; depth -= 1) {
 const node = selection.$from.node(depth);
 if (node.type.name === "blockquote") {
 return "blockquote";
 }

 if (node.type.name === "heading") {
 switch (node.attrs.level) {
 case 1:
 return "heading1";
 case 2:
 return "heading2";
 case 3:
 return "heading3";
 }
 }

 if (node.type.name === "bulletList") {
 return "bulletedList";
 }

 if (node.type.name === "orderedList") {
 return "numberedList";
 }

 if (node.type.name === "taskList") {
 return "taskList";
 }
 }

 return "text";
}

export function applyToolbarBlockTypeCommand(editor: Editor, target: ToolbarBlockTypeId): boolean {
 const current = getToolbarBlockType(editor);
 if (current === target) {
 return false;
 }

 let applied = false;

 editor
 .chain()
 .command(({ state, tr, dispatch }) => {
 const { selection, schema } = state;
 if (!isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty || isNodeSelection(selection)) {
 return false;
 }

 const range = selection.$from.blockRange(selection.$to);
 if (!range) {
 return false;
 }

 const paragraphType = schema.nodes.paragraph;
 const headingType = schema.nodes.heading;
 const bulletListType = schema.nodes.bulletList;
 const orderedListType = schema.nodes.orderedList;
 const taskListType = schema.nodes.taskList;
 const listItemType = schema.nodes.listItem;
 const taskItemType = schema.nodes.taskItem;
 const blockquoteType = schema.nodes.blockquote;
 const currentIsList = current === "bulletedList" || current === "numberedList" || current === "taskList";
 const targetIsList = target === "bulletedList" || target === "numberedList" || target === "taskList";
 const currentIsBlockquote = current === "blockquote";
 const targetIsBlockquote = target === "blockquote";
 const targetListType = target === "bulletedList" ? bulletListType : target === "numberedList" ? orderedListType : taskListType;
 const targetAttrs = target === "heading1" ? { level: 1 } : target === "heading2" ? { level: 2 } : target === "heading3" ? { level: 3 } : {};

 function setTextblockTypeFromSelection(nodeType: typeof paragraphType | typeof headingType, attrs?: Record<string, unknown>) {
 const depth = tr.selection.$from.depth;
 const node = tr.selection.$from.node(depth);
 const pos = tr.selection.$from.before(depth);
 const attrsChanged = !!attrs && Object.keys(attrs).some((key) => node.attrs[key] !== attrs[key]);
 if (node.isTextblock && (node.type !== nodeType || attrsChanged)) {
 tr.setNodeMarkup(pos, nodeType, attrs);
 }
 }

 const listNode = currentIsList
 ? (() => {
 for (let depth = selection.$from.depth; depth >= 0; depth -= 1) {
 const node = selection.$from.node(depth);
 if (node.type === bulletListType || node.type === orderedListType || node.type === taskListType) {
 return {
 depth,
 node,
 pos: selection.$from.before(depth)
 };
 }
 }

 return null;
 })()
 : null;

 function liftCurrentBlockquote() {
 const blockquoteRange = tr.selection.$from.blockRange(tr.selection.$to, (node) => node.type === blockquoteType);
 const targetLift = blockquoteRange ? liftTarget(blockquoteRange) : null;
 if (!blockquoteRange || targetLift == null) {
 return false;
 }

 tr.lift(blockquoteRange, targetLift);
 return true;
 }

 function wrapSelectionInBlockquote() {
 const wrappedRange = tr.selection.$from.blockRange(tr.selection.$to);
 if (!wrappedRange) {
 return false;
 }

 const wrappers = findWrapping(wrappedRange, blockquoteType);
 if (!wrappers) {
 return false;
 }

 tr.wrap(wrappedRange, wrappers);
 return true;
 }

 if (currentIsList && listNode) {
 if (targetIsList) {
 const targetItemType = target === "taskList" ? taskItemType : listItemType;
 const targetItemAttrs = target === "taskList" ? { checked: false } : null;
 // The replacement keeps the list's content tree intact, so text positions
 // inside it are stable relative to the list start. Mapping those positions
 // through replaceWith instead maps them through a deleted node.
 const selectionOffsets = selection instanceof TextSelection
 ? {
 anchor: selection.anchor - listNode.pos,
 head: selection.head - listNode.pos
 }
 : null;
 const convertedItems: PMNode[] = [];
 listNode.node.forEach((item) => {
 convertedItems.push(targetItemType.create(targetItemAttrs, item.content));
 });
 tr.replaceWith(listNode.pos, listNode.pos + listNode.node.nodeSize, targetListType.create(null, convertedItems));
 try {
 if (!selectionOffsets) {
 throw new Error("The replaced list did not contain a text selection.");
 }
 tr.setSelection(TextSelection.create(tr.doc, listNode.pos + selectionOffsets.anchor, listNode.pos + selectionOffsets.head));
 } catch {
 tr.setSelection(Selection.near(tr.doc.resolve(listNode.pos + 1), 1));
 }
 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 const targetLift = liftTarget(range);
 if (targetLift == null) {
 return false;
 }

 tr.lift(range, targetLift);
 if (targetIsBlockquote) {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 if (!wrapSelectionInBlockquote()) {
 return false;
 }
 } else if (target === "text") {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 } else {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(headingType, targetAttrs);
 }

 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 if (currentIsBlockquote) {
 if (!liftCurrentBlockquote()) {
 return false;
 }

 if (targetIsList) {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 const wrappedRange = tr.selection.$from.blockRange(tr.selection.$to);
 if (!wrappedRange) {
 return false;
 }

 const wrappers = findWrapping(wrappedRange, targetListType);
 if (!wrappers) {
 return false;
 }

 tr.wrap(wrappedRange, wrappers);
 } else if (target === "text") {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 } else {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(headingType, targetAttrs);
 }

 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 if (targetIsList) {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 const wrappedRange = tr.selection.$from.blockRange(tr.selection.$to);
 if (!wrappedRange) {
 return false;
 }

 const wrappers = findWrapping(wrappedRange, targetListType);
 if (!wrappers) {
 return false;
 }

 tr.wrap(wrappedRange, wrappers);
 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 if (targetIsBlockquote) {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 if (!wrapSelectionInBlockquote()) {
 return false;
 }

 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 if (target === "text") {
 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(paragraphType);
 applied = true;
 return true;
 }

 setTextblockTypeFromSelection(headingType, targetAttrs);
 applied = true;
 return true;
 })
 .run();

 return applied;
}

export function getToolbarMarkState(editor: Editor) {
 return {
 blockquote: editor.isActive("blockquote"),
 bold: editor.isActive("bold"),
 code: editor.isActive("code"),
 highlight: editor.isActive("highlight"),
 italic: editor.isActive("italic"),
 link: editor.isActive("link"),
 strike: editor.isActive("strike"),
 subscript: editor.isActive("subscript"),
 superscript: editor.isActive("superscript"),
 underline: editor.isActive("underline")
 };
}

function toggleUnderlineMark(editor: Editor) {
 return editor.chain().focus(undefined, { scrollIntoView: false }).toggleUnderline().run();
}

function toggleSuperscriptMark(editor: Editor) {
 return editor
 .chain()
 .focus(undefined, { scrollIntoView: false })
 .unsetSubscript()
 .toggleSuperscript()
 .run();
}

function toggleSubscriptMark(editor: Editor) {
 return editor
 .chain()
 .focus(undefined, { scrollIntoView: false })
 .unsetSuperscript()
 .toggleSubscript()
 .run();
}

function getToolbarSelectionSnapshot(editor: Editor): ToolbarSelectionSnapshot | null {
 const { selection } = editor.state;
 if (!editor.isEditable || !isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty || isNodeSelection(selection)) {
 return null;
 }

 const rect = getSelectionAnchorRect(editor);
 if (!rect) {
 return null;
 }

 const from = Math.min(selection.from, selection.to);
 const to = Math.max(selection.from, selection.to);
 return {
 from,
 key: `${from}:${to}`,
 rect,
 to
 };
}

function getSelectionAnchorRect(editor: Editor): DOMRect | null {
 const { selection } = editor.state;
 if (!editor.isEditable || !isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty || isNodeSelection(selection) || !editor.view) {
 return null;
 }

 const ownerDocument = editor.view.dom.ownerDocument;
 try {
 const selectionApi = ownerDocument.getSelection();
 if (selectionApi?.rangeCount) {
 const range = selectionApi.getRangeAt(0);
 if (!range.collapsed) {
 const rects = Array.from(range.getClientRects()).filter((rect) => rect.width > 0 || rect.height > 0);
 if (rects.length > 0) {
 const orderedRects = selection.anchor <= selection.head ? rects : [...rects].reverse();
 const preferredRect = orderedRects.reduce<DOMRect | null>((best, candidate) => {
 if (!best) {
 return new DOMRect(candidate.left, candidate.top, Math.max(1, candidate.width), Math.max(1, candidate.height));
 }

 if (candidate.width < best.width - 0.5) {
 return new DOMRect(candidate.left, candidate.top, Math.max(1, candidate.width), Math.max(1, candidate.height));
 }

 if (Math.abs(candidate.width - best.width) <= 0.5 && candidate.top < best.top) {
 return new DOMRect(candidate.left, candidate.top, Math.max(1, candidate.width), Math.max(1, candidate.height));
 }

 return best;
 }, null);

 if (preferredRect) {
 return preferredRect;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 } catch {
 // Fall back to coordsAtPos below.
 }

 try {
 const fromRect = editor.view.coordsAtPos(Math.min(selection.from, selection.to));
 const toRect = editor.view.coordsAtPos(Math.max(selection.from, selection.to));
 const left = Math.min(fromRect.left, toRect.left);
 const right = Math.max(fromRect.right, toRect.right);
 const top = Math.min(fromRect.top, toRect.top);
 const bottom = Math.max(fromRect.bottom, toRect.bottom);
 return new DOMRect(left, top, Math.max(1, right - left), Math.max(1, bottom - top));
 } catch {
 return null;
 }
}

function getSelectionRangeRect(editor: Editor, from: number, to: number): DOMRect | null {
 if (!editor.view) {
 return null;
 }

 try {
 const startRect = editor.view.coordsAtPos(Math.min(from, to));
 const endRect = editor.view.coordsAtPos(Math.max(from, to));
 const left = Math.min(startRect.left, endRect.left);
 const right = Math.max(startRect.right, endRect.right);
 const top = Math.min(startRect.top, endRect.top);
 const bottom = Math.max(startRect.bottom, endRect.bottom);
 return new DOMRect(left, top, Math.max(1, right - left), Math.max(1, bottom - top));
 } catch {
 return null;
 }
}

function findLinkRange(editor: Editor): { from: number; to: number; href: string } | null {
 const { selection } = editor.state;
 const linkType = editor.schema.marks.link;
 if (!linkType) {
 return null;
 }

 const range = getMarkRange(selection.$from, linkType);
 if (!range) {
 return null;
 }

 const attrs = editor.getAttributes("link");
 const href = typeof attrs.href === "string" ? attrs.href : "";
 return {
 from: range.from,
 to: range.to,
 href
 };
}

function findLinkRangeAtPosition(editor: Editor, position: number): { from: number; to: number; href: string } | null {
 const linkType = editor.schema.marks.link;
 if (!linkType) {
 return null;
 }

 const resolvedPosition = editor.state.doc.resolve(position);
 const range = getMarkRange(resolvedPosition, linkType);
 if (!range) {
 return null;
 }

 const linkMark = resolvedPosition.marks().find((mark) => mark.type === linkType)
 ?? resolvedPosition.nodeAfter?.marks.find((mark) => mark.type === linkType)
 ?? resolvedPosition.nodeBefore?.marks.find((mark) => mark.type === linkType);
 const href = typeof linkMark?.attrs.href === "string" ? linkMark.attrs.href : "";

 return {
 from: range.from,
 to: range.to,
 href
 };
}

function buildSelectionSnapshot(editor: Editor): ToolbarSelectionSnapshot | null {
 return getToolbarSelectionSnapshot(editor);
}

function getUniformSelectionMarkAttrs(editor: Editor, markName: "highlight" | "highlightColor" | "textColor"): Record<string, unknown> | null | "mixed" {
 const { selection, doc, schema } = editor.state;
 const markType = schema.marks[markName];
 if (!markType || !isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return null;
 }

 let sawText = false;
 let uniformAttrs: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;

 doc.nodesBetween(selection.from, selection.to, (node) => {
 if (!node.isText) {
 return;
 }

 sawText = true;
 const mark = node.marks.find((candidate) => candidate.type === markType) ?? null;
 const attrs = mark?.attrs ?? null;
 if (uniformAttrs === undefined) {
 uniformAttrs = attrs;
 return;
 }

 if (JSON.stringify(uniformAttrs) !== JSON.stringify(attrs)) {
 uniformAttrs = "mixed" as never;
 }
 });

 if (!sawText || uniformAttrs === undefined) {
 return null;
 }

 return uniformAttrs as Record<string, unknown> | null | "mixed";
}

function getUniformTextColorChoice(editor: Editor): TextColorChoice | null | "mixed" {
 const attrs = getUniformSelectionMarkAttrs(editor, "textColor");
 if (attrs === "mixed") {
 return "mixed";
 }

 if (!attrs) {
 return "default";
 }

 return isDocseraPaletteKey(attrs.color) ? attrs.color : "mixed";
}

function getUniformHighlightColorChoice(editor: Editor): HighlightColorChoice | null | "mixed" {
 const highlightAttrs = getUniformSelectionMarkAttrs(editor, "highlight");
 const highlightColorAttrs = getUniformSelectionMarkAttrs(editor, "highlightColor");
 if (highlightAttrs === "mixed" || highlightColorAttrs === "mixed") {
 return "mixed";
 }

 if (highlightAttrs && highlightColorAttrs) {
 return "mixed";
 }

 if (highlightColorAttrs) {
 return isDocseraPaletteKey(highlightColorAttrs.color) ? highlightColorAttrs.color : "mixed";
 }

 return highlightAttrs ? "default" : "none";
}

function applyTextColorChoice(editor: Editor, choice: TextColorChoice): boolean {
 if (getUniformTextColorChoice(editor) === choice) {
 return true;
 }

 const { selection, schema } = editor.state;
 const markType = schema.marks.textColor;
 if (!markType || !isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return false;
 }

 const tr = editor.state.tr.removeMark(selection.from, selection.to, markType);
 if (choice !== "default") {
 tr.addMark(selection.from, selection.to, markType.create({ color: choice }));
 }

 editor.view.dispatch(tr.scrollIntoView());
 return true;
}

function applyHighlightColorChoice(editor: Editor, choice: HighlightColorChoice): boolean {
 if (getUniformHighlightColorChoice(editor) === choice) {
 return true;
 }

 const { selection, schema } = editor.state;
 const highlightType = schema.marks.highlight;
 const highlightColorType = schema.marks.highlightColor;
 if (!highlightType || !highlightColorType || !isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return false;
 }

 const tr = editor.state.tr
 .removeMark(selection.from, selection.to, highlightType)
 .removeMark(selection.from, selection.to, highlightColorType);

 if (choice === "default") {
 tr.addMark(selection.from, selection.to, highlightType.create());
 } else if (choice !== "none") {
 tr.addMark(selection.from, selection.to, highlightColorType.create({ color: choice }));
 }

 editor.view.dispatch(tr.scrollIntoView());
 return true;
}

function getNodeTextAlignChoice(value: unknown): ToolbarAlignmentChoice {
 return value === "center" || value === "right" ? value : "left";
}

function getUniformSelectionAlignmentChoice(editor: Editor): ToolbarAlignmentChoice | null | "mixed" {
 const { selection, doc } = editor.state;
 if (!isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return null;
 }

 let sawSupportedBlock = false;
 let uniformChoice: ToolbarAlignmentChoice | "mixed" | null = null;

 doc.nodesBetween(selection.from, selection.to, (node) => {
 if (node.type.name !== "paragraph" && node.type.name !== "heading") {
 return true;
 }

 const choice = getNodeTextAlignChoice(node.attrs.textAlign);
 sawSupportedBlock = true;
 if (uniformChoice === null) {
 uniformChoice = choice;
 return false;
 }

 if (uniformChoice !== choice) {
 uniformChoice = "mixed";
 return false;
 }

 return false;
 });

 if (!sawSupportedBlock) {
 return null;
 }

 return uniformChoice;
}

function applyAlignmentChoice(editor: Editor, choice: ToolbarAlignmentChoice): boolean {
 const { selection, doc } = editor.state;
 if (!isTextSelection(selection) || selection.empty) {
 return false;
 }

 let sawSupportedBlock = false;
 let changed = false;
 const tr = editor.state.tr;

 doc.nodesBetween(selection.from, selection.to, (node, pos) => {
 if (node.type.name !== "paragraph" && node.type.name !== "heading") {
 return true;
 }

 sawSupportedBlock = true;
 const currentChoice = getNodeTextAlignChoice(node.attrs.textAlign);
 if (currentChoice === choice && (choice !== "left" || node.attrs.textAlign === undefined)) {
 return false;
 }

 const nextAttrs = { ...node.attrs };
 if (choice === "left") {
 delete nextAttrs.textAlign;
 } else {
 nextAttrs.textAlign = choice;
 }
 tr.setNodeMarkup(pos, undefined, nextAttrs);
 changed = true;
 return false;
 });

 if (!sawSupportedBlock) {
 return false;
 }

 if (changed) {
 editor.view.dispatch(tr.scrollIntoView());
 }
 return true;
}

function getMoreItemActiveState(editor: Editor, id: ToolbarMoreItemId): boolean {
 switch (id) {
 case "superscript":
 return editor.isActive("superscript");
 case "subscript":
 return editor.isActive("subscript");
 }
}

function applyMoreItemCommand(editor: Editor, id: ToolbarMoreItemId): boolean {
 switch (id) {
 case "superscript":
 return toggleSuperscriptMark(editor);
 case "subscript":
 return toggleSubscriptMark(editor);
 }
}

function CompactToolbarSeparator() {

function CompactToolbarIconButton({
 active,
 children,
 label,
 onTooltipShow,
 onTooltipHide,
 onClick,
 shortcut,
 title
}: {
 active?: boolean;
 children: ReactNode;
 label: string;
 onTooltipHide: () => void;
 onTooltipShow: (anchorRect: DOMRect, label: string, shortcut?: string | null, immediate?: boolean, allowDuringSurface?: boolean) => void;
 onClick: () => void;
 shortcut?: string | null;
 title: string;
}) {
 const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

 function showTooltip(immediate = false) {
 const rect = getElementRect(buttonRef.current);
 if (rect) {
 onTooltipShow(rect, label, shortcut, immediate);
 }
 }

 return (
 <button
 ref={buttonRef}
 type="button"
 className={`docsera-text-toolbar__button${active ? " docsera-text-toolbar__button--active" : ""}`}

 onBlur={onTooltipHide}
 onClick={() => {
 onTooltipHide();
 onClick();
 }}

 event.preventDefault();
 }}

 onMouseLeave={onTooltipHide}

 {children}

 </button>
 );

function LinkSurface({
 canEdit,
 linkSurface,
 layoutTick,
 onChangeHref,
 onCopy,
 onDismiss,
 onFollow,
 onKeyDown,
 onRemove,
 ownerDocument,
 surfaceRef
}: {
 canEdit: boolean;
 linkSurface: LinkSurfaceState;
 layoutTick: number;
 onChangeHref: (href: string) => void;
 onCopy: () => void;
 onDismiss: () => void;
 onFollow: () => void;
 onKeyDown: (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
 onRemove: () => void;
 ownerDocument: Document;
 surfaceRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
}) {
 const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
 const [surfaceStyle, setSurfaceStyle] = useState<CSSProperties | null>(null);
 const surfaceWidth = linkSurface.mode === "edit" ? LINK_MENU_EDIT_WIDTH : LINK_MENU_CREATE_WIDTH;
 const normalizedHref = normalizeLinkHref(linkSurface.draftHref);
 const hasDraftHref = linkSurface.draftHref.trim().length > 0;
 const canFollow = Boolean(normalizedHref) && isDocseraAllowedLinkHref(normalizedHref);
 const showExistingLinkActions = linkSurface.mode === "edit";

 useEffect(() => {
 inputRef.current?.focus();
 inputRef.current?.select();
 }, [linkSurface.anchorRect, linkSurface.mode, linkSurface.source]);

 useLayoutEffect(() => {
 const element = surfaceRef.current;
 if (!element) {
 setSurfaceStyle(null);
 return;
 }

 const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
 const nextStyle = resolveCenteredSurfaceStyle(ownerDocument, linkSurface.anchorRect, {
 height: Math.max(1, rect.height),
 width: surfaceWidth
 });

 setSurfaceStyle((current) => (sameFloatingStyle(current ?? undefined, nextStyle) ? current : nextStyle));
 }, [layoutTick, linkSurface.anchorRect, linkSurface.mode, ownerDocument, surfaceRef, surfaceWidth]);

 return (
 <div
 ref={surfaceRef}
 className="docsera-text-toolbar__link-surface"
 role="dialog"
 aria-label={linkSurface.mode === "edit" ? "Edit link" : "Create link"}
 style={surfaceStyle ? { width: `${surfaceWidth}px`, ...surfaceStyle } : { visibility: "hidden", width: `${surfaceWidth}px` }}
 >
 <div className="docsera-text-toolbar__link-row">
 <div className="docsera-text-toolbar__link-input-shell">
 <Link2 size={14} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true" />
 <input
 ref={inputRef}
 className="docsera-text-toolbar__link-input"
 type="text"
 value={linkSurface.draftHref}
 placeholder="Paste or type link"
 aria-label="Link URL"
 onChange={(event) => onChangeHref(event.target.value)}
 onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
 disabled={!canEdit}
 />
 </div>
 <div className="docsera-text-toolbar__link-actions">
 <DocseraCompactTooltip label="Open link" ownerDocument={ownerDocument}>
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-text-toolbar__button"
 aria-label="Open link"
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={onFollow}
 disabled={!canFollow}
 >
 <ExternalLink size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
 </button>
 </DocseraCompactTooltip>
 {showExistingLinkActions ? (
 <>
 <DocseraCompactTooltip label="Copy URL" ownerDocument={ownerDocument}>
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-text-toolbar__button"
 aria-label="Copy URL"
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={onCopy}
 disabled={!hasDraftHref}
 >
 <Copy size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
 </button>
 </DocseraCompactTooltip>
 <DocseraCompactTooltip label="Remove link" ownerDocument={ownerDocument}>
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-text-toolbar__button"
 aria-label="Remove link"
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={onRemove}
 >
 <Trash2 size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
 </button>
 </DocseraCompactTooltip>
 </>
 ) : null}
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>
 );
}

export function CompactTextToolbar({
 canEdit,
 editor,
 isTextSelectionPointerOrigin,
 ownerDocument,
 ownerWindow,
 overlayRoot
}: CompactTextToolbarProps) {
 const selectionSnapshot = useEditorState({
 editor,
 selector: ({ editor: snapshotEditor, transactionNumber }) =>
 snapshotEditor
 ? {
 transactionNumber,
 selectionEmpty: snapshotEditor.state.selection.empty,
 selectionFrom: snapshotEditor.state.selection.from,
 selectionInCodeBlock: isTextSelection(snapshotEditor.state.selection) && snapshotEditor.state.selection.$from.parent.type.spec.code,
 selectionRole: isTextSelection(snapshotEditor.state.selection)
 ? "text"
 : isNodeSelection(snapshotEditor.state.selection)
 ? "node"
 : "other",
 selectionTo: snapshotEditor.state.selection.to,
 editable: snapshotEditor.isEditable
 }
 : {
 transactionNumber,
 selectionEmpty: true,
 selectionFrom: 0,
 selectionInCodeBlock: false,
 selectionRole: "other" as const,
 selectionTo: 0,
 editable: false
 }
 });

 const [pointerSelectionHidden, setPointerSelectionHidden] = useState(false);
 const [toolbarDismissedSelectionKey, setToolbarDismissedSelectionKey] = useState("");
 const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState<ToolbarMenuId | null>(null);
 const [displaySelection, setDisplaySelection] = useState<ToolbarSelectionSnapshot | null>(null);
 const [interactionSelection, setInteractionSelection] = useState<ToolbarSelectionSnapshot | null>(null);
 const [linkSurface, setLinkSurface] = useState<LinkSurfaceState | null>(null);
 const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState<ToolbarTooltipState | null>(null);
 const [layoutTick, setLayoutTick] = useState(0);
 const [toolbarStyle, setToolbarStyle] = useState<CSSProperties | null>(null);
 const [blockMenuStyle, setBlockMenuStyle] = useState<CSSProperties | null>(null);

type ImagePickerDialogProps = {

 mediaAdapter?: EditorMediaAdapter;
 onClose: () => void;
 onInsert?: (reference: EditorMediaReference) => void;
 onSelect?: (reference: EditorMediaReference) => void;

 sessionId: string;
};

type PickerViewState = "library" | "upload";

const SUPPORTED_IMAGE_MIME_TYPES = new Set(["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif"]);
const SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif"]);
const MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

function cleanText(value: unknown): string {
 return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}

function getFileExtension(fileName: string): string {
 const trimmed = cleanText(fileName);
 const dotIndex = trimmed.lastIndexOf(".");
 return dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < trimmed.length - 1 ? trimmed.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase() : "";
}

function getMimeForExtension(extension: string): string | null {
 switch (extension) {
 case "jpg":
 case "jpeg":
 return "image/jpeg";
 case "png":
 return "image/png";
 case "webp":
 return "image/webp";
 case "gif":
 return "image/gif";
 default:
 return null;
 }
}

function formatFileName(baseName: string): string {
 return cleanText(baseName);
}

function getSafeErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
 if (typeof error === "string") {
 return cleanText(error) || fallback;
 }

 if (error && typeof error === "object" && "message" in error) {
 return cleanText((error as { message?: unknown }).message) || fallback;
 }

 return fallback;
}

function canCreateObjectUrl(): boolean {
 return typeof URL.createObjectURL === "function";
}

function revokeObjectUrl(value: string | null): void {
 if (!value || typeof URL.revokeObjectURL !== "function") {
 return;
 }

}

function ImagePickerThumbnail({
 fileName,
 mediaAdapter,
 mediaId

 mediaAdapter?: EditorMediaAdapter;

}) {

 }

 return (
 <span className={`docsera-image-picker__tile-image docsera-image-picker__tile-image--${mediaState.status}`} aria-hidden="true">
 <span className="docsera-image-picker__tile-image-fallback">{fileName.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() || "?"}</span>
 </span>
