function validateUploadFile(file: File | null, editedFileName: string): string | null {
 if (!file) {
 return "Choose an image file to continue.";
 }

 if (file.size <= 0) {
 return "The selected file is empty.";
 }

 if (file.size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
 return "The selected file is larger than 10 MB.";
 }

 const normalizedFileName = cleanText(editedFileName);
 if (!normalizedFileName) {
 return "A file name is required.";
 }

 if (normalizedFileName.includes("/") || normalizedFileName.includes("\\") || normalizedFileName.includes("..")) {
 return "The file name cannot include a path or traversal intent.";
 }

 const extension = getFileExtension(normalizedFileName);
 if (!extension || !SUPPORTED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(extension)) {
 return "The file name must end with a supported image extension.";
 }

 const expectedMime = getMimeForExtension(extension);
 const fileMime = cleanText(file.type).toLowerCase();
 if (!expectedMime || !SUPPORTED_IMAGE_MIME_TYPES.has(fileMime)) {
 return "The selected file type is not supported.";
 }

 if (fileMime !== expectedMime) {
 return "The file name extension and selected file type do not match.";
 }

 return null;
}

 </label>

import { ImagePickerDialog } from "./ImagePickerDialog";
import type { EditorMediaAdapter, EditorMediaReference } from "./contracts";
import { canonicalizeDocseraImageAttrs, type DocseraImageAttrs } from "../../shared/editor/imageContract";

type ImageOptionsMediaTarget = "light" | "dark";

type ImageOptionsMediaLabelState = "available" | "pending" | "unavailable" | "unset";

type ImageOptionsDraft = {
 alt: string;
 caption: string;
 darkMediaId: string | null;
 mediaId: string;
};

export type ImageOptionsPanelProps = {
 blockIndex: number;
 editor: Editor;
 initialAttrs: DocseraImageAttrs;
 isEscapeDismissalDeferred?: boolean;
 panelId: string;
 mediaAdapter?: EditorMediaAdapter;
 onClose: () => void;
 overlayRoot: HTMLElement;
 panelStyle: CSSProperties;
 sessionId: string;
};

const readonlyMediaValueStyle: CSSProperties = {
 boxSizing: "border-box",
 width: "100%",
 minWidth: 0,
 height: "34px",
 minHeight: "34px",
 padding: "0 12px",
 border: "1px solid var(--docsera-border)",
 borderRadius: "4px",
 background: "var(--docsera-surface-muted)",
 color: "var(--docsera-text-muted)",
 font: "inherit",
 fontSize: "0.875rem",
 fontWeight: 500,
 lineHeight: "34px",
 overflow: "hidden",
 textOverflow: "ellipsis",
 whiteSpace: "nowrap",
 cursor: "default",
 outline: "none",
 boxShadow: "none",
 appearance: "none",

 caretColor: "transparent"
};

function getTopLevelBlockPosition(editor: Editor, blockIndex: number): number | null {

 editor.state.doc.forEach((_node, offset, index) => {

}

function getTopLevelBlockNode(editor: Editor, blockIndex: number) {

}

 darkMediaId: attrs.darkMediaId,

 };
}

function areDraftsEqual(left: ImageOptionsDraft, right: ImageOptionsDraft): boolean {
 return (

 left.darkMediaId === right.darkMediaId &&
 left.alt === right.alt &&

}

 const next = new Map(current);
 for (const item of items) {
 next.set(item.mediaId, item.fileName);
 }
 return next;
}

 return { label: "Not configured", state: "unset" };
 }

 if (resolvedLabel) {
 return { label: resolvedLabel, state: "available" };
 }

 if (!mediaCatalogLoaded) {
 return { label: "Loading…", state: "pending" };
 }

 return { label: "Media unavailable", state: "unavailable" };

export function ImageOptionsPanel({

 event.preventDefault();
 event.stopPropagation();

 id={`${titleId}-light-media`}
 className={`docsera-image-options-panel__media-value docsera-image-options-panel__media-value--${lightMediaLabel.state}`}
 style={readonlyMediaValueStyle}
 type="text"
 readOnly
 tabIndex={-1}
 aria-readonly="true"
 aria-labelledby={`${titleId}-light-media-label`}
 title={lightMediaLabel.label}
 value={lightMediaLabel.label}
 />
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__chip"
 disabled={!mediaAdapter}
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={() => openPicker("light")}
 >
 <Upload size={14} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" />
 <span style={{ marginInlineStart: 6 }}>Upload</span>
 </button>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div className="docsera-image-options-panel__field docsera-image-options-panel__media-field">
 <span id={`${titleId}-dark-media-label`} className="docsera-image-options-panel__field-label">
 Dark mode image
 </span>
 <div className="docsera-image-options-panel__media-row">
 <input
 aria-labelledby={`${titleId}-dark-media-label`}
 className={`docsera-image-options-panel__media-value docsera-image-options-panel__media-value--${darkMediaLabel.state}`}
 style={readonlyMediaValueStyle}
 type="text"
 readOnly
 tabIndex={-1}
 aria-readonly="true"
 title={darkMediaLabel.label}
 value={darkMediaLabel.label}
 />
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__chip"
 disabled={!mediaAdapter}
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={() => openPicker("dark")}
 >
 <Upload size={14} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" />
 <span style={{ marginInlineStart: 6 }}>Upload</span>
 </button>
 </div>
 </div>

 <label className="docsera-image-options-panel__field" htmlFor={`${titleId}-alt`}>
 <span className="docsera-image-options-panel__field-label">Alt text</span>
 <input
 id={`${titleId}-alt`}
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__input"
 type="text"
 value={draft.alt}
 onChange={(event) => {
 const nextAlt = event.target.value;
 setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, alt: nextAlt }));
 }}
 />
 </label>

 <label className="docsera-image-options-panel__field" htmlFor={`${titleId}-caption`}>
 <span className="docsera-image-options-panel__field-label">Caption</span>
 <input
 id={`${titleId}-caption`}
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__input"
 type="text"
 placeholder="Enter caption"
 value={draft.caption}
 onChange={(event) => {
 const nextCaption = event.target.value;
 setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, caption: nextCaption }));
 }}
 />
 </label>
 </div>

 <div className="docsera-image-options-panel__footer">
 <div className="docsera-image-options-panel__footer-actions">
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__button docsera-image-options-panel__button--destructive"
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={handleDelete}
 >
 <Trash2 size={14} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" />
 <span className="docsera-image-options-panel__button-label">Delete</span>
 </button>
 <button
 type="button"
 className="docsera-image-options-panel__button docsera-image-options-panel__button--primary"
 onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
 onClick={handleSave}
 >
 Save Changes
 </button>
 </div>
 </div>

 <ImagePickerDialog
 isOpen={pickerTarget !== null}
 mediaAdapter={mediaAdapter}
 onClose={closePicker}
 onSelect={handleSelectMedia}
 overlayRoot={overlayRoot}
 sessionId={pickerSessionId}
 />
 </div>,
 overlayRoot
 );
}

","import type { Editor } from "@tiptap/core";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

export type TopLevelBlockDragSourceRange = {

};

export type BlockDragState = {
 clientX: number;
 clientY: number;
 destinationIndex: number | null;
 previewLabel: string;
 previewHtml: string;
 sourceBlockEndIndex: number;
 sourceBlockIndex: number;
 sourceBlockRect: DOMRect;

 pointerOffsetY: number;
};

export function getTopLevelBlockElements(editor: Editor): HTMLElement[] {
 const proseMirror = editor.view.dom;
 if (!(proseMirror instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 return [];
 }

 return Array.from(proseMirror.children).filter((child): child is HTMLElement => child instanceof HTMLElement);
}

export function resolveTopLevelBlockDropIndexFromRects(blockRects: DOMRect[], clientY: number): number | null {
 if (!blockRects.length) {
 return null;
 }

 for (let index = 0; index < blockRects.length; index += 1) {
 const blockRect = blockRects[index]!;
 if (clientY < blockRect.top + blockRect.height / 2) {
 return index;
 }
 }

 return blockRects.length;
}

export function resolveTopLevelBlockDropIndex(editor: Editor, clientY: number): number | null {
 return resolveTopLevelBlockDropIndexFromRects(
 getTopLevelBlockElements(editor).map((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect()),
 clientY
 );
}

export function getTopLevelBlockDragPreview(
 editor: Editor,
 blockIndex: number,
 blockEndIndex = blockIndex
): {
 previewLabel: string;
 previewHtml: string;
 sourceBlockRect: DOMRect;
} | null {
 const sourceElements = getTopLevelBlockElements(editor).slice(Math.min(blockIndex, blockEndIndex), Math.max(blockIndex, blockEndIndex) + 1);
 if (sourceElements.length === 0) {
 return null;
 }

 const sourceBlockRect = resolveBoundingRect(sourceElements.map((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect()));
 return {
 previewLabel:
 sourceElements.map((element) => element.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() || "").filter(Boolean).join(" ") ||
 `Moving ${sourceElements.length} blocks`,
 previewHtml: createInertTopLevelBlockPreviewHtml(sourceElements),
 sourceBlockRect
 };
}

export function isPointWithinTopLevelBlockDropZone(
 editor: Editor,
 clientX: number,
 gutterWidth: number
): boolean {
 const blockRects = getTopLevelBlockElements(editor).map((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect());
 if (!blockRects.length) {
 return false;
 }

 const left = Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER_FALLBACK, Math.min(...blockRects.map((rect) => rect.left)) - gutterWidth);
 const right = Math.max(...blockRects.map((rect) => rect.right));
 return clientX >= left && clientX <= right;
}

export function isValidBlockDragDestinationIndex(
 childCount: number,
 sourceBlockIndex: number,
 sourceBlockEndIndex: number,
 destinationIndex: number | null
): boolean {
 if (destinationIndex === null || childCount <= 0 || sourceBlockIndex < 0 || sourceBlockEndIndex < sourceBlockIndex || sourceBlockEndIndex >= childCount) {
 return false;
 }

 const normalizedDestinationIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(destinationIndex, childCount));
 return normalizedDestinationIndex < sourceBlockIndex || normalizedDestinationIndex > sourceBlockEndIndex + 1;
}

export function getTopLevelBlockInsertionPositionFromDoc(
 doc: Editor["state"]["doc"],
 blockIndex: number
): number | null {
 if (blockIndex < 0 || blockIndex > doc.childCount) {
 return null;
 }

 if (blockIndex === doc.childCount) {
 return doc.content.size;
 }

 let insertionPosition: number | null = null;
 doc.forEach((node, offset, index) => {
 if (index === blockIndex) {
 insertionPosition = offset;
 }
 });

 return insertionPosition;
}

export function buildTopLevelBlockDropIndicatorStyleFromRects(
 input: {
 blockRects: DOMRect[];
 destinationIndex: number;
 lineHeight?: number;
 viewportGutter: number;
 }
): CSSProperties | null {
 const { blockRects, destinationIndex, lineHeight = 2, viewportGutter } = input;
 if (!blockRects.length) {
 return null;
 }

 const clampedDestinationIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(destinationIndex, blockRects.length));
 const targetRect = clampedDestinationIndex >= blockRects.length ? blockRects[blockRects.length - 1]! : blockRects[clampedDestinationIndex]!;

 const left = Math.max(viewportGutter, targetRect.left);
 const width = Math.max(1, targetRect.width);
 const top =
 clampedDestinationIndex === 0
 ? targetRect.top - lineHeight / 2
 : clampedDestinationIndex >= blockRects.length
 ? targetRect.bottom - lineHeight / 2
 : ((blockRects[clampedDestinationIndex - 1]!.bottom + targetRect.top) / 2) - lineHeight / 2;

 return {
 position: "fixed",
 left: `${left}px`,
 top: `${top}px`,
 width: `${width}px`,
 height: `${lineHeight}px`
 };
}

export function buildTopLevelBlockDragFeedbackStyle(input: {
 clientX: number;
 clientY: number;
}): CSSProperties {
 const { clientX, clientY } = input;

 return {
 position: "fixed",
 left: `${Math.round(clientX + 12)}px`,
 top: `${Math.round(clientY + 12)}px`
 };
}

export function buildTopLevelBlockDropIndicatorStyle(
 editor: Editor,
 destinationIndex: number,
 input: {
 lineHeight?: number;
 viewportGutter: number;
 }
): CSSProperties | null {
 const blockRects = getTopLevelBlockElements(editor).map((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect());
 return buildTopLevelBlockDropIndicatorStyleFromRects({
 blockRects,
 destinationIndex,
 lineHeight: input.lineHeight,
 viewportGutter: input.viewportGutter
 });
}

export function moveTopLevelBlock(
 editor: Editor,
 sourceBlockIndex: number,
 destinationIndex: number,
 input: {
 focusTopLevelBlockSelection: (editor: Editor, blockIndex: number) => void;
 getTopLevelBlockRange: (editor: Editor, blockIndex: number) => { from: number; to: number } | null;
 selectTopLevelBlock: (blockIndex: number) => void;
 }
): boolean {
 return moveTopLevelBlocks(editor, sourceBlockIndex, sourceBlockIndex, destinationIndex, {
 ...input,
 selectTopLevelBlockRange: (startBlockIndex) => input.selectTopLevelBlock(startBlockIndex)
 });
}

export function moveTopLevelBlocks(
 editor: Editor,
 sourceStartBlockIndex: number,
 sourceEndBlockIndex: number,
 destinationIndex: number,
 input: {
 focusTopLevelBlockSelection: (editor: Editor, blockIndex: number) => void;
 getTopLevelBlockRange: (editor: Editor, blockIndex: number) => { from: number; to: number } | null;
 selectTopLevelBlockRange: (startBlockIndex: number, endBlockIndex: number) => void;
 }
): boolean {
 const normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex = Math.min(sourceStartBlockIndex, sourceEndBlockIndex);
 const normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex = Math.max(sourceStartBlockIndex, sourceEndBlockIndex);
 if (
 normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex < 0 ||
 normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex < normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex ||
 normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex >= editor.state.doc.childCount
 ) {
 return false;
 }

 const sourceStartRange = input.getTopLevelBlockRange(editor, normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex);
 const sourceEndRange = input.getTopLevelBlockRange(editor, normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex);
 if (!sourceStartRange || !sourceEndRange) {
 return false;
 }

 const normalizedDestinationIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(destinationIndex, editor.state.doc.childCount));
 if (normalizedDestinationIndex >= normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex && normalizedDestinationIndex <= normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex + 1) {
 return false;
 }

 const sourceContent = editor.state.doc.slice(sourceStartRange.from, sourceEndRange.to).content;
 const sourceBlockCount = normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex - normalizedSourceStartBlockIndex + 1;
 const adjustedDestinationIndex =
 normalizedDestinationIndex > normalizedSourceEndBlockIndex + 1
 ? normalizedDestinationIndex - sourceBlockCount
 : normalizedDestinationIndex;
 const draftTransaction = editor.state.tr.delete(sourceStartRange.from, sourceEndRange.to);
 const insertionPosition = getTopLevelBlockInsertionPositionFromDoc(draftTransaction.doc, adjustedDestinationIndex);
 if (insertionPosition === null) {
 return false;
 }

 editor.view.dispatch(draftTransaction.insert(insertionPosition, sourceContent));
 input.focusTopLevelBlockSelection(editor, adjustedDestinationIndex);
 input.selectTopLevelBlockRange(adjustedDestinationIndex, adjustedDestinationIndex + sourceBlockCount - 1);
 return true;
}

function createInertTopLevelBlockPreviewHtml(sourceElements: HTMLElement[]): string {
 const previewHtmlParts: string[] = [];

 for (const sourceElement of sourceElements) {
 const previewBlock = sourceElement.cloneNode(true);
 if (!(previewBlock instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 previewHtmlParts.push(sourceElement.outerHTML);
 continue;
 }

 sanitizeTopLevelBlockPreviewElement(previewBlock);
 previewHtmlParts.push(previewBlock.outerHTML);
 }

 return previewHtmlParts.join("");
}

function sanitizeTopLevelBlockPreviewElement(root: HTMLElement) {
 const previewElements = [root, ...Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("*"))].filter(
 (element): element is HTMLElement => element instanceof HTMLElement
 );

 for (const element of previewElements) {
 element.removeAttribute("id");
 element.removeAttribute("contenteditable");
 element.removeAttribute("draggable");
 element.removeAttribute("spellcheck");
 element.removeAttribute("tabindex");
 element.removeAttribute("aria-selected");
 element.removeAttribute("aria-expanded");
 element.removeAttribute("aria-controls");
 element.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");
 element.removeAttribute("aria-haspopup");
 element.removeAttribute("data-docsera-block-selected");
 element.removeAttribute("data-docsera-block-gutter");
 element.removeAttribute("data-docsera-command-query-owner");
 element.removeAttribute("data-docsera-command-query-inline");
 element.removeAttribute("data-docsera-command-query-inline--helper");

 if (element.classList.contains("docsera-editor-runtime__block--selected")) {
 element.classList.remove("docsera-editor-runtime__block--selected");
 }

 if (element.tagName === "A") {
 element.removeAttribute("href");
 element.removeAttribute("target");
 element.removeAttribute("rel");
 element.removeAttribute("download");
 element.removeAttribute("ping");
 element.removeAttribute("referrerpolicy");
 element.tabIndex = -1;
 continue;
 }

 if (FOCUSABLE_TAG_NAMES.has(element.tagName)) {
 element.tabIndex = -1;
 element.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
 }
 }

const VIEWPORT_GUTTER_FALLBACK = 12;
const FOCUSABLE_TAG_NAMES = new Set(["BUTTON", "INPUT", "SELECT", "TEXTAREA", "SUMMARY", "IFRAME", "OBJECT", "EMBED", "VIDEO", "AUDIO"]);

function resolveBoundingRect(rects: DOMRect[]): DOMRect {
 const firstRect = rects[0];
 if (!firstRect) {
 return new DOMRect(0, 0, 0, 0);
 }

 let left = firstRect.left;
 let top = firstRect.top;
 let right = firstRect.right;
 let bottom = firstRect.bottom;
 for (const rect of rects.slice(1)) {
 left = Math.min(left, rect.left);
 top = Math.min(top, rect.top);
 right = Math.max(right, rect.right);
 bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
 }

 return new DOMRect(left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
}
","export type EditorAutoScrollViewport = {
 element: HTMLElement | null;
 rect: DOMRect;
 scrollTop: number;
 scrollHeight: number;
 clientHeight: number;
 scrollBy: (deltaY: number) => void;
};

export type EditorAutoScrollRequest = {
 deltaY: number;
 direction: "down" | "none" | "up";
};

type EditorAutoScrollSessionInput = {
 getPointerY: () => number | null;
 getTopClearancePx?: () => number;
 getViewport: () => EditorAutoScrollViewport | null;
 onScroll: () => void;
 ownerWindow: Window | null;
};

export const EDITOR_AUTO_SCROLL_EDGE_ZONE_PX = 72;
export const EDITOR_AUTO_SCROLL_MAX_DELTA_PX = 18;

export function resolveEditorAutoScrollRequest(
 viewport: EditorAutoScrollViewport,
 pointerClientY: number,
 input: {
 edgeZonePx?: number;
 maxDeltaPx?: number;
 topClearancePx?: number;
 } = {}
): EditorAutoScrollRequest {
 const edgeZonePx = Math.max(1, input.edgeZonePx ?? EDITOR_AUTO_SCROLL_EDGE_ZONE_PX);
 const maxDeltaPx = Math.max(1, input.maxDeltaPx ?? EDITOR_AUTO_SCROLL_MAX_DELTA_PX);
 const topClearancePx = Math.max(0, input.topClearancePx ?? 0);
 const viewportTop = Math.max(viewport.rect.top, topClearancePx);
 const viewportBottom = viewport.rect.bottom;
 const maxScrollTop = Math.max(0, viewport.scrollHeight - viewport.clientHeight);

 if (viewportBottom <= viewportTop || maxScrollTop <= 0) {
 return { deltaY: 0, direction: "none" };
 }

 if (pointerClientY < viewportTop + edgeZonePx) {
 const proximity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (viewportTop + edgeZonePx - pointerClientY) / edgeZonePx));
 const requestedDelta = -resolveAcceleratedAutoScrollDelta(proximity, maxDeltaPx);
 const deltaY = Math.max(-viewport.scrollTop, requestedDelta);
 return {
 deltaY: Object.is(deltaY, -0) ? 0 : deltaY,
 direction: "up"
 };
 }

 if (pointerClientY > viewportBottom - edgeZonePx) {
 const proximity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (pointerClientY - (viewportBottom - edgeZonePx)) / edgeZonePx));
 const requestedDelta = resolveAcceleratedAutoScrollDelta(proximity, maxDeltaPx);
 const deltaY = Math.min(maxScrollTop - viewport.scrollTop, requestedDelta);
 return {
 deltaY: Object.is(deltaY, -0) ? 0 : deltaY,
 direction: "down"
 };
 }

 return { deltaY: 0, direction: "none" };
}

export function resolveEditorDocumentAutoScrollViewport(input: {
 ownerDocument: Document;
 mainPaneElement: HTMLElement | null;
}): EditorAutoScrollViewport | null {
 const mainPaneViewport = input.mainPaneElement ? buildElementAutoScrollViewport(input.mainPaneElement) : null;
 if (mainPaneViewport && mainPaneViewport.scrollHeight > mainPaneViewport.clientHeight) {
 return mainPaneViewport;
 }

 const scrollingElement = input.ownerDocument.scrollingElement;
 if (!(scrollingElement instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 return null;
 }

 const ownerWindow = input.ownerDocument.defaultView;
 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? scrollingElement.clientHeight;
 return {
 element: scrollingElement,
 rect: new DOMRect(0, 0, ownerWindow?.innerWidth ?? scrollingElement.clientWidth, viewportHeight),
 scrollTop: scrollingElement.scrollTop,
 scrollHeight: scrollingElement.scrollHeight,
 clientHeight: viewportHeight,
 scrollBy: (deltaY) => {
 scrollingElement.scrollTop += deltaY;
 }
 };
}

export function resolveEditorAutoScrollTopClearancePx(input: {
 ownerDocument: Document;
 styleTarget: HTMLElement | null;
}): number {
 const ownerWindow = input.ownerDocument.defaultView;
 const candidates = [input.styleTarget, input.ownerDocument.documentElement].filter(
 (candidate): candidate is HTMLElement => candidate instanceof HTMLElement
 );

 for (const candidate of candidates) {
 const computedStyle = ownerWindow?.getComputedStyle(candidate);
 const scrollPaddingTop = parsePixelValue(computedStyle?.scrollPaddingTop ?? null);
 if (scrollPaddingTop !== null && scrollPaddingTop > 0) {
 return scrollPaddingTop;
 }

 const headingMargin = parsePixelValue(computedStyle?.getPropertyValue("--docsera-workspace-heading-scroll-margin") ?? null);
 if (headingMargin !== null && headingMargin > 0) {
 return headingMargin;
 }

 const headerHeight = parsePixelValue(computedStyle?.getPropertyValue("--docsera-header-height") ?? null);
 if (headerHeight !== null && headerHeight > 0) {
 return headerHeight;
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

export function createEditorAutoScrollSession(input: EditorAutoScrollSessionInput) {
 const ownerWindow = input.ownerWindow ?? window;
 let frameId: number | null = null;
 let active = true;

 const stop = () => {
 active = false;
 if (frameId !== null) {
 ownerWindow.cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
 frameId = null;
 }
 };

 const tick = () => {
 frameId = null;
 if (!active) {
 return;
 }

 const pointerY = input.getPointerY();
 const viewport = input.getViewport();
 if (pointerY === null || !viewport) {
 return;
 }

 const request = resolveEditorAutoScrollRequest(viewport, pointerY, {
 topClearancePx: input.getTopClearancePx?.() ?? 0
 });
 if (request.deltaY === 0) {
 return;
 }

 viewport.scrollBy(request.deltaY);
 input.onScroll();
 frameId = ownerWindow.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 };

 const update = () => {
 if (!active || frameId !== null) {
 return;
 }

 frameId = ownerWindow.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 };

 return {
 stop,
 update
 };
}

function buildElementAutoScrollViewport(element: HTMLElement): EditorAutoScrollViewport {
 return {
 element,
 rect: element.getBoundingClientRect(),
 scrollTop: element.scrollTop,
 scrollHeight: element.scrollHeight,
 clientHeight: element.clientHeight,
 scrollBy: (deltaY) => {
 element.scrollTop += deltaY;
 }
 };
}

function resolveAcceleratedAutoScrollDelta(proximity: number, maxDeltaPx: number): number {
 return Math.max(1, Math.round(2 + (maxDeltaPx - 2) * proximity * proximity));
}

function parsePixelValue(value: string | null): number | null {
 if (!value) {
 return null;
 }

 const parsed = Number.parseFloat(value);
 return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number): number => Math.max(min, Math.min(value, max));

 try {
 editorDom = editor?.view?.dom instanceof HTMLElement ? editor.view.dom : null;
 } catch {

 }

 ? "dark"

}

function getEventComposedPath(event: Event): EventTarget[] {
 if (typeof event.composedPath === "function") {
 return event.composedPath().filter((entry): entry is EventTarget => entry !== null && entry !== undefined);
 }

 return event.target ? [event.target] : [];
}

function resolveHandleStateFromEvent(event: Event): TableHandleState | null {
 for (const entry of getEventComposedPath(event)) {
 const handleState = resolveHandleStateFromTarget(entry);
 if (handleState) {

 }
 }

 return resolveHandleStateFromTarget(event.target);
}

function isEventInsideOpenTableMenu(

 if (menuElement?.contains(entry)) {

function clearNativeSelectionIfCellSelection(editor: TiptapEditor | null): void {

function normalizeCellRect(cellRect: {
 bottom: number;
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
}): {
 bottom: number;
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
} {

 bottom: Number(cellRect.bottom),

 right: Number(cellRect.right),

 };
}

type SelectedTableCellCoordinate = {
 columnIndex: number;
 rowIndex: number;
};

function normalizeSelectedTableCellCoordinates(
 coordinates: SelectedTableCellCoordinate[]
): SelectedTableCellCoordinate[] {
 const uniqueCoordinates = new Map<string, SelectedTableCellCoordinate>();
 for (const coordinate of coordinates) {
 const rowIndex = Number(coordinate.rowIndex);
 const columnIndex = Number(coordinate.columnIndex);
 if (!Number.isFinite(rowIndex) || !Number.isFinite(columnIndex)) {
 continue;
 }

 uniqueCoordinates.set(`${rowIndex}:${columnIndex}`, { columnIndex, rowIndex });
 }

 return Array.from(uniqueCoordinates.values()).sort((left, right) =>
 left.rowIndex === right.rowIndex
 ? left.columnIndex - right.columnIndex
 : left.rowIndex - right.rowIndex
 );
}

function buildSelectedTableCellCoordinates(
 cellRect: {
 bottom: number;
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
 },
): SelectedTableCellCoordinate[] {
 const normalizedCellRect = normalizeCellRect(cellRect);
 const coordinates: SelectedTableCellCoordinate[] = [];

 for (let rowIndex = normalizedCellRect.top; rowIndex < normalizedCellRect.bottom; rowIndex += 1) {
 for (let columnIndex = normalizedCellRect.left; columnIndex < normalizedCellRect.right; columnIndex += 1) {
 coordinates.push({ columnIndex, rowIndex });
 }
 }

 return normalizeSelectedTableCellCoordinates(coordinates);
}

 "0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-text) 10%, transparent)";

 borderColor: input.isActive ? input.primaryColor : "var(--docsera-editor-panel-border)",

 : "color-mix(in srgb, var(--docsera-editor-panel) 94%, var(--docsera-editor-primary) 6%)",

 `box-shadow ${PILL_TRANSITION_DURATION_MS}ms ease`,
 willChange: "width, height, opacity",
 };
}

function buildSelectedTableHandleIndexes(
 selectedCells: SelectedTableCellCoordinate[]
): {
 accentedColumnIndexes: number[];
 accentedRowIndexes: number[];
 selectedColumnIndexes: number[];
 selectedRowIndexes: number[];
} {
 if (selectedCells.length === 1) {
 const [selectedCell] = selectedCells;
 return {
 accentedColumnIndexes: selectedCell.rowIndex === 0 ? [selectedCell.columnIndex] : [],
 accentedRowIndexes: selectedCell.columnIndex === 0 ? [selectedCell.rowIndex] : [],
 selectedColumnIndexes: [selectedCell.columnIndex],
 selectedRowIndexes: [selectedCell.rowIndex],
 };
 }

 const activeColumnIndexes = new Set<number>();
 const activeRowIndexes = new Set<number>();

 for (const cellCoordinate of selectedCells) {
 if (cellCoordinate.rowIndex === 0) {
 activeColumnIndexes.add(cellCoordinate.columnIndex);
 }
 if (cellCoordinate.columnIndex === 0) {
 activeRowIndexes.add(cellCoordinate.rowIndex);
 }
 }

 const selectedColumnIndexes = Array.from(activeColumnIndexes).sort((left, right) => left - right);
 const selectedRowIndexes = Array.from(activeRowIndexes).sort((left, right) => left - right);
 return {
 accentedColumnIndexes: selectedColumnIndexes,
 accentedRowIndexes: selectedRowIndexes,
 selectedColumnIndexes,
 selectedRowIndexes,
 };
}

function resolveSelectedTableCells(editor: TiptapEditor): SelectedTableCellCoordinate[] {
 const selection = editor.state.selection;
 if (selection instanceof CellSelection) {
 let selectedRectRange:
 | {
 bottom: number;
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
 }
 | null = null;

 try {
 selectedRectRange = normalizeCellRect(selectedRect(editor.state));
 } catch {
 selectedRectRange = null;
 }

 if (selectedRectRange) {
 return buildSelectedTableCellCoordinates(selectedRectRange);
 }

 const selectedTableContext = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 const liveCellSelectionRect = selectedTableContext
 ? resolveLiveCellSelectionRect(editor, selectedTableContext)
 : null;
 return liveCellSelectionRect ? buildSelectedTableCellCoordinates(liveCellSelectionRect) : [];
 }

 const textSelection = selection as { $from?: any } | null | undefined;
 let currentRect:
 | {
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
 bottom: number;
 }
 | null = null;
 try {
 currentRect = selectedRect(editor.state);
 } catch {
 currentRect = null;
 }

 if (!textSelection?.$from) {
 return currentRect ? [{ columnIndex: currentRect.left, rowIndex: currentRect.top }] : [];
 }

 const tableContext = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (tableContext) {
 const cellAnchor = findCellPos(editor.state.doc, textSelection.$from.pos);
 if (cellAnchor) {
 const relativeCellPos = cellAnchor.pos - tableContext.tablePos;
 try {
 const cellRect = tableContext.map.findCell(relativeCellPos);
 return [{ columnIndex: cellRect.left, rowIndex: cellRect.top }];
 } catch {
 // Fall through to the manual ancestry scan below.
 }
 }

 const $from = textSelection.$from;
 for (let depth = $from.depth; depth > 0; depth -= 1) {
 const node = $from.node(depth);
 if (node.type.name !== "tableCell" && node.type.name !== "tableHeader") {
 continue;
 }

 const candidateCellPositions = [$from.before(depth) - tableContext.tablePos, $from.start(depth) - tableContext.tablePos];

 for (const relativeCellPos of candidateCellPositions) {
 if (relativeCellPos < 0) {
 continue;
 }

 try {
 const cellRect = tableContext.map.findCell(relativeCellPos);
 return [{ columnIndex: cellRect.left, rowIndex: cellRect.top }];
 } catch {
 // Try the alternate cell boundary offset before giving up on the current ancestor.
 }
 }
 }
 }

 if (currentRect) {
 return [{ columnIndex: currentRect.left, rowIndex: currentRect.top }];
 }

 return [];
}

const getLiveTableContext = (
 editor: TiptapEditor
): TableContext | null => {
 const selection = editor.state.selection as { $anchorCell?: unknown; $from?: unknown } | null | undefined;
 const selectionAnchor =
 selection instanceof CellSelection ? selection.$anchorCell : selection?.$from;
 if (!selectionAnchor) return null;

 const currentTable = findTable(selectionAnchor as Parameters<typeof findTable>[0]);
 if (!currentTable) return null;

 return {
 tablePos: currentTable.pos,
 tableStart: currentTable.start,
 tableNode: currentTable.node,
 map: TableMap.get(currentTable.node),
 };
};

const getLiveTableContextFromTablePos = (
 editor: TiptapEditor,
 tablePos: number
): TableContext | null => {
 const nodeAtTablePos = editor.state.doc.nodeAt(tablePos);
 if (!nodeAtTablePos || nodeAtTablePos.type.name !== "table") return null;

 return {
 tablePos,
 tableStart: tablePos + 1,
 tableNode: nodeAtTablePos,
 map: TableMap.get(nodeAtTablePos),
 };
};

function areHandleStatesEqual(left: TableHandleState | null, right: TableHandleState | null): boolean {
 return left?.kind === right?.kind && left?.index === right?.index;
}

function resolveHandleStateFromTarget(target: EventTarget | null): TableHandleState | null {
 if (!(target instanceof Element)) {
 return null;
 }

 const handle = target.closest("[data-docsera-table-handle='true']");
 if (!(handle instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 return null;
 }

 const kind = handle.dataset.docseraTableHandleKind;
 const index = Number(handle.dataset.docseraTableHandleIndex);
 if ((kind !== "row" && kind !== "column") || Number.isNaN(index)) {
 return null;
 }

 return { kind, index };
}

function resolveActiveTableGeometryElements(editor: TiptapEditor): {
 editorElement: HTMLElement;
 tableElement: HTMLTableElement;
 tableWrapperElement: HTMLElement;
} | null {
 const tableContext = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (!tableContext) {
 return null;
 }

 const nodeDom = editor.view.nodeDOM(tableContext.tablePos);
 let tableElement: HTMLTableElement | null = null;
 let tableWrapperElement: HTMLElement | null = null;
 if (nodeDom instanceof HTMLTableElement) {
 tableElement = nodeDom;
 } else if (nodeDom instanceof HTMLElement) {
 tableWrapperElement = nodeDom.classList.contains("tableWrapper") ? nodeDom : null;
 tableElement = nodeDom.querySelector("table");
 }

 if (!tableElement) {
 return null;
 }

 if (!tableWrapperElement) {
 const wrapperAncestor = tableElement.closest(".tableWrapper");
 tableWrapperElement = wrapperAncestor instanceof HTMLElement ? wrapperAncestor : null;
 }

 if (!(tableWrapperElement instanceof HTMLElement) || !(editor.view.dom instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 return null;
 }

 return {
 editorElement: editor.view.dom,
 tableElement,
 tableWrapperElement,
 };
}

function resolveTableCellAlignmentFromNode(node: ProseMirrorNode | null | undefined): DocseraTableCellAlignment {
 const alignment = node?.attrs?.align;
 return alignment === "left" || alignment === "center" || alignment === "right" ? alignment : "left";
}

function resolveTableColumnAlignment(editor: TiptapEditor, context: TableContext, columnIndex: number): DocseraTableCellAlignment {
 const boundedColumnIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(columnIndex, context.map.width - 1));
 let resolvedAlignment: DocseraTableCellAlignment | null = null;

 for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < context.map.height; rowIndex += 1) {
 const relativeCellPos = context.map.map[rowIndex * context.map.width + boundedColumnIndex];
 if (typeof relativeCellPos !== "number") {
 continue;
 }

 const cellNode = editor.state.doc.nodeAt(context.tableStart + relativeCellPos);
 const nextAlignment = resolveTableCellAlignmentFromNode(cellNode);

 : "var(--docsera-editor-muted)",
 }}
 >

Math.max(TABLE_CONTROL_VIEWPORT_EDGE_PX, (renderLayout.rowLeftBorderAnchorXs[menuState.index] ?? renderLayout.tableRect.left) - TABLE_CONTROL_MENU_GAP_PX) : (renderLayout.rowLeftBorderAnchorXs[menuState.index] ?? renderLayout.tableRect.left) + TABLE_CONTROL_MENU_GAP_PX}px`

function resolveTableLayoutFromContext(
 editor: TiptapEditor,
 context: TableContext
): TableLayout | null {
 const nodeDom = editor.view.nodeDOM(context.tablePos);
 let tableElement: HTMLTableElement | null = null;
 let tableWrapperElement: HTMLElement | null = null;
 if (nodeDom instanceof HTMLTableElement) {
 tableElement = nodeDom;
 } else if (nodeDom instanceof HTMLElement) {
 tableWrapperElement = nodeDom.classList.contains("tableWrapper") ? nodeDom : null;
 tableElement = nodeDom.querySelector("table");
 }

 if (!tableElement) {
 return null;
 }

 if (!tableWrapperElement) {
 const wrapperAncestor = tableElement.closest(".tableWrapper");
 tableWrapperElement = wrapperAncestor instanceof HTMLElement ? wrapperAncestor : null;
 }

 if (!(tableWrapperElement instanceof HTMLElement)) {
 return null;
 }

 const tableRect = tableElement.getBoundingClientRect();
 if (tableRect.width <= 0 || tableRect.height <= 0) {
 return null;
 }

 const wrapperRect = tableWrapperElement.getBoundingClientRect();
 const wrapperOverflowX = tableWrapperElement.scrollWidth > tableWrapperElement.clientWidth + 1;
 const wrapperScrollbarHeightPx = Math.max(
 0,
 tableWrapperElement.offsetHeight - tableWrapperElement.clientHeight || WRAPPER_SCROLLBAR_HEIGHT_FALLBACK_PX
 );
 const ownerWindow = tableElement.ownerDocument.defaultView;

 const rowElements = Array.from(tableElement.querySelectorAll("tr"));
 const rowHeights = Array.from({ length: context.map.height }).map((_, rowIndex) => {
 const rowElement = rowElements[rowIndex];
 if (!(rowElement instanceof HTMLTableRowElement)) {
 return Math.max(1, tableRect.height / Math.max(1, context.map.height));
 }

 const rowRect = rowElement.getBoundingClientRect();
 return rowRect.height > 0 ? rowRect.height : Math.max(1, tableRect.height / Math.max(1, context.map.height));
 });
 const rowCenters = Array.from({ length: context.map.height }).map((_, rowIndex) => {
 const rowElement = rowElements[rowIndex];
 if (!rowElement) {
 return tableRect.top + ((rowIndex + 0.5) / Math.max(1, context.map.height)) * tableRect.height;
 }
 const rowRect = rowElement.getBoundingClientRect();
 if (rowRect.width <= 0 || rowRect.height <= 0) {
 return tableRect.top + ((rowIndex + 0.5) / Math.max(1, context.map.height)) * tableRect.height;
 }
 return rowRect.top + rowRect.height / 2;
 });
 const rowLeftBorderAnchorXs = Array.from({ length: context.map.height }).map((_, rowIndex) => {
 const rowElement = rowElements[rowIndex];
 if (!rowElement) {
 return tableRect.left;
 }

 const rowCells = Array.from(rowElement.querySelectorAll(":scope > th, :scope > td"));
 const firstCell = rowCells[0];
 if (!(firstCell instanceof HTMLTableCellElement)) {
 return tableRect.left;
 }

 const rowRect = firstCell.getBoundingClientRect();
 const computedStyle = ownerWindow?.getComputedStyle(firstCell);
 const renderedLeftBorderWidth = computedStyle ? Number.parseFloat(computedStyle.borderLeftWidth) || 0 : 0;
 return rowRect.left + renderedLeftBorderWidth / 2;
 });

 const firstRowCells = rowElements[0]
 ? Array.from(rowElements[0].querySelectorAll(":scope > th, :scope > td"))
 : [];
 const columnWidths = Array.from({ length: context.map.width }).map((_, columnIndex) => {
 const columnCell = firstRowCells[columnIndex];
 if (!(columnCell instanceof HTMLTableCellElement)) {
 return Math.max(1, tableRect.width / Math.max(1, context.map.width));
 }

 const columnRect = columnCell.getBoundingClientRect();
 return columnRect.width > 0 ? columnRect.width : Math.max(1, tableRect.width / Math.max(1, context.map.width));
 });
 const columnCenters = Array.from({ length: context.map.width }).map((_, columnIndex) => {
 const columnCell = firstRowCells[columnIndex];
 if (!columnCell) {
 return tableRect.left + ((columnIndex + 0.5) / Math.max(1, context.map.width)) * tableRect.width;
 }
 const columnRect = columnCell.getBoundingClientRect();
 return columnRect.left + columnRect.width / 2;
 });
 const columnTopBorderAnchorYs = Array.from({ length: context.map.width }).map((_, columnIndex) => {
 const columnCell = firstRowCells[columnIndex];
 if (!(columnCell instanceof HTMLTableCellElement)) {
 return tableRect.top;
 }

 const columnRect = columnCell.getBoundingClientRect();
 const computedStyle = ownerWindow?.getComputedStyle(columnCell);
 const renderedTopBorderWidth = computedStyle ? Number.parseFloat(computedStyle.borderTopWidth) || 0 : 0;
 return columnRect.top + renderedTopBorderWidth / 2;
 });

 return {
 columnCenters,
 columnTopBorderAnchorYs,
 columnWidths,
 map: context.map,
 rowCenters,
 rowHeights,
 rowLeftBorderAnchorXs,
 tableNode: context.tableNode,
 tablePos: context.tablePos,
 tableRect,
 tableStart: context.tableStart,
 tableWrapper: tableWrapperElement,
 wrapperOverflowX,
 wrapperRect,
 wrapperScrollbarHeightPx,
 };
}

function resolveTableLayoutFromTablePos(editor: TiptapEditor, tablePos: number): TableLayout | null {
 const tableContext = getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(editor, tablePos);
 if (!tableContext) {
 return null;
 }

 return resolveTableLayoutFromContext(editor, tableContext);
}

function resolveLiveCellSelectionRect(
 editor: TiptapEditor,
 tableContext: TableContext
):
 | {
 bottom: number;
 left: number;
 right: number;
 top: number;
 }
 | null {
 const selection = editor.state.selection;
 if (!(selection instanceof CellSelection)) {
 return null;
 }

 return normalizeCellRect(
 tableContext.map.rectBetween(
 selection.$anchorCell.pos - tableContext.tableStart,
 selection.$headCell.pos - tableContext.tableStart
 )
 );
}

function resolveSelectedTableIndexes(editor: TiptapEditor): {
 accentedColumnIndexes: number[];
 accentedRowIndexes: number[];
 selectedColumnIndexes: number[];
 selectedRowIndexes: number[];
} {
 const selectedCells = resolveSelectedTableCells(editor);
 return buildSelectedTableIndexesFromCells(selectedCells);
}

function buildSelectedTableIndexesFromCells(
 selectedCells: SelectedTableCellCoordinate[]
): {
 accentedColumnIndexes: number[];
 accentedRowIndexes: number[];
 selectedColumnIndexes: number[];
 selectedRowIndexes: number[];
} {
 if (!selectedCells.length) {
 return {
 accentedColumnIndexes: [],
 accentedRowIndexes: [],
 selectedColumnIndexes: [],
 selectedRowIndexes: [],
 };
 }

 return buildSelectedTableHandleIndexes(selectedCells);
}

function addColumnAtEnd(
 editor: TiptapEditor | null,
 setState: (nextState: TableOverlayState | null) => void
): boolean {
 if (!editor) {
 return false;
 }

 const context = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (!context) {
 return false;
 }

 selectColumn(editor, context, context.map.width - 1);
 if (!editor.commands.addColumnAfter()) {
 return false;
 }

 const refreshedContext = getLiveTableContext(editor) ?? getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(editor, context.tablePos);
 if (refreshedContext) {
 selectColumn(editor, refreshedContext, refreshedContext.map.width - 1);
 }

 const nextLayout = resolveTableLayoutFromContext(editor, refreshedContext ?? context);
 if (nextLayout) {
 setState({
 ...nextLayout,
 ...resolveSelectedTableIndexes(editor),
 });
 }

 return true;
}

function addRowAtEnd(
 editor: TiptapEditor | null,

 return false;

 const context = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (!context) {
 return false;

 selectRow(editor, context, context.map.height - 1);
 if (!editor.commands.addRowAfter()) {
 return false;
 }

 const refreshedContext = getLiveTableContext(editor) ?? getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(editor, context.tablePos);
 if (refreshedContext) {
 selectRow(editor, refreshedContext, refreshedContext.map.height - 1);

 const nextLayout = resolveTableLayoutFromContext(editor, refreshedContext ?? context);
 if (nextLayout) {

 ...nextLayout,
 ...resolveSelectedTableIndexes(editor),
 });
 }

 return true;
}

 if (!context || context.map.width <= 1) {
 return false;

 selectColumn(editor, context, context.map.width - 1);
 if (!editor.commands.deleteColumn()) {
 return false;

 const refreshedContext = getLiveTableContext(editor) ?? getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(editor, context.tablePos);
 if (refreshedContext) {
 selectColumn(editor, refreshedContext, refreshedContext.map.width - 1);

function removeRowAtEnd(
 editor: TiptapEditor | null,

): boolean {
 if (!editor) {
 return false;
 }

 const context = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (!context || context.map.height <= 1) {
 return false;
 }

 selectRow(editor, context, context.map.height - 1);
 if (!editor.commands.deleteRow()) {
 return false;
 }

 const refreshedContext = getLiveTableContext(editor) ?? getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(editor, context.tablePos);
 if (refreshedContext) {
 selectRow(editor, refreshedContext, refreshedContext.map.height - 1);
 }

 const nextLayout = resolveTableLayoutFromContext(editor, refreshedContext ?? context);
 if (nextLayout) {

 });

function runTableMutationWithHistoryTime(editor: TiptapEditor, historyTime: number, run: () => boolean): boolean {
 const originalDispatch = editor.view.dispatch.bind(editor.view);
 let didRun = false;

 editor.view.dispatch = (transaction) => {
 transaction.time = historyTime;
 originalDispatch(transaction);
 };

 try {
 const result = run();
 didRun = result !== false;
 } finally {
 editor.view.dispatch = originalDispatch;
 }

 return didRun;
}

function getTrailingRowStepPx(layout: TableLayout): number {
 return Math.max(1, layout.rowHeights[layout.rowHeights.length - 1] ?? layout.tableRect.height / Math.max(1, layout.map.height));
}

function getTrailingColumnStepPx(layout: TableLayout): number {
 return Math.max(1, layout.columnWidths[layout.columnWidths.length - 1] ?? layout.tableRect.width / Math.max(1, layout.map.width));
}

type TableRailResizeKind = "row" | "column";

type TableRailResizeSession = {
 dragActivated: boolean;
 historyClosed: boolean;
 historyTime: number;
 originBoundaryAxis: number;
 originCount: number;
 originStepPx: number;
 kind: TableRailResizeKind;
 originClientX: number;
 originClientY: number;
 lastClientX: number;
 lastClientY: number;
 ownerDocument: Document;
 pointerId: number;
 pointerCaptureTarget: HTMLButtonElement | null;
 tablePos: number;
};

function useTableRailResizeSession(
 editor: TiptapEditor | null,
 setOverlayState: (nextState: TableOverlayState | null) => void
): {
 handleRailClick: (kind: TableRailResizeKind) => boolean;
 handleRailPointerDown: (
 kind: TableRailResizeKind,
 event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>
 ) => void;
} {
 const sessionRef = useRef<TableRailResizeSession | null>(null);
 const suppressNextClickRef = useRef<TableRailResizeKind | null>(null);

 const getEditorOwnerDocument = useCallback((): Document | null => {
 if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) {
 return null;
 }

 try {
 return editor.view.dom.ownerDocument;
 } catch {
 return null;
 }
 }, [editor]);

 const clearNativeSelectionRanges = useCallback(() => {
 const ownerDocument = getEditorOwnerDocument();
 const selection = ownerDocument?.getSelection();
 if (!selection || selection.rangeCount === 0) {
 return;
 }

 selection.removeAllRanges();
 }, [getEditorOwnerDocument]);

 const clearTableRailCursorLock = useCallback((ownerDocument: Document | null) => {
 ownerDocument?.documentElement.removeAttribute(TABLE_RAIL_CURSOR_LOCK_ATTRIBUTE);
 }, []);

 const lockTableRailCursor = useCallback((ownerDocument: Document, kind: TableRailResizeKind) => {
 ownerDocument.documentElement.setAttribute(TABLE_RAIL_CURSOR_LOCK_ATTRIBUTE, kind);
 }, []);

 const syncLiveTableState = useCallback(
 (session: TableRailResizeSession | null): TableLayout | null => {
 const runtimeEditor = editor;
 if (!runtimeEditor || runtimeEditor.isDestroyed) {
 setOverlayState(null);
 return null;
 }

 if (!session) {
 return null;
 }

 const tableContext = getLiveTableContextFromTablePos(runtimeEditor, session.tablePos);
 if (!tableContext) {
 setOverlayState(null);
 return null;
 }

 const layout = resolveTableLayoutFromContext(runtimeEditor, tableContext);
 if (!layout) {
 setOverlayState(null);
 return null;
 }

 setOverlayState({
 ...layout,
 ...resolveSelectedTableIndexes(runtimeEditor),
 });
 return layout;
 },
 [editor, setOverlayState]
 );

 const ensureTrailingColumnContentVisibility = useCallback(
 (layout: TableLayout): boolean => {
 const maxScrollLeft = Math.max(0, layout.tableWrapper.scrollWidth - layout.tableWrapper.clientWidth);
 if (layout.tableWrapper.scrollLeft > maxScrollLeft) {
 layout.tableWrapper.scrollLeft = maxScrollLeft;
 return true;
 }

 if (layout.tableWrapper.scrollWidth <= layout.tableWrapper.clientWidth) {
 return false;
 }

 const overflow = layout.tableRect.right - layout.wrapperRect.right;
 if (overflow <= 0) {
 return false;
 }

 const nextScrollLeft = clamp(layout.tableWrapper.scrollLeft + overflow, 0, maxScrollLeft);
 if (nextScrollLeft === layout.tableWrapper.scrollLeft) {
 return false;
 }

 layout.tableWrapper.scrollLeft = nextScrollLeft;
 return true;
 },
 []
 );

 const clearSession = useCallback(
 (options: { suppressClick?: boolean } = {}) => {
 const { suppressClick = false } = options;
 const session = sessionRef.current;
 if (session && suppressClick) {
 suppressNextClickRef.current = session.kind;
 }

 if (session?.pointerCaptureTarget) {
 try {
 const hasPointerCapture =
 typeof session.pointerCaptureTarget.hasPointerCapture === "function" &&
 session.pointerCaptureTarget.hasPointerCapture(session.pointerId);
 if (typeof session.pointerCaptureTarget.releasePointerCapture === "function" && hasPointerCapture) {
 session.pointerCaptureTarget.releasePointerCapture(session.pointerId);
 }
 } catch {
 // Ignore pointer-capture cleanup failures during teardown or lost-capture paths.
 }
 }

 clearTableRailCursorLock(session?.ownerDocument ?? null);
 sessionRef.current = null;
 },
 [clearTableRailCursorLock]
 );

 const activateSession = useCallback(
 (session: TableRailResizeSession) => {
 if (session.dragActivated) {
 return;
 }

 session.dragActivated = true;
 lockTableRailCursor(session.ownerDocument, session.kind);
 if (session.pointerCaptureTarget && typeof session.pointerCaptureTarget.setPointerCapture === "function") {
 try {
 session.pointerCaptureTarget.setPointerCapture(session.pointerId);
 } catch {
 // Pointer capture is an enhancement for browser fidelity; the document listeners remain the source of truth.
 }
 }
 if (!session.historyClosed && editor && !editor.isDestroyed) {
 editor.view.dispatch(closeHistory(editor.state.tr));
 session.historyClosed = true;
 }
 clearNativeSelectionRanges();
 syncLiveTableState(session);
 },
 [clearNativeSelectionRanges, editor, lockTableRailCursor, syncLiveTableState]
 );

 const applySessionResizeAtPoint = useCallback(
 (pointerX: number, pointerY: number) => {
 const runtimeEditor = editor;
 const session = sessionRef.current;
 if (!runtimeEditor || runtimeEditor.isDestroyed || !session) {
 return false;
 }

 const liveLayout = syncLiveTableState(session);
 if (!liveLayout) {
 clearSession({ suppressClick: session.dragActivated });
 return false;
 }

 const currentCount = session.kind === "row" ? liveLayout.map.height : liveLayout.map.width;
 const delta =
 session.kind === "row"
 ? pointerY - session.originBoundaryAxis
 : pointerX - session.originBoundaryAxis;
 const targetCount = Math.max(1, session.originCount + Math.trunc(delta / session.originStepPx));
 if (targetCount === currentCount) {
 return true;
 }

 let safety = 0;
 while (safety < 200) {
 safety += 1;
 const nextLiveLayout = syncLiveTableState(session);
 if (!nextLiveLayout) {
 clearSession({ suppressClick: session.dragActivated });
 return false;
 }

 const nextCurrentCount = session.kind === "row" ? nextLiveLayout.map.height : nextLiveLayout.map.width;
 if (nextCurrentCount === targetCount) {
 if (session.kind === "column" && ensureTrailingColumnContentVisibility(nextLiveLayout)) {
 syncLiveTableState(session);
 }
 return true;
 }

 const runMutation =
 targetCount > nextCurrentCount
 ? () => {
 if (session.kind === "row") {
 return addRowAtEnd(runtimeEditor, setOverlayState);
 }

 return addColumnAtEnd(runtimeEditor, setOverlayState);
 }
 : () => {
 if (session.kind === "row") {
 return removeRowAtEnd(runtimeEditor, setOverlayState);
 }

 return removeColumnAtEnd(runtimeEditor, setOverlayState);
 };

 if (!session.historyClosed) {
 editor.view.dispatch(closeHistory(editor.state.tr));
 session.historyClosed = true;
 }

 const didMutate = runTableMutationWithHistoryTime(runtimeEditor, session.historyTime, runMutation);
 if (!didMutate) {
 clearSession({ suppressClick: session.dragActivated });
 return false;
 }

 const mutatedLayout = syncLiveTableState(session);
 if (mutatedLayout && session.kind === "column" && ensureTrailingColumnContentVisibility(mutatedLayout)) {
 syncLiveTableState(session);
 }
 }

 return true;
 },
 [clearSession, editor, ensureTrailingColumnContentVisibility, syncLiveTableState, setOverlayState]
 );

 const handleRailPointerDown = useCallback(
 (kind: TableRailResizeKind, event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
 if (event.button !== 0) {
 return;
 }

 event.stopPropagation();

 if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) {
 return;
 }

 const ownerDocument = event.currentTarget.ownerDocument;
 const context = getLiveTableContext(editor);
 if (!context) {
 return;
 }

 const layout = resolveTableLayoutFromContext(editor, context);
 if (!layout) {
 return;
 }

 const originCount = kind === "row" ? layout.map.height : layout.map.width;
 const originBoundaryAxis = kind === "row" ? layout.tableRect.bottom : layout.tableRect.right;
 const originStepPx = kind === "row" ? getTrailingRowStepPx(layout) : getTrailingColumnStepPx(layout);

 suppressNextClickRef.current = null;
 clearSession();
 lockTableRailCursor(ownerDocument, kind);
 sessionRef.current = {
 dragActivated: false,
 historyClosed: false,
 historyTime: Date.now(),
 originBoundaryAxis,
 originCount,
 originStepPx,
 kind,
 originClientX: event.clientX,
 originClientY: event.clientY,
 lastClientX: event.clientX,
 lastClientY: event.clientY,
 ownerDocument,
 pointerId: event.pointerId,
 pointerCaptureTarget: event.currentTarget,
 tablePos: context.tablePos,
 };
 },
 [clearSession, editor]
 );

 const handleRailClick = useCallback(
 (kind: TableRailResizeKind) => {
 if (suppressNextClickRef.current === kind) {
 suppressNextClickRef.current = null;
 return false;
 }

 if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) {
 return false;
 }

 return kind === "row" ? addRowAtEnd(editor, setOverlayState) : addColumnAtEnd(editor, setOverlayState);
 },
 [editor, setOverlayState]
 );

 useEffect(() => {
 if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) {
 clearSession();
 return;
 }

 const ownerDocument = getEditorOwnerDocument();
 if (!ownerDocument) {
 clearSession();
 return;
 }

 const ownerWindow = ownerDocument.defaultView;
 if (!ownerWindow) {
 clearSession();
 return;
 }

 const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
 const session = sessionRef.current;
 if (!session || session.pointerId !== event.pointerId) {
 return;
 }

 session.lastClientX = event.clientX;
 session.lastClientY = event.clientY;

 const deltaX = event.clientX - session.originClientX;
 const deltaY = event.clientY - session.originClientY;
 const primaryDelta = session.kind === "row" ? deltaY : deltaX;

 if (!session || session.pointerId !== event.pointerId) {

 if (!session || session.pointerId !== event.pointerId) {
 return;
 }

 const handleWindowBlur = () => {

 ownerDocument.addEventListener("pointercancel", handlePointerCancel, true);

 ownerDocument.addEventListener("selectstart", handleSelectStart, true);
 ownerDocument.addEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);

 if (canSubscribeToEditorEvents) {

 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove, true);
 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("pointerup", handlePointerUp, true);
 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("pointercancel", handlePointerCancel, true);
 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("lostpointercapture", handleLostPointerCapture, true);
 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("selectstart", handleSelectStart, true);
 ownerDocument.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", handleVisibilityChange);
 ownerWindow.removeEventListener("blur", handleWindowBlur);
 if (canSubscribeToEditorEvents) {

 return {

 handleRailPointerDown,

}

function selectColumn(editor: TiptapEditor, context: TableContext, columnIndex: number): void {
 const boundedColumnIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(columnIndex, context.map.width - 1));
 const firstCellPos =
 context.tableStart + context.map.positionAt(0, boundedColumnIndex, context.tableNode);
 const lastCellPos =
 context.tableStart +
 context.map.positionAt(context.map.height - 1, boundedColumnIndex, context.tableNode);
 const tr = editor.state.tr;
 tr.setSelection(
 CellSelection.colSelection(tr.doc.resolve(firstCellPos), tr.doc.resolve(lastCellPos))
 );
 editor.view.dispatch(tr);
 editor.view.focus();
 clearNativeSelectionIfCellSelection(editor);
}

function selectRow(editor: TiptapEditor, context: TableContext, rowIndex: number): void {
 const boundedRowIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(rowIndex, context.map.height - 1));
 const firstCellPos =
 context.tableStart + context.map.positionAt(boundedRowIndex, 0, context.tableNode);
 const lastCellPos =
 context.tableStart +
 context.map.positionAt(boundedRowIndex, context.map.width - 1, context.tableNode);
 const tr = editor.state.tr;
 tr.setSelection(
 CellSelection.rowSelection(tr.doc.resolve(firstCellPos), tr.doc.resolve(lastCellPos))
 );
 editor.view.dispatch(tr);
 editor.view.focus();
 clearNativeSelectionIfCellSelection(editor);
}

function getStructuredTableCellContent(node: ProseMirrorNode | null | undefined): JSONContent[] {
 if (!node || (node.type.name !== "tableCell" && node.type.name !== "tableHeader")) {
 return [];
 }

 return node.content.toJSON() as JSONContent[];
}

function collectRowClipboardCells(editor: TiptapEditor, context: TableContext, rowIndex: number): JSONContent[][] {
 const boundedRowIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(rowIndex, context.map.height - 1));
 const cells: JSONContent[][] = [];

 for (let columnIndex = 0; columnIndex < context.map.width; columnIndex += 1) {
 const relativeCellPos = context.map.map[boundedRowIndex * context.map.width + columnIndex];
 if (typeof relativeCellPos !== "number") {
 cells.push([]);
 continue;
 }

 const cellNode = editor.state.doc.nodeAt(context.tableStart + relativeCellPos);
 cells.push(getStructuredTableCellContent(cellNode));
 }

 return cells;
}

function collectColumnClipboardCells(editor: TiptapEditor, context: TableContext, columnIndex: number): JSONContent[][] {
 const boundedColumnIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(columnIndex, context.map.width - 1));
 const cells: JSONContent[][] = [];

 for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < context.map.height; rowIndex += 1) {
 const relativeCellPos = context.map.map[rowIndex * context.map.width + boundedColumnIndex];
 if (typeof relativeCellPos !== "number") {
 cells.push([]);
 continue;
 }

 const cellNode = editor.state.doc.nodeAt(context.tableStart + relativeCellPos);
 cells.push(getStructuredTableCellContent(cellNode));
 }

 return cells;
}

function shouldFlipRowMenu(layout: TableLayout, rowIndex: number, ownerWindow: Window): boolean {
 const rowCenterY = layout.rowCenters[rowIndex];
 return rowCenterY + TABLE_CONTROL_MENU_MIN_HEIGHT_PX / 2 > ownerWindow.innerHeight - TABLE_CONTROL_VIEWPORT_EDGE_PX;
}

function shouldFlipColumnMenu(layout: TableLayout, columnIndex: number, ownerWindow: Window): boolean {
 const columnCenterX = layout.columnCenters[columnIndex];
 return columnCenterX + TABLE_CONTROL_MENU_MIN_WIDTH_PX / 2 > ownerWindow.innerWidth - TABLE_CONTROL_VIEWPORT_EDGE_PX;
}

 if (resolvedSelection) {

 if (nodeName === "accordionContent") {

 if (nodeName === "callout") {

 if (nodeName === "column") {
 isInsideColumn = true;

 if (nodeName === "tableCell" || nodeName === "tableHeader") {
 isInsideTableCellOrHeader = true;

 isInsideAccordion,
 isInsideAccordionContent,
 isInsideCallout,
 isInsideColumn,

 }

 if (mappedOwnerPosResult.deleted) {
 return null;
 }

 const mappedOwnerPos = mappedOwnerPosResult.pos;
 const mappedBlock = getTopLevelBlockAtPosition(transaction.doc, mappedOwnerPos);
 if (!mappedBlock || !mappedBlock.node.isBlock) {

 }

 if (!isBlockSelectionRangeState(state)) {

 }

 const mappedRangeEndPosResult = transaction.mapping.mapResult(state.rangeEndPos, 1);
 if (mappedRangeEndPosResult.deleted) {
 return null;
 }

 const mappedRangeEndPos = mappedRangeEndPosResult.pos;
 const mappedRangeEndBlock = getTopLevelBlockAtPosition(transaction.doc, mappedRangeEndPos);
 if (!mappedRangeEndBlock || !mappedRangeEndBlock.node.isBlock) {

 }

function createBlockSelectionExtension() {
 return Extension.create({
 name: "docseraBlockSelection",

 state: {
 init: () => null,
 apply(transaction, value) {

 if (meta === null) {
 return null;
 }
 if (meta) {
 return mapBlockSelectionState(transaction, meta satisfies BlockSelectionState);
 }

 if (transaction.selectionSet) {
 return null;
 }

 return transaction.docChanged ? mapBlockSelectionState(transaction, value) : value;
 }

 props: {
 decorations(state) {
 const selection = BLOCK_SELECTION_PLUGIN_KEY.getState(state);
 if (!selection) {
 return DecorationSet.empty;
 }

 const selectedBounds = resolveTopLevelBlockSelectionBoundsFromState(state.doc, selection);
 if (!selectedBounds) {

 }

 const decorations: Decoration[] = [];
 for (let blockIndex = selectedBounds.startBlockIndex; blockIndex <= selectedBounds.endBlockIndex; blockIndex += 1) {
 const selectedBlock = getTopLevelBlockRangeFromDoc(state.doc, blockIndex);
 if (!selectedBlock) {

 return DecorationSet.create(state.doc, decorations);
 }

function resolveTopLevelBlockIndexForPosition(editor: Editor, position: number): number | null {
 let blockIndex: number | null = null;

 editor.state.doc.forEach((node, offset, index) => {
 const blockStart = offset + 1;
 const blockEnd = offset + node.nodeSize - 1;
 if (position >= blockStart && position <= blockEnd) {
 blockIndex = index;
 }
 });

 return blockIndex;
}

function getTopLevelBlockAtPosition(doc: Editor["state"]["doc"], position: number): {
 from: number;
 node: (typeof doc)["content"]["content"][number];
 to: number;
} | null {
 let block: {
 from: number;
 node: (typeof doc)["content"]["content"][number];
 to: number;
 } | null = null;

 doc.forEach((node, offset) => {

 block = {
 from: offset,
 node,
 to: offset + node.nodeSize
 };
 }
 });

 return block;
}

function getTopLevelBlockPositionFromDoc(doc: Editor["state"]["doc"], blockIndex: number): number | null {
 let blockPosition: number | null = null;

 doc.forEach((_node, offset, index) => {
 if (index === blockIndex) {

 }
 });

 return blockPosition;
}

function getTopLevelBlockPosition(editor: Editor, blockIndex: number): number | null {
 return getTopLevelBlockPositionFromDoc(editor.state.doc, blockIndex);
}

function getTopLevelBlockRangeFromDoc(

 blockIndex: number
): { from: number; to: number } | null {
 if (blockIndex < 0 || blockIndex >= doc.childCount) {
 return null;
 }

 let blockRange: { from: number; to: number } | null = null;
 doc.forEach((node, offset, index) => {
 if (index === blockIndex) {
 blockRange = {
 from: offset,
 to: offset + node.nodeSize
 };
 }
 });

 return blockRange;
}

function getTopLevelBlockNodeFromDoc(
 doc: Editor["state"]["doc"],
 blockIndex: number
): Editor["state"]["doc"]["content"]["content"][number] | null {

function getTopLevelImageNodePositionFromDoc(doc: Editor["state"]["doc"], blockIndex: number): number | null {

function updateTopLevelImageAttrs(
 editor: Editor,
 blockIndex: number,

): boolean {
 const runtimeNode = getTopLevelBlockNodeFromDoc(editor.state.doc, blockIndex);
 if (!runtimeNode || runtimeNode.type.name !== "image") {
 return false;
 }

 const position = getTopLevelImageNodePositionFromDoc(editor.state.doc, blockIndex);
 if (position === null) {
 return false;
 }

 const liveAttrs = canonicalizeDocseraImageAttrs(runtimeNode.attrs);
 const nextAttrs = updater(liveAttrs);
 if (
 liveAttrs.mediaId === nextAttrs.mediaId &&
 liveAttrs.darkMediaId === nextAttrs.darkMediaId &&
 liveAttrs.alt === nextAttrs.alt &&
 liveAttrs.caption === nextAttrs.caption &&
 liveAttrs.frame === nextAttrs.frame &&
 liveAttrs.align === nextAttrs.align &&
 liveAttrs.widthPct === nextAttrs.widthPct
 ) {
 return false;
 }

 let didUpdate = false;
 editor
 .chain()
 .focus(undefined, { scrollIntoView: false })
 .command(({ tr, dispatch }) => {
 tr.setNodeMarkup(position, undefined, nextAttrs);
 dispatch?.(tr);
 didUpdate = true;
 return true;
 })
 .run();
 return didUpdate;
}

function getImageControlButtonRect(overlayRoot: HTMLElement, blockIndex: number, kind: string): DOMRect | null {

function resolveBlockSelectionStateFromDoc(
 doc: Editor["state"]["doc"],
 blockIndex: number
): BlockSelectionState | null {
 const ownerPos = getTopLevelBlockPositionFromDoc(doc, blockIndex);
 if (ownerPos === null) {
 return null;
 }

 const ownerBlock = getTopLevelBlockNodeFromDoc(doc, blockIndex);
 if (!ownerBlock || !ownerBlock.isBlock) {
 return null;
 }

 return {
 ownerPos
 };
}

function getTopLevelBlockSelectionOffset(
 node: Editor["state"]["doc"]["content"]["content"][number]
): number | "continuation" {
 switch (node.type.name) {
 case "accordion":
 return 3;
 case "blockquote":
 return 2;
 case "table":
 return 4;
 case "bulletList":
 case "orderedList":
 case "taskList":
 return 3;
 case "horizontalRule":
 return "continuation";

 return 1;
 }
}

function isTopLevelListBlock(

}

function canSafelyConvertTopLevelListToNonList(

function getTopLevelBlockInlineContent(

): Fragment {
 if (node.type.name === "blockquote") {

 if (paragraph?.type.name === "paragraph") {
 return paragraph.content;
 }
 }

 if (isTopLevelListBlock(node)) {

 const paragraph = listItem?.firstChild;
 if (paragraph?.type.name === "paragraph") {

function applyTopLevelBlockSelectionToTransaction(

 const selectionOffset = getTopLevelBlockSelectionOffset(targetNode);

 if (nextSelection) {
 nextTransaction = nextTransaction.setMeta(BLOCK_SELECTION_PLUGIN_KEY, nextSelection);

 selectionOffset === "continuation"
 ? Math.min(blockRange.from + targetNode.nodeSize + 1, Math.max(1, transaction.doc.content.size))
 : Math.min(blockRange.from + selectionOffset, Math.max(1, transaction.doc.content.size));

 nextTransaction = nextTransaction.setSelection(TextSelection.create(nextTransaction.doc, selectionAnchor));
 } catch {

 const { $from } = selection;
 if (
 $from.depth !== 1 ||
 $from.parent.type.name !== "paragraph" ||
 $from.parent.content.size !== 0 ||
 $from.parentOffset !== 0
 ) {
 return null;
 }

 const blockIndex = $from.index(0);
 if (blockIndex <= 0) {

 const blockquotePosition = getTopLevelBlockPositionFromDoc(editor.state.doc, blockIndex - 1);
 if (paragraphPosition === null || blockquotePosition === null) {

 }

 const paragraph = getTopLevelBlockAtPosition(editor.state.doc, paragraphPosition);
 const blockquote = getTopLevelBlockAtPosition(editor.state.doc, blockquotePosition);

 return {

function handleBlockquoteExitBackspace(editor: Editor): boolean {

 let transaction = editor.state.tr.delete(boundary.paragraph.from, boundary.paragraph.to);

 }

 transaction = transaction.setSelection(TextSelection.create(transaction.doc, resolvedSelection.from)).scrollIntoView();
 editor.view.dispatch(transaction);
 return true;
}

function createCommandQueryPresentationExtension() {

 const { selection } = editor.state;
 if (!isTextSelection(selection) || !selection.empty || !editor.isEditable) {
 return null;
 }

 const { $from } = selection;
 const parent = $from.parent;
 if (!parent.isTextblock || parent.type.spec.code) {

 }

 for (let depth = $from.depth; depth > 0; depth -= 1) {
 if ($from.node(depth).type.name === "accordionTitle") {

 if (text.length > 0) {

 blockIndex,
 ownerPos: $from.before($from.depth),

 to: selection.to
 };

function getCaretBounds(editor: Editor): DOMRect | null {

 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientHeight;
 const maxSurfaceWidth = Math.max(1, viewportWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const maxSurfaceHeight = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const clampedWidth = Math.max(1, Math.min(width, maxSurfaceWidth));
 const clampedHeight = Math.max(1, Math.min(height, maxSurfaceHeight));
 const left = Math.min(Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, rect.left), Math.max(VIEWPORT_GUTTER, viewportWidth - clampedWidth - VIEWPORT_GUTTER));

function resolveCommandSelectorPlacement(ownerDocument: Document, rect: DOMRect, height: number): CommandSelectorPlacement {

 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientHeight;
 const maxSurfaceHeight = Math.max(1, Math.min(height, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2));
 const belowRoom = Math.max(0, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER - rect.bottom - POPOVER_GAP);
 const aboveRoom = Math.max(0, rect.top - VIEWPORT_GUTTER - POPOVER_GAP);

 return "below";

 if (aboveRoom >= maxSurfaceHeight) {
 return "above";
 }

function resolveConstrainedSurfaceHeight(

 height: number,

 const ownerWindow = ownerDocument.defaultView;
 const viewportHeight = ownerWindow?.innerHeight ?? ownerDocument.documentElement.clientHeight;
 const viewportAvailableHeight = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER * 2);
 const sideAvailableHeight =
 placement === "above"
 ? Math.max(1, rect.top - VIEWPORT_GUTTER - POPOVER_GAP)
 : Math.max(1, viewportHeight - VIEWPORT_GUTTER - rect.bottom - POPOVER_GAP);
