<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, GlideSysAttachment, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
const DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_page";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_change_set";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_ENTRY_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_change_entry";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_edit_lease";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_icon_asset";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_member_mutation_command";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MUTATION_CLAIM_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_mutation_claim";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PAGE_SNAPSHOT_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_page_snapshot";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_BATCH_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_removal_batch";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_MEMBER_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_removal_member";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_snapshot_set";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId)
        return null;
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    return record.get("sys_id", sysId) ? mapWorkspaceRecord(record) : null;
}
function loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug) {
    const slug = cleanText(workspaceSlug);
    if (!slug)
        return null;
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    record.addQuery("workspace_slug", slug);
    record.setLimit(1);
    record.query();
    return record.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(record) : null;
}
function deleteRowsByConfiguredQuery(tableName, configureQuery) {
    const rows = new GlideRecord(tableName);
    if (!configureQuery(rows))
        return;
    rows.deleteMultiple();
}
function addRequiredQuery(rows, fieldName, value) {
    const cleanValue = cleanText(value);
    if (!cleanValue)
        return false;
    rows.addQuery(fieldName, cleanValue);
    return true;
}
function countRecordsByField(tableName, fieldName, value) {
    const cleanValue = cleanText(value);
    if (!cleanValue)
        return 0;
    const rows = new GlideRecord(tableName);
    rows.addQuery(fieldName, cleanValue);
    rows.query();
    let count = 0;
    while (rows.next())
        count += 1;
    return count;
}
function recordExists(tableName, sysId) {
    const cleanSysId = cleanText(sysId);
    if (!cleanSysId)
        return false;
    const row = new GlideRecord(tableName);
    return row.get("sys_id", cleanSysId);
}
function listAttachments(tableName, tableSysId) {
    const rows = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
    rows.addQuery("table_name", tableName);
    rows.addQuery("table_sys_id", cleanText(tableSysId));
    rows.query();
    const attachmentSysIds = [];
    while (rows.next()) {
        const sysId = cleanText(rows.getUniqueValue());
        if (sysId)
            attachmentSysIds.push(sysId);
    }
    return attachmentSysIds;
}
function listIconAssetAttachments(workspaceSysId) {
    const assets = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE);
    assets.addQuery("workspace", cleanText(workspaceSysId));
    assets.query();
    const attachmentSysIds = [];
    while (assets.next()) {
        const attachmentSysId = cleanText(assets.getValue("attachment"));
        if (attachmentSysId)
            attachmentSysIds.push(attachmentSysId);
    }
    return attachmentSysIds;
}
function listPageSysIds(workspaceSysId) {
    const pages = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    pages.addQuery("workspace", cleanText(workspaceSysId));
    pages.query();
    const pageSysIds = [];
    while (pages.next()) {
        const pageSysId = cleanText(pages.getUniqueValue());
        if (pageSysId)
            pageSysIds.push(pageSysId);
    }
    return pageSysIds;
}
function listSysIdsByField(tableName, fieldName, value) {
    const cleanValue = cleanText(value);
    if (!cleanValue)
        return [];
    const rows = new GlideRecord(tableName);
    rows.addQuery(fieldName, cleanValue);
    rows.query();
    const sysIds = [];
    while (rows.next()) {
        const sysId = cleanText(rows.getUniqueValue());
        if (sysId)
            sysIds.push(sysId);
    }
    return sysIds;
}
function listChangeSetSysIds(workspaceSysId) {
    return listSysIdsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE, "workspace", workspaceSysId);
}
function listSnapshotSetSysIds(workspaceSysId) {
    return listSysIdsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SET_TABLE, "workspace", workspaceSysId);
}
function listRemovalBatchSysIds(changeSetSysIds) {
    const removalBatchSysIds = [];
    for (const changeSetSysId of changeSetSysIds) {
        removalBatchSysIds.push(...listSysIdsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_BATCH_TABLE, "change_set", changeSetSysId));
    }
    return removalBatchSysIds;
}
function markWorkspaceInactiveTombstone(workspace) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(workspace.sysId);
    if (!workspaceSysId)
        return null;
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId))
        return null;
    record.setValue("status", "inactive");
    record.setValue("admin_group", null);
    record.setValue("editor_group", null);
    record.setValue("pending_change_set", null);
    record.setValue("published_snapshot_set", null);
    record.setValue("icon_type", "builtin");
    record.setValue("icon_key", "docsera-workspace");
    record.setValue("icon_label", "Docsera workspace");
    record.setValue("icon_asset_path", null);
    if (!cleanText(record.update()))
        return null;
    const refreshed = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    return refreshed.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId) ? mapWorkspaceRecord(refreshed) : null;
}
function commitWorkspaceInactiveTombstone(workspace) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(workspace.sysId);
    if (!workspaceSysId)
        return null;
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId))
        return null;
    record.setValue("status", "inactive");
    if (!cleanText(record.update()))
        return null;
    const refreshed = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    return refreshed.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId) ? mapWorkspaceRecord(refreshed) : null;
}
function createWorkspaceGroupCommand(workspace, mutationKind) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(workspace.sysId);
    const userSysId = cleanText(gs.getUserID());
    if (!workspaceSysId || !userSysId)
        return null;
    const command = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE);
    command.initialize();
    command.setValue("workspace", workspaceSysId);
    command.setValue("target_user", userSysId);
    command.setValue("mutation_kind", mutationKind);
    command.setValue("access_level", "");
    command.setValue("requested_by", userSysId);
    command.setValue("state", "requested");
    return cleanText(command.insert()) || null;
}
function readWorkspaceGroupCommandState(commandSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(commandSysId);
    if (!sysId)
        return "unavailable";
    const command = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE);
    if (!command.get("sys_id", sysId))
        return "unavailable";
    const state = cleanText(command.getValue("state"));
    return state === "succeeded" || state === "failed" || state === "requested" ? state : "unavailable";
}
function createGroupDeletionCommand(workspace) {
    return createWorkspaceGroupCommand(workspace, "delete_workspace_groups");
}
function createGroupDeletionValidationCommand(workspace) {
    const commandSysId = createWorkspaceGroupCommand(workspace, "validate_workspace_group_deletion");
    return readWorkspaceGroupCommandState(commandSysId ?? "");
}
function groupExists(groupSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(groupSysId);
    if (!sysId)
        return false;
    const group = new GlideRecord("sys_user_group");
    return group.get("sys_id", sysId);
}
function verifyGroupsDeleted(workspace) {
    return !groupExists(workspace.adminGroupSysId) && !groupExists(workspace.editorGroupSysId);
}
function verifyCleanupComplete(input) {
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MUTATION_CLAIM_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_ICON_ASSET_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_MUTATION_COMMAND_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SET_TABLE, "workspace", input.workspaceSysId) > 0)
        return false;
    for (const changeSetSysId of input.changeSetSysIds) {
        if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_ENTRY_TABLE, "change_set", changeSetSysId) > 0)
            return false;
        if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_BATCH_TABLE, "change_set", changeSetSysId) > 0)
            return false;
    }
    for (const removalBatchSysId of input.removalBatchSysIds) {
        if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_MEMBER_TABLE, "removal_batch", removalBatchSysId) > 0)
            return false;
    }
    for (const snapshotSetSysId of input.snapshotSetSysIds) {
        if (countRecordsByField(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PAGE_SNAPSHOT_TABLE, "snapshot_set", snapshotSetSysId) > 0)
            return false;
    }
    for (const attachmentSysId of [...input.workspaceAttachmentSysIds, ...input.iconAttachmentSysIds]) {
        if (recordExists("sys_attachment", attachmentSysId))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}
function createDefaultDependencies() {

        createGroupDeletionValidationCommand,
        commitWorkspaceInactiveTombstone,
        deleteAttachment: (attachmentSysId) => new GlideSysAttachment().deleteAttachment(cleanText(attachmentSysId)),
        deleteChangeEntriesByChangeSet: (changeSetSysId) => deleteRowsByConfiguredQuery(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_ENTRY_TABLE, (rows) => addRequiredQuery(rows, "change_set", changeSetSysId)),

function resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input) {

export function createWorkspaceDeletionService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async deleteWorkspace(input) {
            const workspace = resolveWorkspace(dependencies, input);
            if (!workspace || !cleanText(workspace.sysId)) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
            }
            if (!dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace).canAdminWorkspace) {
                return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "You do not have permission to delete this workspace.", status: 403 };
            }
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(workspace.sysId);
            const deletingActiveWorkspace = workspace.status !== "inactive";
            const hasGroupReferences = Boolean(cleanText(workspace.adminGroupSysId) || cleanText(workspace.editorGroupSysId));
            try {
                const pageSysIds = dependencies.listPageSysIds(workspaceSysId);
                const changeSetSysIds = dependencies.listChangeSetSysIds(workspaceSysId);
                const snapshotSetSysIds = dependencies.listSnapshotSetSysIds(workspaceSysId);
                const removalBatchSysIds = dependencies.listRemovalBatchSysIds(changeSetSysIds);
                const workspaceAttachmentSysIds = dependencies.listAttachments(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE, workspaceSysId);
                const iconAttachmentSysIds = dependencies.listIconAssetAttachments(workspaceSysId);
                if (deletingActiveWorkspace && dependencies.createGroupDeletionValidationCommand(workspace) !== "succeeded") {
                    return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace access groups could not be deleted. The workspace was not deleted.", status: 500 };
                }
                const committedWorkspace = dependencies.commitWorkspaceInactiveTombstone(workspace);
                if (!committedWorkspace || committedWorkspace.status !== "inactive" || cleanText(committedWorkspace.slug) !== cleanText(workspace.slug)) {
                    return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace deletion could not be started. The workspace was not deleted.", status: 500 };
                }
                for (const attachmentSysId of workspaceAttachmentSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deleteAttachment(attachmentSysId);
                }
                for (const attachmentSysId of iconAttachmentSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deleteAttachment(attachmentSysId);
                }
                dependencies.deleteMemberMutationCommandsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                dependencies.deleteMutationClaimsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                for (const changeSetSysId of changeSetSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deleteChangeEntriesByChangeSet(changeSetSysId);
                }
                for (const removalBatchSysId of removalBatchSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deleteRemovalMembersByBatch(removalBatchSysId);
                }
                for (const changeSetSysId of changeSetSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deleteRemovalBatchesByChangeSet(changeSetSysId);
                }
                for (const snapshotSetSysId of snapshotSetSysIds) {
                    dependencies.deletePageSnapshotsBySnapshotSet(snapshotSetSysId);
                }
                dependencies.deleteSnapshotSetsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                dependencies.deleteWorkspaceChangeSetsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                dependencies.deleteWorkspaceEditLeasesByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                dependencies.deleteIconAssetsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                dependencies.deletePagesByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                if (!dependencies.verifyCleanupComplete({
                    changeSetSysIds,
                    iconAttachmentSysIds,
                    pageSysIds,
                    removalBatchSysIds,
                    snapshotSetSysIds,
                    workspaceAttachmentSysIds,
                    workspaceSysId

                    return { deletionCommitted: true, kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace deletion started, but cleanup could not be completed. Please retry deletion cleanup.", status: 500 };
                }
                if (hasGroupReferences) {
                    if (!dependencies.createGroupDeletionCommand(committedWorkspace) || !dependencies.verifyGroupsDeleted(workspace)) {
                        return { deletionCommitted: true, kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace deletion started, but cleanup could not be completed. Please retry deletion cleanup.", status: 500 };
                    }
                    dependencies.deleteMemberMutationCommandsByWorkspace(workspaceSysId);
                    if (!dependencies.verifyGroupsDeleted(workspace) || !dependencies.verifyCleanupComplete({
                        changeSetSysIds,
                        iconAttachmentSysIds,
                        pageSysIds,
                        removalBatchSysIds,
                        snapshotSetSysIds,
                        workspaceAttachmentSysIds,
                        workspaceSysId

                        return { deletionCommitted: true, kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace deletion started, but cleanup could not be completed. Please retry deletion cleanup.", status: 500 };
                    }

                const tombstone = dependencies.markWorkspaceInactiveTombstone(committedWorkspace);
                if (!tombstone || tombstone.status !== "inactive" || cleanText(tombstone.slug) !== cleanText(workspace.slug)) {

            }
        }

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { buildWorkspaceListItem, buildWorkspaceListResult, filterWorkspacesByName } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { canCurrentUserCreateWorkspaces, evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function queryActiveWorkspaces() {
    const workspaces = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    workspaces.addQuery("status", "active");
    workspaces.orderBy("name");
    workspaces.query();
    const results = [];
    while (workspaces.next()) {
        results.push(mapWorkspaceRecord(workspaces));
    }
    return results;
}
function createCapabilityMap(workspaces) {
    const capabilitiesBySlug = new Map();
    for (const workspace of workspaces) {
        capabilitiesBySlug.set(workspace.slug, evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace));
    }
    return capabilitiesBySlug;
}
function buildAccessibleWorkspaceView(workspace) {
    return buildWorkspaceListItem(workspace, evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace));
}
export function createServiceNowWorkspaceCatalogService() {
    return {
        async getWorkspace(workspaceSlug) {
            const slug = cleanText(workspaceSlug);
            if (!slug) {
                return null;
            }
            const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
            record.addQuery("workspace_slug", slug);
            record.addQuery("status", "active");
            record.setLimit(1);
            record.query();
            if (!record.next()) {
                return null;
            }
            const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
            return buildAccessibleWorkspaceView(workspace);
        },
        async listWorkspaces(query = {}) {
            const workspaces = queryActiveWorkspaces();
            const nameMatchedWorkspaces = filterWorkspacesByName(workspaces, query.searchText ?? "");
            const capabilitiesBySlug = createCapabilityMap(nameMatchedWorkspaces);
            return buildWorkspaceListResult(workspaces, capabilitiesBySlug, query, canCurrentUserCreateWorkspaces());
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCatalog.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>aef2fd66f772457c82d37896ba4177cb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCatalog.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_aef2fd66f772457c82d37896ba4177cb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function summarizeRequestBody(body) {
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const title = cleanText(body.title);
    const parentPageSysId = cleanText(body.parentPageSysId);
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, titlePresent: Boolean(title), titleLength: title.length, parentPageSysIdPresent: Boolean(parentPageSysId), parentPageSysIdLength: parentPageSysId.length };
}
function logUnexpectedPageCreationError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page creation failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page creation] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    if (!row.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response))
            return;
        if (lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority)
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = service.createPage({
            authority,
            title: cleanText(body.title),
            parentPageSysId: cleanText(body.parentPageSysId) || null,
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "recovery_required"
                            ? "recovery_required"
                            : result.code === "unsupported"
                                ? "unsupported"
                                : "invalid",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? {
                            currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision
                        }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(201);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                page: result.result.page,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedPageCreationError(error, {
            ...summarizeRequestBody(readRequestBody(request))
        });
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Something went wrong while creating the page. The page was not created. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-create-page.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>d62d283c4ef640bc857d8758c2c74972</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-create-page.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_d62d283c4ef640bc857d8758c2c74972</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { loadWorkspaceBySlug, listWorkspacePages } from "./serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { deletePageRecord, savePageSettingsRecord } from "./serviceNowPagePersistence.ts";
import { collectPageSubtreeSysIds, pickNextVisiblePageAfterDelete, resolvePagePublicationState, validatePageSettingsSlug, validatePageSettingsTitle } from "./serverPageDomain.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedPageSettingsError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page settings failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page settings] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return Promise.resolve(mapWorkspaceRecord(record));
}
function findPageBySysId(pages, pageSysId) {
    const normalizedPageSysId = cleanText(pageSysId);
    if (!normalizedPageSysId) {
        return null;
    }
    return pages.find((candidate) => cleanText(candidate.sysId) === normalizedPageSysId) ?? null;
}
function normalizePageSettingsResult(page) {
    return savePageSettingsRecord(page);
}
export function createPageSettingsService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async savePageSettings(input) {
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
            const pageSysId = cleanText(input.pageSysId);
            const title = cleanText(input.title);
            const slug = cleanText(input.slug);
            if (!workspaceSlug && !workspaceSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (!pageSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A page reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (!title) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page title is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const workspace = workspaceSysId && typeof dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId === "function"
                ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId)
                : workspaceSlug
                    ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug)
                    : null;
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (workspaceSlug && workspace.slug !== workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (!capability.canEditWorkspace && !capability.canAdminWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to edit page settings in this workspace."
                };
            }
            const pages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId);
            const currentPage = findPageBySysId(pages, pageSysId);
            if (!currentPage) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (cleanText(currentPage.workspaceSysId) !== workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found in this workspace.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const titleValidation = validatePageSettingsTitle(title);
            if (!titleValidation.valid) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: titleValidation.error,
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const slugValidation = validatePageSettingsSlug(slug, pages, workspace.sysId, currentPage.sysId);
            if (!slugValidation.valid) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: slugValidation.error,
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const nextPage = {
                ...currentPage,
                draftTitle: titleValidation.value,
                draftSlug: slugValidation.normalizedValue,
                draftSlugNormalized: slugValidation.normalizedValue
            };
            const savedPage = await dependencies.savePage({
                ...nextPage,
                publicationState: resolvePagePublicationState(nextPage)
            });
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                page: savedPage
            };
        },
        async deletePage(input) {
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
            const pageSysId = cleanText(input.pageSysId);
            if (!workspaceSlug && !workspaceSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (!pageSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A page reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const workspace = workspaceSysId && typeof dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId === "function"
                ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId)
                : workspaceSlug
                    ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug)
                    : null;
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (workspaceSlug && workspace.slug !== workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (!capability.canEditWorkspace && !capability.canAdminWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to delete pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            const pages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId, { activeOnly: false });
            const currentPage = findPageBySysId(pages, pageSysId);
            if (!currentPage) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (cleanText(currentPage.workspaceSysId) !== workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found in this workspace.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const subtreeIds = collectPageSubtreeSysIds(pages, currentPage.sysId);
            const subtreePages = pages.filter((page) => subtreeIds.includes(cleanText(page.sysId)));
            const nextPageSysId = pickNextVisiblePageAfterDelete(pages, currentPage.sysId);
            const deleteTargets = subtreePages.slice().reverse();
            for (const page of deleteTargets) {
                if (!page.sysId) {
                    continue;
                }
                await dependencies.deletePage(page.sysId);
            }
            const remainingPages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId, { activeOnly: false });
            const remainingSubtreeIds = remainingPages
                .map((page) => cleanText(page.sysId))
                .filter((candidate) => subtreeIds.includes(candidate));
            if (remainingSubtreeIds.length > 0) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Something went wrong while deleting the page. The page was not deleted. Please try again.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                deletedPageSysId: currentPage.sysId ?? pageSysId,
                nextPageSysId
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowPageSettingsService() {
    const service = createPageSettingsService({
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        loadWorkspaceBySysId,
        listWorkspacePages,
        savePage: normalizePageSettingsResult,
        deletePage: deletePageRecord
    });
    return {
        async savePageSettings(input) {
            return service.savePageSettings(input);
        },
        async deletePage(input) {
            return service.deletePage(input);
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageSettings.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>dd9fbd812f3f4abf9cd5a8904df96a85</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageSettings.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_dd9fbd812f3f4abf9cd5a8904df96a85</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceIcons.ts";
import { readQueryParam } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const assetKey = readQueryParam(request, "assetKey");
    const workspaceSysId = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId");
    return { action: "retrieve", assetKeyPresent: Boolean(assetKey), assetKeyLength: assetKey.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, preview: readQueryParam(request, "preview") === "settings" ? "settings" : "default" };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService();
        const result = readQueryParam(request, "preview") === "settings"
            ? await service.getWorkspaceSettingsIconPreviewFile({
                assetKey: readQueryParam(request, "assetKey"),
                workspaceSysId: readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
            })
            : await service.getWorkspaceIconFile({ assetKey: readQueryParam(request, "assetKey") });
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({ error: { message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setHeaders?.({ "Content-Type": result.contentType });
        const writer = response.getStreamWriter?.();
        if (!writer) {
            throw new Error("A response stream writer is required for workspace icon retrieval.");
        }
        writer.writeStream(result.contentStream);
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace icon file] ${JSON.stringify({ context: summarizeRequest(request), message: cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace icon retrieval failure." })}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Unable to load workspace icon. Please try again." } });
    }
}

}
export const DOCSERA_TEXT_ALIGNMENTS = ["left", "center", "right"];
export const DOCSERA_NON_DEFAULT_TEXT_ALIGNMENTS = ["center", "right"];

}

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_137613f1d801456b863e5c06b32cfc67
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceSettingsService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceSettings.ts";
import { toWorkspaceViewRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function summarizeRequestBody(body) {
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const name = cleanText(body.name);
    const shortDescription = cleanText(body.shortDescription);
    const layout = body.layout && typeof body.layout === "object" ? body.layout : null;
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, namePresent: Boolean(name), nameLength: name.length, shortDescriptionPresent: Boolean(shortDescription), shortDescriptionLength: shortDescription.length, iconProvided: body.icon !== undefined, layoutProvided: Boolean(layout), layoutTocVisibleProvided: typeof layout?.tocVisible === "boolean" };
}
function logUnexpectedWorkspaceSettingsError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace settings failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace settings] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    const body = readRequestBody(request);
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceSettingsService();
        const layout = body.layout && typeof body.layout === "object" ? body.layout : null;
        const result = await service.saveWorkspaceSettings({
            workspaceSlug: cleanText(body.workspaceSlug),
            workspaceSysId: cleanText(body.workspaceSysId),
            name: cleanText(body.name),
            shortDescription: cleanText(body.shortDescription) || null,
            icon: body.icon === undefined ? undefined : body.icon && (typeof body.icon === "object" || typeof body.icon === "string") ? body.icon : null,
            layout: layout
                ? {
                    tocVisible: typeof layout.tocVisible === "boolean" ? layout.tocVisible : undefined
                }
                : null
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: "workspace_settings_forbidden",
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.status === 404 ? "workspace_not_found" : "workspace_settings_invalid",
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                workspace: toWorkspaceViewRecord(result.workspace, "Admin")
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceSettingsError(error, {
            ...summarizeRequestBody(body)
        });
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Something went wrong while saving workspace settings. Your changes were not saved. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-settings-save.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>137613f1d801456b863e5c06b32cfc67</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-settings-save.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_137613f1d801456b863e5c06b32cfc67</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_3cd3d9d47d5342b59944218514090139
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[// Keep server-executed workspace domain logic under src/server so the SDK emits
// it into sys_module records for on-instance module resolution.
export const DOCSERA_SCOPE = "x_2300756_docsera";
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace";
export const WORKSPACE_ROLE_NAMES = Object.freeze({
    docseraAdmin: `${DOCSERA_SCOPE}.admin`,
    workspaceAdmin: `${DOCSERA_SCOPE}.workspace_admin`,
    editor: `${DOCSERA_SCOPE}.editor`
});
export { BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICONS, DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON, DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON_KEY, findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon, isBuiltInWorkspaceIconKey, normalizeBuiltInWorkspaceIcon } from "./serverWorkspaceIconCatalog.ts";
import { DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON, findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon } from "./serverWorkspaceIconCatalog.ts";
const DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ICON = Object.freeze({
    type: "builtin",
    key: DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON.key,
    label: DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON.label
});
const DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_LAYOUT = Object.freeze({
    tocVisible: true,
    pageWidth: "readable"
});
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
export function normalizeWorkspaceSearchText(value) {
    return cleanText(value).toLowerCase();
}
function toSlugFragment(value) {
    return cleanText(value)
        .normalize("NFKD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
        .replace(/-{2,}/g, "-")
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}
function toWorkspaceTitleFragment(value) {
    return cleanText(value)
        .normalize("NFKD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, " ")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((part) => `${part.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${part.slice(1)}`)
        .join("_");
}
function normalizeRetainedWorkspaceSlugs(retainedWorkspaces = []) {
    return retainedWorkspaces
        .map((entry) => {
        if (typeof entry === "string") {
            return cleanText(entry);
        }
        if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") {
            return "";
        }
        return cleanText(entry.slug ?? entry.workspaceSlug);
    })
        .filter(Boolean);
}
export function slugifyWorkspaceName(name) {
    return toSlugFragment(name) || "workspace";
}
export function allocateWorkspaceSlug(name, retainedWorkspaces = []) {
    const baseSlug = slugifyWorkspaceName(name);
    const reservedSlugs = new Set(normalizeRetainedWorkspaceSlugs(retainedWorkspaces).map((slug) => slug.toLowerCase()));
    if (!reservedSlugs.has(baseSlug)) {
        return baseSlug;
    }
    let suffix = 2;
    while (reservedSlugs.has(`${baseSlug}-${suffix}`)) {
        suffix += 1;
    }
    return `${baseSlug}-${suffix}`;
}
export function deriveWorkspaceGroupKey(name, slug) {
    const baseKey = toWorkspaceTitleFragment(name) || "Workspace";
    const suffix = cleanText(slug).match(/-(\d+)$/)?.[1];
    return suffix ? `${baseKey}_${suffix}` : baseKey;
}
export function buildWorkspaceGroupNames(workspaceKey) {
    const cleanKey = cleanText(workspaceKey) || "Workspace";
    return {
        admin: `Docsera_${cleanKey}_Admins`,
        editor: `Docsera_${cleanKey}_Editors`
    };
}
export function normalizeWorkspaceIcon(icon) {
    if (!icon) {
        return { ...DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ICON };
    }
    if (typeof icon === "string") {
        const builtInIcon = findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon(icon);
        if (!builtInIcon) {
            throw new TypeError("Unsupported built-in workspace icon.");
        }
        return {
            ...DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ICON,
            key: builtInIcon.key,
            label: builtInIcon.label
        };
    }

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder, cleanText, DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS, DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_STALE_AFTER_MS } from "./serverWorkspaceEditLeaseDomain.ts";
function canEdit(capability) { return capability.canEditWorkspace || capability.canAdminWorkspace; }
function matches(lease, userSysId, digest) {
    return Boolean(lease && cleanText(lease.holderUserSysId) === cleanText(userSysId) && cleanText(lease.verifierDigest) === cleanText(digest));
}
export function createWorkspaceEditLeaseService(dependencies) {
    async function context(input) {
        const currentUser = dependencies.getCurrentUser();
        if (!cleanText(currentUser.sysId))
            return { error: "You do not have permission to edit this workspace.", status: 403, currentUser };
        const workspace = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId) ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(cleanText(input.workspaceSysId)) : await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(cleanText(input.workspaceSlug));
        if (!workspace || !cleanText(workspace.sysId))
            return { error: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404, currentUser };
        if (cleanText(input.workspaceSlug) && cleanText(workspace.slug) !== cleanText(input.workspaceSlug))
            return { error: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404, currentUser };
        if (!canEdit(dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace)))
            return { error: "You do not have permission to edit this workspace.", status: 403, currentUser };
        return { workspace, currentUser };
    }
    function failed(resolved) { return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: resolved.error, retryable: false, status: resolved.status }; }
    function expired(lease, now) { return Boolean(lease && dependencies.isLeaseExpired({ currentTimestamp: now, lastSeenAt: lease.lastSeenAt, staleAfterMs: DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_STALE_AFTER_MS })); }
    function held(token, generation) {
        return {
            kind: "held",
            leaseToken: token,
            heartbeatIntervalMs: DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS,
            staleAfterMs: DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_STALE_AFTER_MS,
            ...generation
        };
    }
    async function acquire(input) {
        const resolved = await context(input);
        if ("error" in resolved)
            return failed(resolved);
        const active = await dependencies.loadActiveGeneration(resolved.workspace);
        if (active.kind === "failed")
            return active;
        const key = cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId);
        const existing = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        const token = cleanText(input.leaseToken);
        const now = dependencies.currentTimestamp();
        if (token && matches(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId, dependencies.digestToken(token)) && !expired(existing, now))
            return held(token, active.generation);
        if (existing && !expired(existing, now))
            return { kind: "locked", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId) };
        const nextToken = dependencies.createToken();
        const nextLease = { workspaceSysId: key, holderUserSysId: resolved.currentUser.sysId, holderDisplayName: resolved.currentUser.displayName, verifierDigest: dependencies.digestToken(nextToken), acquiredAt: now, lastSeenAt: now };
        if (existing) {
            await dependencies.deleteExactExpiredLease({
                currentTimestamp: now,
                expectedLeaseSysId: cleanText(existing.sysId),
                expectedLastSeenAt: cleanText(existing.lastSeenAt),
                workspaceKey: key
            });
        }
        const created = await dependencies.insertLease(nextLease);
        if (created === "created")
            return held(nextToken, active.generation);
        const winner = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        return winner ? { kind: "locked", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(winner, resolved.currentUser.sysId) } : { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Something went wrong while starting Edit mode. Please try again.", retryable: true, status: 500 };
    }
    async function validateHeld(input) {
        const token = cleanText(input.leaseToken);
        if (!token)
            return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "A workspace edit lease token is required.", retryable: false, status: 400 };
        const resolved = await context(input);
        if ("error" in resolved)
            return failed(resolved);
        const active = await dependencies.loadActiveGeneration(resolved.workspace);
        if (active.kind === "failed")
            return active;
        const key = cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId);
        const existing = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        const digest = dependencies.digestToken(token);
        const now = dependencies.currentTimestamp();
        if (!matches(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId, digest) || expired(existing, now))
            return { kind: "lost", currentHolder: expired(existing, now) ? null : buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId), errorMessage: "This workspace edit session ended and unsaved changes were not saved." };
        return held(token, active.generation);
    }
    async function renew(input) {
        const token = cleanText(input.leaseToken);
        if (!token)
            return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "A workspace edit lease token is required.", retryable: false, status: 400 };
        const resolved = await context(input);
        if ("error" in resolved)
            return failed(resolved);
        const active = await dependencies.loadActiveGeneration(resolved.workspace);
        if (active.kind === "failed")
            return active;
        const key = cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId);
        const existing = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        const digest = dependencies.digestToken(token);
        const now = dependencies.currentTimestamp();
        if (!matches(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId, digest) || expired(existing, now))
            return { kind: "lost", currentHolder: expired(existing, now) ? null : buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId), errorMessage: "This workspace edit session ended and unsaved changes were not saved." };
        const touched = await dependencies.touchExactLease({ lastSeenAt: now, leaseSysId: cleanText(existing?.sysId), workspaceKey: key, holderUserSysId: resolved.currentUser.sysId, verifierDigest: digest });
        return touched ? held(token, active.generation) : { kind: "lost", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key), resolved.currentUser.sysId), errorMessage: "This workspace edit session ended and unsaved changes were not saved." };
    }
    async function release(input) {
        const token = cleanText(input.leaseToken);
        if (!token)
            return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "A workspace edit lease token is required.", retryable: false, status: 400 };
        const resolved = await context(input);
        if ("error" in resolved)
            return failed(resolved);
        const key = cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId);
        const existing = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        const digest = dependencies.digestToken(token);
        if (!matches(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId, digest) || expired(existing, dependencies.currentTimestamp()))
            return { kind: "lost", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(existing, resolved.currentUser.sysId), errorMessage: "This workspace edit session has already ended." };
        return await dependencies.releaseExactLease({ leaseSysId: cleanText(existing?.sysId), workspaceKey: key, holderUserSysId: resolved.currentUser.sysId, verifierDigest: digest }) ? { kind: "released" } : { kind: "lost", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key), resolved.currentUser.sysId), errorMessage: "This workspace edit session has already ended." };
    }
    async function endPreviousSession(input) {
        const resolved = await context(input);
        if ("error" in resolved)
            return failed(resolved);
        const observedId = cleanText(input.observedLeaseId);
        if (!observedId)
            return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "The observed editing session is required.", retryable: false, status: 400 };
        const key = cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId);
        const lease = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(key);
        if (!lease || cleanText(lease.sysId) !== observedId || cleanText(lease.holderUserSysId) !== cleanText(resolved.currentUser.sysId))
            return { kind: "lost", currentHolder: null, errorMessage: "The previous editing session has changed or ended. Try Edit again." };
        return await dependencies.releaseExactLease({ leaseSysId: observedId, workspaceKey: key, holderUserSysId: resolved.currentUser.sysId, verifierDigest: cleanText(lease.verifierDigest) })
            ? { kind: "released" } : { kind: "lost", currentHolder: null, errorMessage: "The previous editing session has changed or ended. Try Edit again." };
    }
    return {
        endPreviousSession,
        acquire,
        validateHeld,
        renew,
        release,
        resume: renew,
        status: async (input) => {
            const resolved = await context(input);
            if ("error" in resolved)
                return failed(resolved);
            const active = await dependencies.loadActiveGeneration(resolved.workspace);
            if (active.kind === "failed")
                return active;
            const lease = await dependencies.loadLeaseByWorkspaceKey(cleanText(resolved.workspace.sysId));
            return !lease || expired(lease, dependencies.currentTimestamp())
                ? { kind: "unlocked" }
                : cleanText(input.leaseToken) && matches(lease, resolved.currentUser.sysId, dependencies.digestToken(cleanText(input.leaseToken)))
                    ? held(cleanText(input.leaseToken), active.generation)
                    : { kind: "locked", currentHolder: buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(lease, resolved.currentUser.sysId) };
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/workspaceEditLeaseService.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>6258c509ae9b44eabcd027b9d3a7e3c7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/workspaceEditLeaseService.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_6258c509ae9b44eabcd027b9d3a7e3c7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_edit_lease";
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_EDIT_LEASE_STALE_AFTER_MS = 300_000;
export const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_change_set";
export function cleanText(value) { return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : ""; }
export function buildWorkspaceLeaseHolder(lease, currentUserSysId) {
    if (!lease)
        return null;
    const sameUserDifferentSession = cleanText(lease.holderUserSysId) === cleanText(currentUserSysId);
    return { displayName: cleanText(lease.holderDisplayName) || null, sameUserDifferentSession, ...(!sameUserDifferentSession && cleanText(lease.holderUserSysId) ? { holderUserSysId: cleanText(lease.holderUserSysId) } : {}), ...(sameUserDifferentSession && cleanText(lease.sysId) ? { observedLeaseId: cleanText(lease.sysId) } : {}) };
}
export function buildWorkspaceLockedMessage(holder) {
    if (holder?.sameUserDifferentSession)
        return "This workspace is already being edited in another tab or window for your account.";
    if (holder?.displayName)
        return `This workspace is currently being edited by ${holder.displayName}.`;
    return "This workspace is currently being edited by another user.";
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/serverWorkspaceEditLeaseDomain.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>700b94fed0314cf4a1e38fcbe289ab76</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/workspace-leases/serverWorkspaceEditLeaseDomain.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_700b94fed0314cf4a1e38fcbe289ab76</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

else

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { WORKSPACE_ROLE_NAMES, evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function isCurrentUserMemberOfGroup(groupSysId, userSysId) {
    const cleanGroupSysId = cleanText(groupSysId);
    if (!cleanGroupSysId || !userSysId) {
        return false;
    }
    const membership = new GlideRecord("sys_user_grmember");
    membership.addQuery("group", cleanGroupSysId);
    membership.addQuery("user", userSysId);
    membership.setLimit(1);
    membership.query();
    return membership.next();
}
export function evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace) {
    const currentUserSysId = cleanText(gs.getUserID());
    return evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace, {
        isAuthenticated: Boolean(currentUserSysId),
        hasRole: (roleName) => Boolean(cleanText(roleName)) && gs.hasRole(roleName),
        isMemberOfGroup: (groupSysId) => isCurrentUserMemberOfGroup(groupSysId, currentUserSysId)
    });
}
export function canCurrentUserCreateWorkspaces() {
    return gs.hasRole(WORKSPACE_ROLE_NAMES.docseraAdmin);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><business_calendar/><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><entered_run_end/><entered_run_start/><entered_time>1970-01-01 00:00:00</entered_time><max_drift/><name>Docsera Workspace Edit Lease Cleanup</name><offset/><offset_type>0</offset_type><repeat_every/><run_as/><run_as_tz/><run_dayofmonth>1</run_dayofmonth><run_dayofweek>1</run_dayofweek><run_daysofweek/><run_end/><run_month>1</run_month><run_period>1970-01-01 00:01:00</run_period><run_start>2026-11-06 22:37:12</run_start><run_time>1970-01-01 05:00:00</run_time><run_type>periodically</run_type><run_weekinmonth>1</run_weekinmonth><script><![CDATA[(function () {
    var LEASE_TABLE = 'x_2300756_docsera_workspace_edit_lease';
    var STALE_AFTER_MS = 300000;
    var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
    cutoff.addSeconds(-Math.floor(STALE_AFTER_MS / 1000));
    var cutoffValue = cutoff.getValue();

    var candidates = new GlideRecord(LEASE_TABLE);
    candidates.addQuery('last_seen_on', '<', cutoffValue);
    candidates.query();

    while (candidates.next()) {
        var sysId = String(candidates.getUniqueValue() || '').trim();
        var workspaceKey = String(candidates.getValue('workspace_key') || '').trim();
        var lastSeenOn = String(candidates.getValue('last_seen_on') || '').trim();
        if (!sysId || !workspaceKey || !lastSeenOn) {
            continue;
        }

        var exactDelete = new GlideRecord(LEASE_TABLE);
        exactDelete.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        exactDelete.addQuery('workspace_key', workspaceKey);
        exactDelete.addQuery('last_seen_on', lastSeenOn);
        exactDelete.addQuery('last_seen_on', '<', cutoffValue);
        exactDelete.query();
        exactDelete.deleteMultiple();
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>d10e6693bf37427a8ef6f7049ace26d9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Docsera Workspace Edit Lease Cleanup</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysauto_script_d10e6693bf37427a8ef6f7049ace26d9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:46</sys_updated_on><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe></sysauto_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[(function () {
    var LEASE_TABLE = 'x_2300756_docsera_workspace_edit_lease';
    var STALE_AFTER_MS = 300000;
    var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
    cutoff.addSeconds(-Math.floor(STALE_AFTER_MS / 1000));
    var cutoffValue = cutoff.getValue();

    var candidates = new GlideRecord(LEASE_TABLE);
    candidates.addQuery('last_seen_on', '<', cutoffValue);
    candidates.query();

    while (candidates.next()) {
        var sysId = String(candidates.getUniqueValue() || '').trim();
        var workspaceKey = String(candidates.getValue('workspace_key') || '').trim();
        var lastSeenOn = String(candidates.getValue('last_seen_on') || '').trim();
        if (!sysId || !workspaceKey || !lastSeenOn) {
            continue;
        }

        var exactDelete = new GlideRecord(LEASE_TABLE);
        exactDelete.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        exactDelete.addQuery('workspace_key', workspaceKey);
        exactDelete.addQuery('last_seen_on', lastSeenOn);
        exactDelete.addQuery('last_seen_on', '<', cutoffValue);
        exactDelete.query();
        exactDelete.deleteMultiple();
    }
})();
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/scheduled-scripts/docsera-workspace-edit-lease-cleanup.js</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>b4b547bceeba4dc38fc504f9125d6eaa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/scheduled-scripts/docsera-workspace-edit-lease-cleanup.js</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_b4b547bceeba4dc38fc504f9125d6eaa</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideDateTime, GlideDigest, GlideRecord, GlideSecureRandomUtil, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createRemovalBatch, discardPageChanges, deriveChangeCategory, completeSnapshotStaging, movePage, pendingEntries, projectEdit, projectLive, recordPendingChange, stageSnapshotSet, switchSelectors } from "./workspaceChangeSetDomain.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "./serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "./serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE, collectPageSubtreeSysIds, createPageDraft, hasPageDraftDifferencesFromPublished, normalizePageRecord, normalizeServiceNowBoolean, normalizeSiblingOrder, pickNextVisiblePageAfterDelete } from "../pages/serverPageDomain.ts";
import { mapPageRecord } from "../pages/serviceNowPageRecords.ts";
import { createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope, extractPlainTextFromServerDocument, parseServerDocument } from "../pages/serverEditorDocument.ts";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_SET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_change_set";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_SET_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_snapshot_set";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_PAGE_SNAPSHOT_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_page_snapshot";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_CHANGE_ENTRY_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_change_entry";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_BATCH_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_removal_batch";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_REMOVAL_MEMBER_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_removal_member";
const DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_MUTATION_CLAIM_TABLE = "x_2300756_docsera_workspace_mutation_claim";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function safeInteger(value) {
    const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? Number(value) : Number.NaN;
    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : null;
}
function parseTimestamp(value) {
    const normalized = cleanText(value).replace(" ", "T");
    if (!normalized) {
        return null;
    }
    const withZone = normalized.endsWith("Z") ? normalized : `${normalized}Z`;
    const parsed = Date.parse(withZone);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}
function formatTimestamp(value) {
    const date = new Date(value);
    const year = String(date.getUTCFullYear());
    const month = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    const hour = String(date.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, "0");
    const minute = String(date.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
    const second = String(date.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${hour}:${minute}:${second}`;
}
function plusDuration(timestampValue, durationMs) {
    const parsed = parseTimestamp(timestampValue);
    return parsed === null ? timestampValue : formatTimestamp(parsed + durationMs);
}
function stableSerialize(value) {
    return JSON.stringify(sortForSerialization(value));
}
function sortForSerialization(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return value.map((entry) => sortForSerialization(entry));
    }
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
        return value;
    }
    const candidate = value;
    return Object.keys(candidate)
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right))
        .reduce((result, key) => {
        result[key] = sortForSerialization(candidate[key]);
        return result;
    }, {});
}
function serializeDocument(value) {
    return JSON.stringify(parseServerDocument(value ?? createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope()));
}
function readBoolean(value, fallback = true) {
    const text = cleanText(value).toLowerCase();
    if (text === "false" || text === "0") {
        return false;
    }
    if (text === "true" || text === "1") {
        return true;
    }
    return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : fallback;
}
function createDefaultDependencies() {
    return {
        createDeterministicSysId(seed) {
            return new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(seed).slice(0, 32).toLowerCase();
        },
        currentTimestamp() {
            return new GlideDateTime().getValue();
        },
        currentUserSysId() {
            return cleanText(gs.getUserID()) || "system";
        },
        digest(value) {
            return new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(value).toUpperCase();
        },
        ownerTimeoutMs: 30_000,
        randomKey(prefix) {
            return `${prefix}-${GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomString(24)}`;
        }
    };
}
function triggerDurablePhase(dependencies, phase, context) {
    dependencies.afterDurablePhase?.(phase, context);
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return null;
    }
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!row.get("sys_id", sysId)) {

}
function mapWorkspaceFoundationPageRecord(record) {

    const publishedTitle = cleanText(record.getValue("published_title")) || null;
    const publishedSlug = cleanText(record.getValue("published_slug_normalized") || record.getValue("published_slug")) || null;
    const publishedBodyText = cleanText(record.getValue("published_body_text")) || null;
    return normalizePageRecord({
        sysId: cleanText(record.getUniqueValue()),
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("workspace")),
        parentPageSysId: cleanText(record.getValue("parent_page")) || null,
        siblingOrder: normalizeSiblingOrder(record.getValue("sibling_order")),
