                const sourceAuthority = activeRecovery?.sourceAuthority ?? input.authority;
                const generationKey = buildMutationGenerationKey(sourceAuthority);
                const originalAffectedPageCount = activeRecovery?.affectedPageCount ?? pendingEntries(loaded.state).length;
                const payload = activeRecovery?.claim.kind === "discard_all" && activeRecovery.claim.payload.kind === "discard_all"
                    ? activeRecovery.claim.payload
                    : buildDiscardAllPayload(workspaceSysId, commandId, sourceAuthority, originalAffectedPageCount, dependencies);
                const existingClaim = activeRecovery?.claim ?? loadMutationClaimByGeneration(generationKey);
                if (existingClaim &&
                    (existingClaim.kind !== "discard_all" ||
                        existingClaim.payload.kind !== "discard_all" ||
                        existingClaim.payload.commandId !== payload.commandId ||
                        existingClaim.payload.successorChangeSetSysId !== payload.successorChangeSetSysId ||
                        existingClaim.payload.successorGenerationKey !== payload.successorGenerationKey)) {
                    return staleFailure(nextAuthority(loaded.state));
                }
                // loadWorkspaceState has already selected and validated this ready snapshot.
                // Reuse it so the claimed phase neither rereads the complete snapshot table
                // nor risks substituting another snapshot for the active selector.
                const selectedSnapshot = loaded.state.snapshotSets.find((snapshot) => snapshot.id === selectedSnapshotSetSysId && snapshot.readiness === "ready");
                if (!selectedSnapshot) {
                    throw new Error("Workspace foundation is invalid.");
                }
                const publishedPages = selectedSnapshot.pages;
                if (!existingClaim) {
                    if (originalAffectedPageCount === 0) {
                        return { kind: "failed", code: "invalid", errorMessage: "There are no pending changes to discard.", status: 400 };
                    }
                    orderProjectionPages(projectEdit(loaded.state));
                    const validatedSwitch = switchSelectors(loaded.state, {
                        expectedChangeSetId: input.authority.changeSetId,
                        expectedChangeSetRevision: input.authority.changeSetRevision
                    }, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "discard_all",
                        successorChangeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId
                    });
                    if (validatedSwitch.kind === "stale") {
                        return staleFailure(validatedSwitch.current);
                    }
                }
                let claim = existingClaim ?? {
                    sysId: "",
                    workspaceId: workspaceSysId,
                    changeSetId: sourceAuthority.changeSetId,
                    generationKey,
                    mutationKey: buildMutationKey(dependencies, sourceAuthority, "discard_all", payload),
                    kind: "discard_all",
                    state: "claimed",
                    ownerKey: dependencies.randomKey("mutation-owner"),
                    ownerExpiresOn: plusDuration(dependencies.currentTimestamp(), dependencies.ownerTimeoutMs),
                    claimedOn: dependencies.currentTimestamp(),
                    phase: "claimed",
                    payload
                };
                const acquired = acquireMutationClaim(dependencies, loaded.state, claim);
                if (acquired.kind === "failed") {
                    return acquired.failure;
                }
                if (acquired.kind === "replay") {
                    return {
                        kind: "succeeded",
                        authority: acquired.resultAuthority,
                        result: parseReplayResult(acquired.resultJson)
                    };
                }
                claim = acquired.claim;
                const executorKey = acquired.executorKey;
                const discardedOn = claim.appliedOn ?? dependencies.currentTimestamp();
                let resultAuthority = claim.resultAuthority;
                let switchedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) ?? loaded.workspace;
                const alreadySwitched = cleanText(switchedWorkspace.pendingChangeSetSysId) === payload.successorChangeSetSysId &&
                    cleanText(switchedWorkspace.publishedSnapshotSetSysId) === selectedSnapshotSetSysId;
                if (!resultAuthority && alreadySwitched) {
                    resultAuthority = {
                        changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                        changeSetRevision: 0
                    };
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? discardedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_persisted",
                        resultAuthority,
                        state: "applied"
                    }, null);
                }
                if (!resultAuthority) {
                    claim = requireClaimOwner(claim, executorKey);
                    const validatedSwitch = switchSelectors(loaded.state, {
                        expectedChangeSetId: input.authority.changeSetId,
                        expectedChangeSetRevision: input.authority.changeSetRevision
                    }, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "discard_all",
                        successorChangeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId
                    });
                    if (validatedSwitch.kind === "stale") {
                        return staleFailure(validatedSwitch.current);
                    }
                    // Match Array.find's existing first-match semantics while avoiding one
                    // complete page-record scan for every published projection page.
                    const preparedPageRecordsBySysId = new Map();
                    for (const record of loaded.pageRecords) {
                        const pageSysId = cleanText(record.sysId);
                        if (pageSysId && !preparedPageRecordsBySysId.has(pageSysId)) {
                            preparedPageRecordsBySysId.set(pageSysId, record);
                        }
                    }
                    const preparedResult = {
                        pages: orderProjectionPages(publishedPages).map((page) => pageFromProjectionPage(page, preparedPageRecordsBySysId.get(page.pageId), workspaceSysId, "live")),
                        pendingChanges: {
                            affectedPageCount: 0,
                            changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                            changeSetRevision: 0,
                            rows: [],
                            workspaceSysId
                        },
                        workspaceStateRevision: validatedSwitch.result.workspaceStateRevision
                    };
                    const preparedResultJson = stableSerialize(preparedResult);
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? discardedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_advancing",
                        resultJson: preparedResultJson
                    }, executorKey);
                    claim = requireDurableChangeSetAdvancingMarker(claim, executorKey, preparedResultJson);
                    ensureDiscardAllSuccessorChangeSet(workspaceSysId, payload);
                    switchedWorkspace = switchWorkspaceDiscardSelectors({
                        authority: input.authority,
                        dependencies,
                        payload,
                        workspace: loaded.workspace
                    });
                    resultAuthority = {
                        changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                        changeSetRevision: 0
                    };
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? discardedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_persisted",
                        resultAuthority,
                        state: "applied"
                    }, null);
                }
                if (claim.phase === "change_set_persisted" && resultAuthority) {
                    markPublishedChangeSetSuperseded(claim.changeSetId, commandId, discardedOn);
                    reconcileDiscardedPageRows({
                        dependencies,
                        discardedChangeSetId: claim.changeSetId,
                        pages: publishedPages,
                        workspaceSysId
                    });
                    switchedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) ?? switchedWorkspace;
                    const pageRecords = listWorkspacePageRecords(workspaceSysId);
                    const recordMap = new Map(pageRecords.map((page) => [cleanText(page.sysId), page]));
                    const result = {
                        pages: orderProjectionPages(publishedPages).map((page) => pageFromProjectionPage(page, recordMap.get(page.pageId), workspaceSysId, "edit")),
                        pendingChanges: {
                            affectedPageCount: 0,
                            changeSetId: resultAuthority.changeSetId,
                            changeSetRevision: resultAuthority.changeSetRevision,
                            rows: [],
                            workspaceSysId
                        },
                        workspaceStateRevision: typeof switchedWorkspace.workspaceStateRevision === "number" ? switchedWorkspace.workspaceStateRevision : 0
                    };
                    try {
                        claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                            appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? discardedOn,
                            phase: "result_persisted",
                            resultAuthority,
                            resultJson: stableSerialize(result),
                            state: "applied"
                        }, null);
                    }
                    catch (error) {
                        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace discard-all] Result persistence failed while discard recovery remains blocked: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                        return discardRecoveryRequiredFailure({
                            affectedPageCount: payload.affectedPageCount,
                            currentChangeSetId: resultAuthority.changeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: resultAuthority.changeSetRevision,
                            recoveryCommandId: commandId
                        });
                    }
                    triggerDurablePhase(dependencies, "discard_result_persisted", {
                        generationKey,
                        kind: "discard_all"
                    });
                }
                if (claim.phase === "result_persisted" && claim.resultAuthority) {
                    try {
                        updateChangeSetRecoveryState(claim.resultAuthority.changeSetId, "none");
                    }
                    catch (error) {
                        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace discard-all] Replay-safe result persisted but recovery marker still needs retry: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                        return discardRecoveryRequiredFailure({
                            affectedPageCount: payload.affectedPageCount,
                            currentChangeSetId: claim.resultAuthority.changeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: claim.resultAuthority.changeSetRevision,
                            recoveryCommandId: commandId
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (!claim.resultAuthority || !claim.resultJson) {
                    throw new Error("Recovered discard-all result could not be persisted.");
                }
                const replayed = parseReplayResult(claim.resultJson);
                try {
                    claim = finalizeMutationClaim(dependencies, claim, claim.resultAuthority, replayed, null);
                }
                catch (error) {
                    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace discard-all] Selector advanced but claim finalization needs retry: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                }
                return {
                    kind: "succeeded",
                    authority: claim.resultAuthority,
                    result: replayed
                };
            }
            catch (error) {
                const errorMessage = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
                if (errorMessage === "The active draft generation changed. Reload before discarding again.") {
                    try {
                        const reloadedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(cleanText(input.workspace.sysId)) ?? input.workspace;
                        return staleFailure(nextAuthority(loadWorkspaceState(reloadedWorkspace, dependencies).state));
                    }
                    catch {
                        return {
                            kind: "failed",
                            code: "stale_generation",
                            errorMessage,
                            status: 409
                        };
                    }
                }
                try {
                    const reloadedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(cleanText(input.workspace.sysId)) ?? input.workspace;
                    const recovery = readActiveDiscardRecovery(loadWorkspaceState(reloadedWorkspace, dependencies));
                    if (recovery) {
                        return discardRecoveryRequiredFailure({
                            affectedPageCount: recovery.affectedPageCount,
                            currentChangeSetId: recovery.successorAuthority.changeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: recovery.successorAuthority.changeSetRevision,
                            recoveryCommandId: recovery.recoveryCommandId
                        });
                    }
                }
                catch {
                    // Fall back to the generic failure below.
                }
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: errorMessage || "Something went wrong while discarding changes. No changes were discarded. Please try again.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
        },
        publishWorkspace(input) {
            try {
                const loaded = loadWorkspaceState(input.workspace, dependencies);
                const recoveryFailure = blockOnActiveDiscardRecovery(loaded);
                if (recoveryFailure) {
                    return recoveryFailure;
                }
                const workspaceSysId = cleanText(loaded.workspace.sysId);
                const commandId = cleanText(input.commandId);
                if (!workspaceSysId) {
                    return { kind: "failed", errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.", status: 404 };
                }
                if (!commandId || commandId.length > 64 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+$/.test(commandId)) {
                    return { kind: "failed", code: "invalid", errorMessage: "A valid publish command identity is required.", status: 400 };
                }
                const generationKey = buildMutationGenerationKey(input.authority);
                const payload = buildPublishPayload(workspaceSysId, commandId, input.authority, dependencies);
                const existingClaim = loadMutationClaimByGeneration(generationKey);
                if (existingClaim &&
                    (existingClaim.kind !== "publish" ||
                        existingClaim.payload.kind !== "publish" ||
                        existingClaim.payload.commandId !== payload.commandId ||
                        existingClaim.payload.snapshotSetSysId !== payload.snapshotSetSysId ||
                        existingClaim.payload.snapshotKey !== payload.snapshotKey ||
                        existingClaim.payload.successorChangeSetSysId !== payload.successorChangeSetSysId ||
                        existingClaim.payload.successorGenerationKey !== payload.successorGenerationKey)) {
                    return staleFailure(nextAuthority(loaded.state));
                }
                if (!existingClaim) {
                    const tokenValidation = switchSelectors(completeSnapshotStaging(stageSnapshotSet(loaded.state, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "publish",
                        snapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId
                    }), payload.snapshotSetSysId), {
                        expectedChangeSetId: input.authority.changeSetId,
                        expectedChangeSetRevision: input.authority.changeSetRevision
                    }, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "publish",
                        snapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId,
                        successorChangeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId
                    });
                    if (tokenValidation.kind === "stale") {
                        return staleFailure(tokenValidation.current);
                    }
                    if (pendingEntries(loaded.state).length === 0) {
                        return { kind: "failed", code: "invalid", errorMessage: "There are no pending changes to publish.", status: 400 };
                    }
                }
                let claim = existingClaim ?? {
                    sysId: "",
                    workspaceId: workspaceSysId,
                    changeSetId: input.authority.changeSetId,
                    generationKey,
                    mutationKey: buildMutationKey(dependencies, input.authority, "publish", payload),
                    kind: "publish",
                    state: "claimed",
                    ownerKey: dependencies.randomKey("mutation-owner"),
                    ownerExpiresOn: plusDuration(dependencies.currentTimestamp(), dependencies.ownerTimeoutMs),
                    claimedOn: dependencies.currentTimestamp(),
                    phase: "claimed",
                    payload
                };
                const acquired = acquireMutationClaim(dependencies, loaded.state, claim);
                if (acquired.kind === "failed") {
                    return acquired.failure;
                }
                if (acquired.kind === "replay") {
                    return {
                        kind: "succeeded",
                        authority: acquired.resultAuthority,
                        result: parseReplayResult(acquired.resultJson)
                    };
                }
                claim = acquired.claim;
                const executorKey = acquired.executorKey;
                const publishedOn = claim.appliedOn ?? dependencies.currentTimestamp();
                const publishedBy = dependencies.currentUserSysId();
                let snapshotPages = [];
                if (claim.phase === "claimed") {
                    claim = requireClaimOwner(claim, executorKey);
                    snapshotPages = persistPublishSnapshot(dependencies, loaded, payload, input.authority, publishedOn, publishedBy);
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: publishedOn,
                        phase: "page_persisted"
                    }, executorKey);
                }
                else {
                    const snapshot = loadFoundationSnapshot(workspaceSysId, payload.snapshotSetSysId);
                    if (!snapshot || snapshot.readiness !== "ready") {
                        throw new Error("Workspace publish snapshot could not be recovered.");
                    }
                    snapshotPages = snapshot.pages;
                }
                let resultAuthority = claim.resultAuthority;
                let switchedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) ?? loaded.workspace;
                const alreadySwitched = cleanText(switchedWorkspace.pendingChangeSetSysId) === payload.successorChangeSetSysId &&
                    cleanText(switchedWorkspace.publishedSnapshotSetSysId) === payload.snapshotSetSysId;
                if (!resultAuthority && alreadySwitched) {
                    resultAuthority = {
                        changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                        changeSetRevision: 0
                    };
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? publishedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_persisted",
                        resultAuthority,
                        state: "applied"
                    }, null);
                }
                if (!resultAuthority) {
                    claim = requireClaimOwner(claim, executorKey);
                    const validationState = completeSnapshotStaging(stageSnapshotSet(loaded.state, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "publish",
                        snapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId
                    }), payload.snapshotSetSysId);
                    const validatedSwitch = switchSelectors(validationState, {
                        expectedChangeSetId: input.authority.changeSetId,
                        expectedChangeSetRevision: input.authority.changeSetRevision
                    }, {
                        commandId,
                        kind: "publish",
                        snapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId,
                        successorChangeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId
                    });
                    if (validatedSwitch.kind === "stale") {
                        return staleFailure(validatedSwitch.current);
                    }
                    const preparedResult = {
                        pages: [],
                        pendingChanges: {
                            affectedPageCount: 0,
                            changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                            changeSetRevision: 0,
                            rows: [],
                            workspaceSysId
                        },
                        publishedSnapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId,
                        workspaceStateRevision: validatedSwitch.result.workspaceStateRevision
                    };
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? publishedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_advancing",
                        resultJson: stableSerialize(preparedResult)
                    }, executorKey);
                    claim = requireDurableChangeSetAdvancingMarker(claim, executorKey, stableSerialize(preparedResult));
                    ensurePublishSuccessorChangeSet(workspaceSysId, payload);
                    switchedWorkspace = switchWorkspacePublishSelectors({
                        authority: input.authority,
                        dependencies,
                        payload,
                        snapshotSetSysId: payload.snapshotSetSysId,
                        workspace: loaded.workspace
                    });
                    markPublishedChangeSetSuperseded(input.authority.changeSetId, commandId, publishedOn);
                    resultAuthority = {
                        changeSetId: payload.successorChangeSetSysId,
                        changeSetRevision: 0
                    };
                    claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                        appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? publishedOn,
                        phase: "change_set_persisted",
                        resultAuthority,
                        state: "applied"
                    }, null);
                }
                if (claim.phase === "change_set_persisted" && resultAuthority) {
                    try {
                        reconcilePublishedPageRows({
                            dependencies,
                            pages: snapshotPages.length > 0 ? snapshotPages : loadSnapshotPages(payload.snapshotSetSysId),
                            publishedBy,
                            publishedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? publishedOn,
                            workspaceSysId
                        });
                    }
                    catch (error) {
                        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace publish] Published selector advanced but page row reconciliation needs retry: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                    }
                    switchedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) ?? switchedWorkspace;
                    const refreshed = this.listPages(switchedWorkspace, "edit");
                    if (refreshed.kind !== "succeeded") {
                        return refreshed;
                    }
                    const workspaceStateRevision = typeof refreshed.workspace.workspaceStateRevision === "number" ? refreshed.workspace.workspaceStateRevision : 0;
                    const result = {
                        pages: refreshed.pages,
                        pendingChanges: {
                            affectedPageCount: 0,
                            changeSetId: resultAuthority.changeSetId,
                            changeSetRevision: resultAuthority.changeSetRevision,
                            rows: [],
                            workspaceSysId
                        },
                        publishedSnapshotSetId: payload.snapshotSetSysId,
                        workspaceStateRevision
                    };
                    try {
                        claim = persistClaimProgress(dependencies, claim, {
                            appliedOn: claim.appliedOn ?? publishedOn,
                            phase: "result_persisted",
                            resultAuthority,
                            resultJson: stableSerialize(result),
                            state: "applied"
                        }, null);
                    }
                    catch (error) {
                        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace publish] Published selector advanced but result persistence needs retry: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                        return {
                            kind: "succeeded",
                            authority: resultAuthority,
                            result
                        };
                    }
                }
                if (!claim.resultAuthority || !claim.resultJson) {
                    throw new Error("Recovered publish result could not be persisted.");
                }
                const replayed = parseReplayResult(claim.resultJson);
                try {
                    claim = finalizeMutationClaim(dependencies, claim, claim.resultAuthority, replayed, null);
                }
                catch (error) {
                    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace publish] Published selector advanced but claim finalization needs retry: ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "unknown failure"}`);
                }
                return {
                    kind: "succeeded",
                    authority: claim.resultAuthority,
                    result: replayed
                };
            }
            catch (error) {
                const errorMessage = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
                if (errorMessage === "The active draft generation changed. Reload before publishing again.") {
                    try {
                        const reloadedWorkspace = loadWorkspaceBySysId(cleanText(input.workspace.sysId)) ?? input.workspace;
                        return staleFailure(nextAuthority(loadWorkspaceState(reloadedWorkspace, dependencies).state));
                    }
                    catch {
                        return {
                            kind: "failed",
                            code: "stale_generation",
                            errorMessage,
                            status: 409
                        };
                    }
                }
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: errorMessage || "Something went wrong while publishing. No changes were published. Please try again.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
        },
        pendingChanges(workspace) {
            try {
                const loaded = loadWorkspaceState(workspace, dependencies);
                return pendingChangesFromLoadedState(loaded);
            }
            catch (error) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unable to load pending changes. Please try again.",
                    status: 500
                };
            }
        }
    };
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    return row.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(row) : null;
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response)) {
            return;
        }
        if (lease.kind !== "held") {
            return;
        }
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority) {
            return;
        }
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "not_found", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService().publishWorkspace({
            authority,
            commandId: cleanText(body.commandId),
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "forbidden", message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "invalid"
                            ? "invalid"
                            : result.code === "recovery_required"
                                ? "recovery_required"
                                : "publish_failed",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? { currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId, currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                pages: result.result.pages,
                pendingChanges: result.result.pendingChanges,
                publishedSnapshotSetId: result.result.publishedSnapshotSetId,
                workspaceStateRevision: result.result.workspaceStateRevision,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace publish] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace publish failure."}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "publish_failed", message: "Something went wrong while publishing. No changes were published. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-publish.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>c202a36f4dfb42889911ec4a42d2bbf9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-publish.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_c202a36f4dfb42889911ec4a42d2bbf9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";

function cleanText(value) {

        editor: cleanText(roleNames.editor),
        workspaceAdmin: cleanText(roleNames.workspaceAdmin)

}

        return rawBody.data;

}

    const name = cleanText(body.name);
    const shortDescription = cleanText(body.shortDescription);
    const icon = body.icon && typeof body.icon === "object" ? body.icon : null;
    const layout = body.layout && typeof body.layout === "object" ? body.layout : null;
    return { namePresent: Boolean(name), nameLength: name.length, shortDescriptionPresent: Boolean(shortDescription), shortDescriptionLength: shortDescription.length, iconProvided: body.icon !== undefined, iconType: icon?.type === "builtin" || icon?.type === "uploaded" ? icon.type : undefined, layoutProvided: Boolean(layout), layoutTocVisibleProvided: typeof layout?.tocVisible === "boolean", layoutPageWidth: layout?.pageWidth === "full" || layout?.pageWidth === "readable" ? layout.pageWidth : undefined, status: body.status === "inactive" ? "inactive" : "active" };
}

    const layout = body.layout && typeof body.layout === "object" ? body.layout : null;

}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope, parseServerDocument } from "./serverEditorDocument.ts";

export function validatePageSettingsTitle(title) {

        return {
            valid: false,
            value: normalizedTitle,
            normalizedValue: normalizedTitle,
            error: "Page title must be 160 characters or fewer."

        valid: true,
        value: normalizedTitle,
        normalizedValue: normalizedTitle,
        error: ""

}
export function validatePageSettingsSlug(slug, retainedPages = [], workspaceSysId = "", currentPageSysId = "") {

            valid: false,

            valid: false,

        const currentSlugCandidates = resolvePageSlugCandidates(currentPage).map((value) => value.toLowerCase());

            return {
                valid: true,
                value: normalizedSlug,
                normalizedValue,
                error: ""
            };
        }
    }
    const reservedSlugs = new Set(collectReservedPageSlugs(retainedPages, workspaceSysId, currentPageSysId));
    if (reservedSlugs.has(normalizedValue)) {
        return {
            valid: false,
            value: normalizedSlug,
            normalizedValue,
            error: "Slug must be unique within this workspace."

        valid: true,
        value: normalizedSlug,
        normalizedValue,

}
export function collectPageSubtreeSysIds(pages = [], rootPageSysId = "") {
    const normalizedRootPageSysId = cleanText(rootPageSysId);

        const childPages = pagesByParent.get(currentSysId) ?? [];

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_15820f3e34794478b5bf9b61fb4dfc90
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { loadWorkspaceBySlug } from "./serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function resolveListingMode(value) {
    return cleanText(value).toLowerCase() === "edit" ? "edit" : "live";
}
export function createPageListingService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async listPages(input) {
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            const mode = resolveListingMode(input.mode);
            if (!workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const workspace = await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug);
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (mode === "edit" && !capability.canEditWorkspace && !capability.canAdminWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to view draft pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            if (mode === "live" && !capability.canViewWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to view pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                mode,
                workspace,
                pages: await dependencies.listPages(workspace, mode)
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowPageListingService() {
    const changeSetPersistence = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
    const service = createPageListingService({
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        listPages: async (workspace, mode) => {
            const result = changeSetPersistence.listPages(workspace, mode);
            if (result.kind !== "succeeded") {
                throw new Error(result.errorMessage);
            }
            return result.pages;
        }
    });
    return {
        async listPages(input) {
            return service.listPages(input);
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageListing.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>15820f3e34794478b5bf9b61fb4dfc90</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageListing.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_15820f3e34794478b5bf9b61fb4dfc90</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

export const BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICONS = Object.freeze([

        glyph: "folder-kanban"
    }
]);
export const DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON = Object.freeze(BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICONS[0]);
export function findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon(key) {
    const cleanKey = typeof key === "string" ? key.trim() : "";
    if (!cleanKey) {
        return null;
    }
    return BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICONS.find((icon) => icon.key === cleanKey) ?? null;
}
export function isBuiltInWorkspaceIconKey(key) {
    return Boolean(findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon(key));
}
export function normalizeBuiltInWorkspaceIcon(key) {
    return findBuiltInWorkspaceIcon(key) ?? DEFAULT_BUILT_IN_WORKSPACE_ICON;
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    return row.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(row) : null;
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response)) {
            return;
        }
        if (lease.kind !== "held") {
            return;
        }
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority) {
            return;
        }
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "not_found", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService().discardAllWorkspace({
            authority,
            commandId: cleanText(body.commandId),
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "forbidden", message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "invalid"
                            ? "invalid"
                            : result.code === "recovery_required"
                                ? "recovery_required"
                                : "discard_all_failed",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? { currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId, currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                pages: result.result.pages,
                pendingChanges: result.result.pendingChanges,
                workspaceStateRevision: result.result.workspaceStateRevision,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace discard-all] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace discard-all failure."}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "discard_all_failed", message: "Something went wrong while discarding changes. No changes were discarded. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-discard-all.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>e0ab24034c7a4fdda544559615c35d9a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-discard-all.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_e0ab24034c7a4fdda544559615c35d9a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowPageListingService } from "../pages/serviceNowPageListing.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readValueFromQuery(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (const candidate of value) {
            const text = cleanText(candidate);
            if (text) {
                return text;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        return cleanText(value.value) || cleanText(value.sys_id);
    }
    return cleanText(value);
}
function readQueryParam(request, key) {
    const queryString = cleanText(request?.queryString);
    if (!queryString) {
        const queryParams = request?.queryParams;
        if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === "object") {
            return readValueFromQuery(queryParams[key]);
        }
        return "";
    }
    const normalizedQuery = queryString.startsWith("?") ? queryString.slice(1) : queryString;
    for (const entry of normalizedQuery.split("&")) {
        if (!entry) {
            continue;
        }
        const [rawKey, ...rawValueParts] = entry.split("=");
        if (cleanText(decodeURIComponent(rawKey || "")) !== key) {
            continue;
        }
        const rawValue = rawValueParts.join("=");
        if (!rawValue) {
            return "";
        }
        return cleanText(decodeURIComponent(rawValue.replace(/\+/g, " ")));
    }
    const queryParams = request?.queryParams;
    if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === "object") {
        return readValueFromQuery(queryParams[key]);
    }
    return "";
}
function normalizePagePayload(result) {
    return {
        mode: "servicenow",
        pageMode: result.mode ?? "live",
        items: result.items ?? [],
        workspaceSlug: cleanText(result.workspaceSlug),
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(result.workspaceSysId),
        totalCount: Number(result.totalCount) || (result.items ?? []).length
    };
}
function logUnexpectedPageListingError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page listing failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page listing] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const workspaceSlug = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSlug") || readQueryParam(request, "workspace");
    const mode = readQueryParam(request, "mode");
    return { workspaceSlugPresent: Boolean(workspaceSlug), workspaceSlugLength: workspaceSlug.length, mode: mode === "edit" ? "edit" : mode ? "other" : "absent" };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowPageListingService();
        const workspaceSlug = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSlug") || readQueryParam(request, "workspace");
        const result = await service.listPages({
            mode: readQueryParam(request, "mode") === "edit" ? "edit" : "live",
            workspaceSlug
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setBody({
            result: normalizePagePayload({
                items: result.pages,
                mode: result.mode,
                workspaceSlug: result.workspace.slug,
                workspaceSysId: result.workspace.sysId,
                totalCount: result.pages.length
            })
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedPageListingError(error, {
            ...summarizeRequest(request)
        });
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                message: "Unable to load pages. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-pages.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>01b2f2e0f5564834a7adaf2de483ab2e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-pages.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_01b2f2e0f5564834a7adaf2de483ab2e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideDateTime, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
const DOCSERA_SCOPE = "x_2300756_docsera";
export function process(_request, response) {
    response.setBody({
        result: {
            authenticated: true,
            scope: DOCSERA_SCOPE,
            status: "ok",
            timestamp: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue(),
            userDisplayName: gs.getUserDisplayName(),
            userName: gs.getUserName(),
            userSysId: gs.getUserID()
        }
    });
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-ping.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>f0ad814593a44c78b9cf22e2b54d72da</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-ping.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_f0ad814593a44c78b9cf22e2b54d72da</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:36</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceIcons.ts";
import { readHeader, readNumericHeader, readQueryParam, readRequestBodyDataStream } from "./docsera-runtime-request.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function logUnexpectedIconError(error, context) {
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace icon upload] ${JSON.stringify({ context, message: cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace icon upload failure." })}`);
}
function summarizeRequest(request) {
    const fileName = readQueryParam(request, "fileName");
    const workspaceSysId = readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId");
    const assetKey = readQueryParam(request, "assetKey");
    const contentLengthBytes = readNumericHeader(request, "Content-Length");
    return { action: readQueryParam(request, "action") === "cleanup-settings-staged" ? "cleanup-settings-staged" : "upload", fileNamePresent: Boolean(fileName), fileNameLength: fileName.length, workspaceSysIdPresent: Boolean(workspaceSysId), workspaceSysIdLength: workspaceSysId.length, assetKeyPresent: Boolean(assetKey), assetKeyLength: assetKey.length, contentTypePresent: Boolean(readHeader(request, "Content-Type")), contentLengthBytes: typeof contentLengthBytes === "number" ? contentLengthBytes : undefined };
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceIconService();
        if (readQueryParam(request, "action") === "cleanup-settings-staged") {
            service.cleanupStagedWorkspaceSettingsIcon(readQueryParam(request, "assetKey"), readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId"));
            response.setStatus?.(204);
            response.setBody({});
            return;
        }
        const result = await service.uploadWorkspaceIcon({
            contentLengthBytes: readNumericHeader(request, "Content-Length"),
            contentType: readHeader(request, "Content-Type"),
            dataStream: readRequestBodyDataStream(request),
            fileName: readQueryParam(request, "fileName"),
            workspaceSysId: readQueryParam(request, "workspaceSysId")
        });
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({ error: { message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(201);
        response.setBody({ result: { asset: result.asset } });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedIconError(error, summarizeRequest(request));
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Something went wrong while uploading the workspace icon. The file was not saved. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-icon-upload.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>42bb5c120d1e466683e32d62429dfb83</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-icon-upload.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_42bb5c120d1e466683e32d62429dfb83</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:34</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_574747ab264c44c1bf53c85258857d50
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) { return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : ""; }
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object")
        return rawBody.data;
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId))
            return null;
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug)
        return null;
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    return row.next() ? mapWorkspaceRecord(row) : null;
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response))
            return;
        if (lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority)
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = service.movePage({
            authority,
            pageSysId: cleanText(body.pageSysId),
            parentPageSysId: cleanText(body.parentPageSysId) || null,
            siblingOrder: cleanText(body.siblingOrder),
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "forbidden", message: result.errorMessage } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "recovery_required"
                            ? "recovery_required"
                            : "invalid",
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? { currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId, currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                pages: result.result.pages,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        gs.error(`[Docsera page move] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page move failure."}`);
        response.setBody({ error: { message: "Something went wrong while moving the page. The page was not moved. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-move.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>574747ab264c44c1bf53c85258857d50</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-move.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_574747ab264c44c1bf53c85258857d50</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideDateTime, GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { loadWorkspaceBySlug, listWorkspacePages } from "./serviceNowPageQueries.ts";
import { buildPublishedPageRecord, savePublishedPageRecord } from "./serviceNowPagePersistence.ts";
import { PAGE_PUBLICATION_STATES, validatePageSettingsSlug } from "./serverPageDomain.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    if (!sysId) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", sysId)) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return Promise.resolve(mapWorkspaceRecord(record));
}
function findPageByReference(pages, reference) {
    const pageSysId = cleanText(reference.pageSysId);
    const pageSlug = cleanText(reference.pageSlug).toLowerCase();
    if (pageSysId) {
        const page = pages.find((candidate) => cleanText(candidate.sysId) === pageSysId) ?? null;
        if (!page) {
            return null;
        }
        if (pageSlug && cleanText(page.draftSlugNormalized || page.draftSlug).toLowerCase() !== pageSlug) {
            return null;
        }
        return page;
    }
    if (!pageSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    return (pages.find((candidate) => cleanText(candidate.draftSlugNormalized || candidate.draftSlug).toLowerCase() === pageSlug) ??
        null);
}
function isDocumentValidationFailure(error) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error).toLowerCase();
    return (message.includes("stored page content") ||
        message.includes("document envelope") ||
        message.includes("valid json") ||
        message.includes("unsupported document") ||
        message.includes("valid tiptap document"));
}
function validatePublishableAncestry(page, pages) {
    const pagesBySysId = new Map();
    for (const candidate of pages) {
        const candidateSysId = cleanText(candidate.sysId);
        if (candidateSysId) {
            pagesBySysId.set(candidateSysId, candidate);
        }
    }
    const visitedAncestors = new Set();
    let ancestorSysId = cleanText(page.parentPageSysId);
    while (ancestorSysId) {
        if (visitedAncestors.has(ancestorSysId)) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                errorMessage: "This page cannot be published until all ancestor pages are published."
            };
        }
        visitedAncestors.add(ancestorSysId);
        const ancestor = pagesBySysId.get(ancestorSysId);
        if (!ancestor) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                errorMessage: "This page cannot be published until all ancestor pages are published."
            };
        }
        if (ancestor.publicationState !== PAGE_PUBLICATION_STATES.published &&
            ancestor.publicationState !== PAGE_PUBLICATION_STATES.publishedWithUnpublishedChanges) {
            return {
                valid: false,
                errorMessage: "This page cannot be published until all ancestor pages are published."
            };
        }
        ancestorSysId = cleanText(ancestor.parentPageSysId);
    }
    return {
        valid: true,
        errorMessage: ""
    };
}
export function createPagePublishService(dependencies) {
    return {
        async publishPage(input) {
            const workspaceSlug = cleanText(input.workspaceSlug);
            const workspaceSysId = cleanText(input.workspaceSysId);
            const pageSysId = cleanText(input.pageSysId);
            const pageSlug = cleanText(input.pageSlug);
            if (!workspaceSlug && !workspaceSysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A workspace reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            if (!pageSysId && !pageSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A page reference is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const expectedRevision = Number(input.expectedRevision);
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expectedRevision) || expectedRevision < 0) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "A non-negative expected draft revision is required.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const workspace = workspaceSysId && typeof dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId === "function"
                ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySysId(workspaceSysId)
                : workspaceSlug
                    ? await dependencies.loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug)
                    : null;
            if (!workspace || !workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (workspaceSlug && workspace.slug !== workspaceSlug) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Workspace could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            const capability = dependencies.evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities(workspace);
            if (!capability.canEditWorkspace && !capability.canAdminWorkspace) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to publish pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            let pages;
            try {
                pages = await dependencies.listWorkspacePages(workspace.sysId);
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (isDocumentValidationFailure(error)) {
                    return {
                        kind: "failed",
                        errorMessage: "The current draft content cannot be published.",
                        status: 400
                    };
                }
                throw error;
            }
            const page = findPageByReference(pages, input);
            if (!page) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found.",
                    status: 404
                };
            }
            if (cleanText(page.workspaceSysId) !== workspace.sysId) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "Page could not be found in this workspace.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const currentRevision = Number.isSafeInteger(Number(page.draftRevision)) ? Number(page.draftRevision) : 0;
            if (currentRevision !== expectedRevision) {
                return {
                    kind: "conflict",
                    currentRevision,
                    errorMessage: "This page has a newer saved draft. Reload before publishing again."
                };
            }
            const slugValidation = validatePageSettingsSlug(page.draftSlug, pages, workspace.sysId, page.sysId);
            if (!slugValidation.valid) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: slugValidation.error,
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const ancestryValidation = validatePublishableAncestry(page, pages);
            if (!ancestryValidation.valid) {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: ancestryValidation.errorMessage,
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const currentUser = dependencies.getCurrentUser();
            if (!cleanText(currentUser.sysId)) {
                return {
                    kind: "forbidden",
                    errorMessage: "You do not have permission to publish pages in this workspace."
                };
            }
            let nextPage;
            try {
                nextPage = buildPublishedPageRecord(page, {
                    publishedAt: dependencies.currentTimestamp(),
                    publishedByDisplayName: currentUser.displayName,
                    publishedBySysId: currentUser.sysId
                });
            }
            catch {
                return {
                    kind: "failed",
                    errorMessage: "The current draft content cannot be published.",
                    status: 400
                };
            }
            const savedPage = await dependencies.publishPage(nextPage, expectedRevision);
            if (!savedPage) {
                return {
                    kind: "conflict",
                    currentRevision,
                    errorMessage: "This page has a newer saved draft. Reload before publishing again."
                };
            }
            return {
                kind: "succeeded",
                page: savedPage
            };
        }
    };
}
export function createServiceNowPagePublishService() {
    const service = createPagePublishService({
        currentTimestamp: () => new GlideDateTime().getValue(),
        evaluateWorkspaceCapabilities: evaluateCurrentUserWorkspaceCapabilities,
        getCurrentUser: () => ({
            displayName: cleanText(gs.getUserDisplayName()) || cleanText(gs.getUserName()) || null,
            sysId: cleanText(gs.getUserID())
        }),
        loadWorkspaceBySlug,
        loadWorkspaceBySysId,
        listWorkspacePages,
        publishPage: savePublishedPageRecord,
    });
    return {
        async publishPage(input) {
            return service.publishPage(input);
        }
    };
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPagePublishing.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>62efa124099547169c40ca68713368ff</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPagePublishing.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_62efa124099547169c40ca68713368ff</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
