sys_update_xml.name: sys_module_76072ec07d1b4939a653f2549de29f7f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceProvisioningService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceProvisioning.ts";
import { canCurrentUserCreateWorkspaces } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceCapabilities.ts";
import { toWorkspaceViewRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readStringFromObjectValue(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (const entry of value) {
            const text = cleanText(entry);
            if (text) {
                return text;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        return (cleanText(value.value) ||
            cleanText(value.sys_id));
    }
    return cleanText(value);
}
function readRequestId(request) {
    const queryParams = request?.queryParams;
    if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === "object") {
        const direct = readStringFromObjectValue(queryParams.requestId);
        if (direct) {
            return direct;
        }
        const sysId = readStringFromObjectValue(queryParams.sys_id);
        if (sysId) {
            return sysId;
        }
    }
    const queryString = cleanText(request?.queryString);
    if (queryString) {
        for (const segment of queryString.split("&")) {
            const [rawKey, rawValue] = segment.split("=", 2);
            if (cleanText(rawKey) === "requestId" || cleanText(rawKey) === "sys_id") {
                return cleanText(decodeURIComponent(rawValue || ""));
            }
        }
    }
    return "";
}
function cloneRoleNames(roleNames) {
    return {
        docseraAdmin: cleanText(roleNames.docseraAdmin),
        editor: cleanText(roleNames.editor),
        workspaceAdmin: cleanText(roleNames.workspaceAdmin)
    };
}
function logUnexpectedWorkspaceProvisioningStatusError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown workspace provisioning status failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera workspace provisioning status] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    if (!canCurrentUserCreateWorkspaces()) {
        response.setStatus?.(403);
        response.setBody?.({
            error: {
                code: "workspace_provisioning_status_forbidden",
                message: "You do not have permission to check workspace provisioning status."
            }
        });
        return;
    }
    const requestId = readRequestId(request);
    if (!requestId) {
        response.setStatus?.(400);
        response.setBody?.({
            error: {
                message: "Workspace provisioning requestId is required."
            }
        });
        return;
    }
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceProvisioningService();
        const result = await service.getProvisioningStatus(requestId);
        if (!result) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody?.({
                error: {
                    message: "Workspace provisioning request could not be found."
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setBody?.({
                result: {
                    error: {
                        code: result.errorCode,
                        message: result.errorMessage
                    },
                    mode: "servicenow",
                    provisioning: {
                        requestId: result.requestId,
                        state: "failed",
                        statusPath: service.statusPathFor(result.requestId)
                    },
                    roleNames: cloneRoleNames(service.roleNames)
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "pending") {
            response.setBody?.({
                result: {
                    mode: "servicenow",
                    provisioning: {
                        pollAfterMs: 1000,
                        requestId: result.requestId,
                        state: result.state,
                        statusPath: service.statusPathFor(result.requestId)
                    },
                    roleNames: cloneRoleNames(service.roleNames)
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setBody?.({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                provisioning: {
                    requestId: result.requestId,
                    state: "succeeded",
                    statusPath: service.statusPathFor(result.requestId)
                },
                workspace: toWorkspaceViewRecord(result.workspace, "Admin"),
                groups: {
                    admin: result.adminGroup,
                    editor: result.editorGroup
                },
                roleNames: cloneRoleNames(service.roleNames)
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedWorkspaceProvisioningStatusError(error, { requestId });
        response.setBody?.({
            error: {
                message: "Workspace provisioning status could not be checked. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-provisioning-status.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>76072ec07d1b4939a653f2549de29f7f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-provisioning-status.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_76072ec07d1b4939a653f2549de29f7f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord, gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistence.ts";
import { readWorkspaceMutationAuthority, sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure, verifyWorkspaceEditLease } from "./docsera-runtime-workspace-edit-lease.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readRequestBody(request) {
    const rawBody = request?.body ?? request?.data;
    if (rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" && "data" in rawBody && rawBody.data && typeof rawBody.data === "object") {
        return rawBody.data;
    }
    return rawBody && typeof rawBody === "object" ? rawBody : {};
}
function summarizeRequestBody(body) {
    const draftBodyText = cleanText(body.draftBodyText);
    return {
        workspaceSlug: cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) || undefined,
        workspaceSysId: cleanText(body.workspaceSysId) || undefined,
        pageSysId: cleanText(body.pageSysId) || undefined,
        pageSlug: cleanText(body.pageSlug) || undefined,
        draftBodyTextPresent: Boolean(draftBodyText),
        draftBodyTextLength: draftBodyText.length,
        expectedRevision: Number.isSafeInteger(Number(body.expectedRevision)) ? Number(body.expectedRevision) : undefined
    };
}
function logUnexpectedPageSaveError(error, context) {
    const message = cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown page save failure.";
    const stack = error instanceof Error ? cleanText(error.stack) : "";
    gs.error(`[Docsera page save] ${JSON.stringify({
        context,
        message,
        stack: stack || undefined
    })}`);
}
function loadWorkspace(body) {
    const workspaceSysId = cleanText(body.workspaceSysId);
    const workspaceSlug = cleanText(body.workspaceSlug);
    const row = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    if (workspaceSysId) {
        if (!row.get("sys_id", workspaceSysId)) {
            return null;
        }
        const workspace = mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
        return !workspaceSlug || workspace.slug === workspaceSlug ? workspace : null;
    }
    if (!workspaceSlug) {
        return null;
    }
    row.addQuery("workspace_slug", workspaceSlug);
    row.setLimit(1);
    row.query();
    if (!row.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(row);
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    try {
        const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService();
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response))
            return;
        if (lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        const authority = readWorkspaceMutationAuthority(lease, body, response);
        if (!authority)
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: "invalid",
                    retryable: false,
                    message: "A workspace reference is required."
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: "invalid",
                    retryable: false,
                    message: "Workspace could not be found."
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        const result = service.savePageBody({
            authority,
            draftContentJson: body.draftContentJson,
            expectedRevision: Number(body.expectedRevision),
            pageSysId: cleanText(body.pageSysId),
            pageSlug: cleanText(body.pageSlug),
            workspace
        });
        if (result.kind === "forbidden") {
            response.setStatus?.(403);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: "forbidden",
                    retryable: false,
                    message: result.errorMessage
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({
                error: {
                    code: result.code === "stale_generation"
                        ? "stale_generation"
                        : result.code === "recovery_required"
                            ? "recovery_required"
                            : "invalid",
                    retryable: false,
                    message: result.errorMessage,
                    ...(typeof result.currentChangeSetId === "string" && typeof result.currentChangeSetRevision === "number"
                        ? {
                            currentChangeSetId: result.currentChangeSetId,
                            currentChangeSetRevision: result.currentChangeSetRevision
                        }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.affectedPageCount === "number"
                        ? { affectedPageCount: result.affectedPageCount }
                        : {}),
                    ...(typeof result.recoveryCommandId === "string" && result.recoveryCommandId
                        ? { recoveryCommandId: result.recoveryCommandId }
                        : {})
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({
            result: {
                mode: "servicenow",
                page: result.result.page,
                changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId,
                changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision
            }
        });
    }
    catch (error) {
        const body = readRequestBody(request);
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        logUnexpectedPageSaveError(error, summarizeRequestBody(body));
        response.setBody({
            error: {
                code: "persistence_invariant",
                retryable: false,
                message: "Something went wrong while saving the page body. Please try again."
            }
        });
    }
}
/** Recovery deliberately shares this established runtime module so its
 * deployment boundary remains the same as the body-save replay it invokes. */
export async function processBodySaveRecovery(request, response) {
    const body = readRequestBody(request);
    try {
        const lease = await verifyWorkspaceEditLease(body);
        if (sendWorkspaceLeaseMutationFailure(lease, response) || lease.kind !== "held")
            return;
        if (!cleanText(body.workspaceSlug) && !cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)) {
            response.setStatus?.(400);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", retryable: false, message: "A workspace reference is required." } });
            return;
        }
        const workspace = loadWorkspace(body);
        if (!workspace) {
            response.setStatus?.(404);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "invalid", retryable: false, message: "Workspace could not be found." } });
            return;
        }
        const result = createServiceNowWorkspaceChangeSetPersistenceService().recoverAbandonedBodySave(workspace);
        if (result.kind === "failed") {
            response.setStatus?.(result.status);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "recovery_failed", retryable: false, message: "The unfinished body save could not be recovered. Further action is required." } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "executor_active") {
            response.setStatus?.(409);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "executor_active", retryable: false, message: "The original body-save executor is still active." } });
            return;
        }
        if (result.kind === "unsupported") {
            response.setStatus?.(409);
            response.setBody({ error: { code: "unsupported_mutation", retryable: false, message: "The unfinished mutation cannot be recovered by this operation." } });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(200);
        response.setBody({ result: { outcome: result.kind, changeSetId: result.authority.changeSetId, changeSetRevision: result.authority.changeSetRevision } });
    }
    catch (error) {
        gs.error(`[Docsera body-save recovery] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown failure"}`);
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "recovery_failed", retryable: false, message: "The unfinished body save could not be recovered. Further action is required." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-save.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>8ceedb64127a4587bad9afc3eeed975b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-page-save.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_8ceedb64127a4587bad9afc3eeed975b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE } from "./serverPageDomain.ts";
import { DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE } from "../workspaces/serverWorkspaceDomain.ts";
import { mapPageRecord } from "./serviceNowPageRecords.ts";
import { mapWorkspaceRecord } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function comparePageRecords(left, right) {
    if (left.siblingOrder !== right.siblingOrder) {
        return left.siblingOrder - right.siblingOrder;
    }
    const titleComparison = cleanText(left.draftTitle).localeCompare(cleanText(right.draftTitle), undefined, {
        sensitivity: "base"
    });
    if (titleComparison !== 0) {
        return titleComparison;
    }
    const slugComparison = cleanText(left.draftSlug).localeCompare(cleanText(right.draftSlug), undefined, {
        sensitivity: "base"
    });
    if (slugComparison !== 0) {
        return slugComparison;
    }
    return cleanText(left.sysId).localeCompare(cleanText(right.sysId), undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
}
export function loadWorkspaceBySlug(workspaceSlug) {
    const slug = cleanText(workspaceSlug);
    if (!slug) {
        return null;
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_WORKSPACE_TABLE);
    record.addQuery("workspace_slug", slug);
    record.addQuery("status", "active");
    record.setLimit(1);
    record.query();
    if (!record.next()) {
        return null;
    }
    return mapWorkspaceRecord(record);
}
export function sortPageRecordsForTree(records) {
    const nodesByKey = new Map();
    const roots = [];
    records.forEach((page, index) => {
        const key = cleanText(page.sysId) || `${cleanText(page.workspaceSysId)}:${cleanText(page.draftSlug)}:${index}`;
        nodesByKey.set(key, {
            key,
            page,
            children: []
        });
    });
    for (const node of nodesByKey.values()) {
        const parentKey = cleanText(node.page.parentPageSysId);
        const parentNode = parentKey ? nodesByKey.get(parentKey) : null;
        if (parentNode && parentNode.key !== node.key) {
            parentNode.children.push(node);
            continue;
        }
        roots.push(node);
    }
    const sortNodes = (nodes) => {
        nodes.sort((left, right) => comparePageRecords(left.page, right.page));
        for (const node of nodes) {
            sortNodes(node.children);
        }
    };
    sortNodes(roots);
    const ordered = [];
    const visited = new Set();
    const visit = (node) => {
        if (visited.has(node.key)) {
            return;
        }
        visited.add(node.key);
        ordered.push(node.page);
        for (const child of node.children) {
            visit(child);
        }
    };
    for (const root of roots) {
        visit(root);
    }
    const remaining = [...nodesByKey.values()].filter((node) => !visited.has(node.key));
    remaining.sort((left, right) => comparePageRecords(left.page, right.page));
    for (const node of remaining) {
        visit(node);
    }
    return ordered;
}
export function filterActivePageRecords(records) {
    return records.filter((record) => record.active !== false);
}
export function listWorkspacePages(workspaceSysId, options = {}) {
    const sysId = cleanText(workspaceSysId);
    const pages = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    pages.addQuery("workspace", sysId);
    if (options.activeOnly !== false) {
        pages.addQuery("active", true);
    }
    pages.query();
    const results = [];
    while (pages.next()) {
        results.push(mapPageRecord(pages));
    }
    return Promise.resolve(sortPageRecordsForTree(filterActivePageRecords(results)));
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageQueries.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>a143a919fef543ee8122a1c4a925e297</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPageQueries.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_a143a919fef543ee8122a1c4a925e297</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { gs } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createServiceNowWorkspaceDeletionService } from "../workspaces/serviceNowWorkspaceDeletion.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function readBody(request) {
    const body = request?.body?.data;
    return body && typeof body === "object" && !Array.isArray(body) ? body : {};
}
export async function process(request, response) {
    const body = readBody(request);
    const service = createServiceNowWorkspaceDeletionService();
    try {
        const result = await service.deleteWorkspace({
            workspaceSlug: cleanText(body.workspaceSlug),
            workspaceSysId: cleanText(body.workspaceSysId)
        });
        if (result.kind === "succeeded") {
            response.setStatus?.(200);
            response.setBody({ result: { state: "succeeded", workspace: result.workspace } });
            return;
        }
        response.setStatus?.(result.status);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: result.status === 403 ? "forbidden" : result.status === 404 ? "not_found" : "delete_failed", deletionCommitted: result.deletionCommitted === true, message: result.errorMessage } });
    }
    catch (error) {
        gs.error(`[Docsera workspace deletion route] ${cleanText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error) || "Unknown failure"}`);
        response.setStatus?.(500);
        response.setBody({ error: { code: "delete_failed", message: "Something went wrong while deleting the workspace. Nothing was deleted. Please try again." } });
    }
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-delete.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>ab658fa9140b4bc3b4143f25f8f37d72</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/api/docsera-runtime-workspace-delete.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_ab658fa9140b4bc3b4143f25f8f37d72</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_module"><sys_module action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><content><![CDATA[import { GlideRecord } from "@servicenow/glide";
import { createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope, parseServerDocument, extractPlainTextFromServerDocument } from "./serverEditorDocument.ts";
import { DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE, normalizePageRecord, PAGE_PUBLICATION_STATES, resolvePagePublicationState } from "./serverPageDomain.ts";
import { mapPageRecord } from "./serviceNowPageRecords.ts";
function cleanText(value) {
    return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
}
function serializePageContentJson(value) {
    return JSON.stringify(value ?? createEmptyServerDocumentEnvelope());
}
function loadExistingPageRecord(pageSysId) {
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", pageSysId)) {
        throw new Error("Page record could not be loaded.");
    }
    return record;
}
function rereadPageRecord(pageSysId) {
    return mapPageRecord(loadExistingPageRecord(pageSysId));
}
export function createPageBodyContentJsonFromText(text) {
    const normalizedText = cleanText(text).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
    const lines = normalizedText ? normalizedText.split("\n") : [""];
    return {
        schemaVersion: 1,
        document: {
            type: "doc",
            content: lines.map((line) => ({
                type: "paragraph",
                content: line
                    ? [
                        {
                            type: "text",
                            text: line
                        }
                    ]
                    : []
            }))
        }
    };
}
export function buildPageBodySaveRecord(page, draftBodyText, draftRevision = page.draftRevision ?? 0) {
    const normalizedPage = normalizePageRecord(page);
    const normalizedBodyText = cleanText(draftBodyText) || null;
    const draftContentJson = createPageBodyContentJsonFromText(normalizedBodyText ?? "");
    const nextPage = {
        ...normalizedPage,
        draftBodyText: normalizedBodyText,
        draftContentJson,
        draftRevision: Number.isSafeInteger(draftRevision) && draftRevision >= 0 ? draftRevision : normalizedPage.draftRevision ?? 0
    };
    return {
        ...nextPage,
        publicationState: resolvePagePublicationState(nextPage)
    };
}
export function buildPageContentSaveRecord(page, draftContentJson, draftRevision = page.draftRevision ?? 0) {
    const normalizedPage = normalizePageRecord({
        ...page,
        draftContentJson
    });
    const nextPage = {
        ...normalizedPage,
        draftBodyText: extractPlainTextFromServerDocument(normalizedPage.draftContentJson) || null,
        draftRevision: Number.isSafeInteger(draftRevision) && draftRevision >= 0 ? draftRevision : normalizedPage.draftRevision ?? 0
    };
    return {
        ...nextPage,
        publicationState: resolvePagePublicationState(nextPage)
    };
}
export function savePageRecord(page) {
    const draft = normalizePageRecord(page);
    const record = draft.sysId ? loadExistingPageRecord(draft.sysId) : new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    if (!draft.sysId) {
        record.initialize();
    }
    record.setValue("workspace", draft.workspaceSysId);
    record.setValue("parent_page", draft.parentPageSysId ?? "");
    record.setValue("sibling_order", String(draft.siblingOrder));
    record.setValue("draft_title", draft.draftTitle);
    record.setValue("draft_slug", draft.draftSlug);
    record.setValue("draft_slug_normalized", draft.draftSlugNormalized);
    record.setValue("draft_content_json", serializePageContentJson(draft.draftContentJson));
    record.setValue("draft_revision", draft.draftRevision ?? 0);
    record.setValue("draft_body_text", draft.draftBodyText ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_title", draft.publishedTitle ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_slug", draft.publishedSlug ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_slug_normalized", draft.publishedSlugNormalized ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_content_json", draft.publishedContentJson ? serializePageContentJson(draft.publishedContentJson) : "");
    record.setValue("published_body_text", draft.publishedBodyText ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_at", draft.publishedAt ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_by", draft.publishedBySysId ?? "");
    record.setValue("publication_state", draft.publicationState);
    record.setValue("active", draft.active);
    const savedSysId = cleanText(draft.sysId ? record.update() : record.insert());
    if (!savedSysId) {
        throw new Error("Failed to save page record.");
    }
    return Promise.resolve(rereadPageRecord(savedSysId));
}
/**
 * Saves only the draft fields used by autosave for a single active editor
 * session. The caller-provided revision remains a sequential stale-request
 * guard, but this helper does not claim atomic cross-session protection.
 */
export function savePageDraftRecord(page, expectedRevision) {
    const draft = normalizePageRecord(page);
    if (!draft.sysId || typeof expectedRevision !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedRevision) || expectedRevision < 0) {
        throw new Error("A saved page and expected draft revision are required.");
    }
    const currentRevision = expectedRevision;
    const acceptedRevision = currentRevision + 1;
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", draft.sysId)) {
        throw new Error("Page record could not be loaded.");
    }
    const persistedRevision = Number(record.getValue("draft_revision"));
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(persistedRevision) || persistedRevision < 0) {
        throw new Error("Page record has an invalid persisted draft revision.");
    }
    if (persistedRevision !== currentRevision) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    const persistedPublishedSnapshot = {
        publishedTitle: cleanText(record.getValue("published_title")) || null,
        publishedSlug: cleanText(record.getValue("published_slug")) || null,
        publishedSlugNormalized: cleanText(record.getValue("published_slug_normalized")) || null,
        publishedContentJson: cleanText(record.getValue("published_content_json"))
            ? parseServerDocument(String(record.getValue("published_content_json")))
            : null,
        publishedBodyText: cleanText(record.getValue("published_body_text")) || null
    };
    const persistedDraftSnapshot = {
        ...draft,
        ...persistedPublishedSnapshot,
        publicationState: resolvePagePublicationState({
            ...draft,
            ...persistedPublishedSnapshot
        })
    };
    record.setValue("draft_body_text", persistedDraftSnapshot.draftBodyText ?? "");
    record.setValue("draft_content_json", serializePageContentJson(persistedDraftSnapshot.draftContentJson));
    record.setValue("draft_revision", acceptedRevision);
    record.setValue("publication_state", persistedDraftSnapshot.publicationState);
    const updatedSysId = cleanText(record.update());
    if (!updatedSysId) {
        throw new Error("Failed to save page record.");
    }
    return Promise.resolve({ ...persistedDraftSnapshot, draftRevision: acceptedRevision });
}
export function buildPublishedPageRecord(page, input) {
    const normalizedPage = normalizePageRecord(page);
    const publishedTitle = cleanText(normalizedPage.draftTitle);
    const publishedSlug = cleanText(normalizedPage.draftSlugNormalized || normalizedPage.draftSlug).toLowerCase();
    const publishedBodyText = extractPlainTextFromServerDocument(normalizedPage.draftContentJson) || null;
    return {
        ...normalizedPage,
        draftSlug: publishedSlug,
        draftSlugNormalized: publishedSlug,
        draftBodyText: publishedBodyText,
        publishedTitle,
        publishedSlug,
        publishedSlugNormalized: publishedSlug,
        publishedContentJson: parseServerDocument(normalizedPage.draftContentJson),
        publishedBodyText,
        publishedAt: cleanText(input.publishedAt) || null,
        publishedBySysId: cleanText(input.publishedBySysId) || null,
        publishedByDisplayName: cleanText(input.publishedByDisplayName) || null,
        publicationState: PAGE_PUBLICATION_STATES.published
    };
}
export function savePublishedPageRecord(page, expectedRevision) {
    const draft = normalizePageRecord(page);
    if (!draft.sysId || typeof expectedRevision !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(expectedRevision) || expectedRevision < 0) {
        throw new Error("A saved page and expected draft revision are required.");
    }
    const record = loadExistingPageRecord(draft.sysId);
    const persistedRevision = Number(record.getValue("draft_revision"));
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(persistedRevision) || persistedRevision < 0) {
        throw new Error("Page record has an invalid persisted draft revision.");
    }
    if (persistedRevision !== expectedRevision) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    const persistedPage = mapPageRecord(record);
    const nextPublishedPage = {
        ...persistedPage,
        publishedTitle: draft.publishedTitle,
        publishedSlug: draft.publishedSlug,
        publishedSlugNormalized: draft.publishedSlugNormalized,
        publishedContentJson: draft.publishedContentJson,
        publishedBodyText: draft.publishedBodyText,
        publishedAt: draft.publishedAt,
        publishedBySysId: draft.publishedBySysId,
        publishedByDisplayName: draft.publishedByDisplayName
    };
    record.setValue("published_title", nextPublishedPage.publishedTitle ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_slug", nextPublishedPage.publishedSlug ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_slug_normalized", nextPublishedPage.publishedSlugNormalized ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_content_json", nextPublishedPage.publishedContentJson ? serializePageContentJson(nextPublishedPage.publishedContentJson) : "");
    record.setValue("published_body_text", nextPublishedPage.publishedBodyText ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_at", nextPublishedPage.publishedAt ?? "");
    record.setValue("published_by", nextPublishedPage.publishedBySysId ?? "");
    record.setValue("publication_state", resolvePagePublicationState(nextPublishedPage));
    const updatedSysId = cleanText(record.update());
    if (!updatedSysId) {
        throw new Error("Failed to save page record.");
    }
    return Promise.resolve(rereadPageRecord(updatedSysId));
}
export function savePageSettingsRecord(page) {
    const draft = normalizePageRecord(page);
    if (!draft.sysId) {
        throw new Error("A saved page is required.");
    }
    const record = loadExistingPageRecord(draft.sysId);
    const persistedPage = mapPageRecord(record);
    const nextPage = {
        ...persistedPage,
        draftTitle: draft.draftTitle,
        draftSlug: draft.draftSlug,
        draftSlugNormalized: draft.draftSlugNormalized
    };
    record.setValue("draft_title", nextPage.draftTitle);
    record.setValue("draft_slug", nextPage.draftSlug);
    record.setValue("draft_slug_normalized", nextPage.draftSlugNormalized);
    record.setValue("publication_state", resolvePagePublicationState(nextPage));
    const updatedSysId = cleanText(record.update());
    if (!updatedSysId) {
        throw new Error("Failed to save page record.");
    }
    return Promise.resolve(rereadPageRecord(updatedSysId));
}
export function deletePageRecord(pageSysId) {
    const normalizedPageSysId = cleanText(pageSysId);
    if (!normalizedPageSysId) {
        throw new Error("Page record could not be loaded.");
    }
    const record = new GlideRecord(DOCSERA_PAGE_TABLE);
    if (!record.get("sys_id", normalizedPageSysId)) {
        throw new Error("Page record could not be loaded.");
    }
    const deleted = record.deleteRecord();
    if (!deleted) {
        throw new Error("Failed to delete page record.");
    }
    return Promise.resolve();
}
]]></content><external_source>false</external_source><path>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPagePersistence.ts</path><sys_class_name>sys_module</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>b739644bdfc947459665af0d0c0311df</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2300756_docsera/docsera-direct-ui-page-runtime/0.1.0/src/server/pages/serviceNowPagePersistence.ts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Docsera" source="x_2300756_docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Docsera">e6e43323accd4c7fb9271525a343850e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_module_b739644bdfc947459665af0d0c0311df</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-03 17:35:35</sys_updated_on></sys_module></record_update>
